item.title: Nestle third quarter organic sales beat forecast, deconsolidates Russian business
item.description: Nestle reported better than expected organic sales growth for the third quarter on Thursday and said it had deconsolidated its Russian business after Moscow seized control of Nestle's Russian assets last month.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Marrow
item.content:encoded: Nestle (NESN.S) reported better than expected organic sales growth for the third quarter on Thursday and said it had deconsolidated its Russian business after Moscow seized control of Nestle's Russian assets last month. Nestle, the maker of Maggi stock cubes and Nescafe coffee, maintained its outlook for 2026 of full-year organic sales in the range of 3% to 4% and recorded a 4% uptick in quarterly organic sales.

item.title: Raffles Family Office aims to invest in Rwanda
item.description: Asia's Raffles Family Office has agreed with the Rwanda Development Board to promote developments in the African country to its client network, including infrastructure and tourism projects surrounding Rwanda's plans to host Formula One racing.
item.dc:creator: Rae Wee
item.content:encoded: Asia's Raffles Family Office has agreed with the Rwanda Development Board to promote developments in the African country to its client network, including infrastructure and tourism projects surrounding Rwanda's plans to host Formula One racing. Here are some details: Raffles Family Office, which has headquarters in Hong Kong and Singapore, will work with its high-net-worth clients across Asia and Africa with an aim of "mobilising hundreds of millions of dollars" in investment in the coming years Projects include a new international airport under construction at Bugesera, as well as hospitality, tourism, entertainment, real estate, infrastructure and supporting services in Bugesera, Kigali, Musanze and the rest of the country "This strategic collaboration creates a compelling channel for our clients to explore Rwanda's priority growth opportunities," said Chi Man Kwan, Raffles Family Office's group chief executive officer Last week, it was announced that Africa will return to the F1 calendar for the first time since 1993, with Rwanda [USN:L6N45Z0M6 TEXT:"set to host a grand prix"] from the early 2030s in a 10-year deal Raffles Family Office earlier this year established its Rwandan representative office in Kigali It announced the appointment of Jean de Dieu Uwihanganye, a former Rwandan cabinet minister and ambassador, as principal for emerging markets and business development, in September

item.title: Nokia third-quarter profit beats expectations
item.description: Finnish telecom equipment maker Nokia reported a bigger than expected rise in quarterly earnings on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Finnish telecom equipment maker Nokia (NOKIA.HE) reported a bigger than expected rise in quarterly earnings on Thursday. Comparable operating profit rose to 605 million euros ($680.20 million) in the third quarter of 2026 from a year-ago 448 million euros, above the average estimate of 453 million euros in a company-provided poll. ($1 = 0.8894 euros)

item.title: French company Thales reports 8% higher 9-month sales led by arms spending
item.description: French defence and security company Thales on Thursday reported an 8.1% organic increase in nine-month sales, boosted by rising arms purchases, and confirmed its forecasts for the year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French defence and security company Thales (TCFP.PA) on Thursday reported an 8.1% organic increase in nine-month sales, boosted by rising arms purchases, and confirmed its forecasts for the year. The group, whose products range from military radar to civil air traffic control, confirmed its financial targets for 2026, adding that expected organic sales growth should come in near the upper end of its 6% to 7% targeted range. Europe's largest defence technology group said sales rose to €16.42 billion ($18.46 billion) from €15.25 billion a year earlier, while its order intake rose 14% to €19.12 billion from €16.76 billion for the same period last year. Analysts on average had expected organic growth of 7.4% in nine-month sales to €16.33 billion and 11% growth in order intake to €18.58 billion, according to a company-compiled consensus. Defence, its main division, which accounted for more than half of 2025 sales, grew organically by 13% to €9.36 billion, above the 12.4% growth analysts expected. Thales booked 11 major orders exceeding €100 million each in the third quarter, it said, including an [USN:S8N41V020 TEXT:"agreement"] with satellite operator Eutelsat to supply government payloads for the European Union's IRIS² planned communications constellation. Chief Financial Officer Jeremie Papin, who took over the role in July, said during a press briefing that the group benefited from sustained commercial momentum. ($1 = 0.8894 euros)

item.title: How Europe's emptying countryside is fuelling a new wildfire crisis
item.description: Untended forests are spreading into vacated farmland, providing fuel for some of Europe’s worst fires. A megablaze in Spain exposed the risks when rising temperatures collide with decades of land abandonment.
item.dc:creator: Mariano Zafra, Kate Abnett, Pietro Lombardi
item.content:encoded: Europe is emerging from one of its worst wildfire seasons on record. Deadly blazes this year ripped through countries including Spain, France and Greece, forcing hundreds of thousands to evacuate and burning 699,000 hectares (1.7 million acres) - an area more than four times the size of London. The disasters highlighted how climate change is fuelling hot and dry conditions that amplify wildfires. But another, often-overlooked factor played a pivotal rolein some instances: How governments and private landowners are managing Europe’s emptying countryside. As climate change pushes temperatures to new peaks, the consequences of this landscape evolution are becoming clear: This summer, tinder-dry stretches of untended forest and shrubland served as the perfect fuel for Spain’s biggest wildfire in recent history. Click here to read the full story.

item.title: China reports $30 billion in natural disaster losses in first 9 months
item.description: China's direct economic losses from natural disasters totalled 199.36 billion yuan ($29.9 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, the Ministry of Emergency Management said on Thursday, adding that extreme disasters included typhoons, flooding and heavy rainfall and geological disasters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's direct economic losses from natural disasters totalled 199.36 billion yuan ($29.9 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, the Ministry of Emergency Management said on Thursday, adding that extreme disasters included typhoons, flooding and heavy rainfall and geological disasters. The ministry said 562 people had died or were missing from the deadly Nepal-Tibet disaster in August, leaving the toll unchanged from a previous announcement. ($1 = 6.6743 Chinese yuan)

item.title: Luka Doncic, Lakers open with dominant win vs. Stephen Curry, Warriors
item.description: Luka Doncic scored 28 points and Walker Kessler added 26 on 12-of-12 shooting in his Los Angeles debut as the Lakers routed the visiting Golden State Warriors 127-105 on Wednesday in the season opener for both teams.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Luka Doncic scored 28 points and Walker Kessler added 26 on 12-of-12 shooting in his Los Angeles debut as the Lakers routed the visiting Golden State Warriors 127-105 on Wednesday in the season opener for both teams. Austin Reaves scored 23 points, while Jake LaRavia and Quentin Grimes had 10 apiece for Los Angeles, which led by 14 at halftime before taking control by outscoring Golden State 36-16 in the third quarter. Kessler finished with nine rebounds and 10 dunks for the Lakers, who opened the season with nine new players after four-time NBA MVP LeBron James left as a free agent to join the Philadelphia 76ers. Doncic added eight rebounds and seven assists. Golden State was led by Stephen Curry, who scored 20 of his 23 points in the first half. Brandon Williams contributed 14 points, Gui Santos and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg scored 12 apiece, and Gary Payton II chipped in 10. Los Angeles led 34-33 after the first quarter despite a hot start by Curry, who scored 16 of the Warriors' first 21 points. The Lakers closed the second quarter with a 17-4 run and took a 66-52 lead into halftime after shooting 63.2% from the field. Doncic capped the half by draining a bank shot from near halfcourt, giving him 23 points in 18 minutes. Doncic was primarily guarded by Lendeborg, who received a technical foul late in the second quarter after the players exchanged words throughout the first half. Curry was held to three points in the decisive third quarter. The Lakers extended their lead to 90-61 on Reaves' 3-pointer with 4:31 remaining in the period. Los Angeles led 102-68 entering the fourth quarter, and Curry sat out the entire period. The Warriors played without starting guard Brandin Podziemski (lower back soreness) and center Charles Bassey (knee tendinitis). Golden State also was without several players, including Moses Moody, Jimmy Butler and Kristaps Porzingis. Moody and Butler are not expected to return until January while recovering from knee injuries, while Porzingis is out indefinitely because of a health issue. --Field Level Media

item.title: French investors face boiling frog test
item.description: The risk premium on Paris' €3.6 trln debt is the widest since 2011. The ECB could come to the rescue only if yields climb higher and lawmakers embrace fiscal rigour. A more likely delay could deepen the economic and political fallout, and require more serious austerity.
item.dc:creator: Neil Unmack
item.content:encoded: After years in which France's borrowing and debt levels have risen without murmur, a jump in yields is finally making investors realise they are getting burned. What’s not clear, however, is whether and when France, or the European Central Bank, can turn down the heat. France’s parlous fiscal situation is no secret. President Emmanuel Macron’s fiscal giveaways, stagnant growth, and half-hearted [USN:L8N44H1DA TEXT:"budgets"] have brought the government's debt to about €3.6 trillion. Based on IMF projections, the budget deficit will be 5.4% of GDP this year. The international backdrop hasn’t helped. An energy crisis fuelled by US President Donald Trump’s war in Iran has led central banks to hike interest rates. But domestic factors are having a big impact in France: the country's 10-year bonds are trading at a yield of around 5%, more than 150 basis points above equivalent German paper. This spread, seen by investors as the premium required to hold riskier debt, has roughly tripled since February, and is the widest since the 2011 euro crisis. It makes France the riskiest sovereign in the single-currency bloc. It’s hard to see the Élysée Palace taking the necessary action. Marine Le Pen’s National Rally looks set to win the next presidential vote in 2027 but, even if she triggered a legislative election right after, polls suggest she wouldn't have the parliamentary majority to push fiscal restraint through. Full-on panic may be unwarranted. First, Paris still spends relatively little to service its total stock of liabilities, thanks to years of cheap bond issues during the ECB's negative rate policy era. According to Oxford Economics, interest payments will amount to 2.3% of GDP this year, compared with 3.9% in Italy. With a debt maturity of about 8 years, even big jumps in yields take time to feed into France’s borrowing costs. In the meantime, its own citizens own half of the debt, and there's room for banks to step in and buy more. Second, the ECB would almost certainly rescue the country before the point of sovereign default. France's €3.1 trillion economy is too big to let fail: doing so would take out otherwise-healthy French lenders - including four globally systemic ones, BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole (BNPP.PA) , Groupe BPCE and Société Générale (SOGN.PA) - and imperil the single currency itself. Both former President Mario Draghi and incumbent Christine Lagarde have shown a willingness to tame financial markets at times of crisis. But the situation may need to get a lot worse before it can get better. Some illustrative numbers: let's say the debt reaches 119% of GDP this year, as the IMF expects, and that France's nominal output grows at an annual 3% from next year - roughly what economists project. Arithmetically, keeping the debt ratio stable would require a budget deficit no wider than 3.5% of GDP a year, a 1.9 percentage-point reduction from current levels. And it gets worse: as old debt rolls over and is replaced by higher-yielding issues in coming years, Oxford Economics forecasts the interest bill to rise to at least 4% of GDP, pushing up the deficit. Subtract that from the required 3.5% of GDP deficit, and the non-interest "primary" balance would need to swing from next year's 3.1% deficit to an 0.5% surplus. Such consolidation looks far beyond what is politically feasible today. Case in point: this year’s budget, a placeholder ahead of the elections, only aims to reduce the deficit to 5%, and has still contributed to [USN:L1N4610U5 TEXT:"protests"] and school fires. The problem isn't just a lack of willingness to reduce the country's expansive welfare state, but that the French have lost the ability to raise [USN:L6N45T0JW TEXT:"revenues"] in tandem: since 2018, tax collections as a percentage of GDP have dropped, largely a result of a reform that permanently depressed employer social security payments. Add this to rising long-term pension costs amid strong resistance to raising France's low retirement age. The other big snag is that, while the ECB does have an array of firehoses, none fit France easily. So-called outright monetary transactions (OMT) rely on a country being willing to submit to EU fiscal adjustment and oversight. Meanwhile, the transmission protection instrument (TPI) unveiled after the Covid-19 pandemic has lighter conditionality but isn't meant to insulate countries against the effects of their own policies. Also, it still requires compliance with European fiscal rules, which include a 3% deficit cap. For the ECB to start to buy, spreads would probably need to be a lot higher, with Capital Economics suggesting an intervention level of at least 250 basis points. In 2018, Italian spreads exceeded 300 basis points when a coalition of anti-EU forces rose to power. The ECB didn't actually buy any bonds then, despite Rome grappling with a deficit that was over three percentage points of GDP lower than Paris' today. The key, then, is whether a prospective Le Pen presidency could avoid stoking fears of a French euro exit and signal fiscal responsibility, making it politically feasible for the ECB to at least talk about buying bonds. After all, Draghi's mere suggestion of OMT was enough to calm investors back in 2012. Yet Le Pen's statements have so far been a mixed bag, unveiling plans to deploy rapid austerity while still insisting on reneging on France's EU budget contribution and refusing to back retirement-age increases. Plus, her victory would trigger even more left-wing unrest, making her chances of reaching compromises in future parliaments even slimmer. So far, market pressure simply hasn't gotten to the point where it's steering French politics. This is a blessing for investors, since it means few distressed sales, but it's also a curse: it provides little incentive for officials to redesign fiscal policy, or for euro zone authorities to step in. Instead, waning investor confidence in France will likely stifle growth and keep raising borrowing costs in coming months and years. When a true economic crisis eventually boils over, the austerity to follow will be much harsher. That a release valve exists is scant consolation for those already in hot water. Follow @Unmack1 on X

item.title: Kuehne+Nagel lifts 2026 outlook for third time on growth in air and sea logistics
item.description: Kuehne+Nagel raised its 2026 operating profit guidance for the third time this year on Thursday, citing continued strength in its air logistics business and market share gains in sea logistics.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kuehne+Nagel (KNIN.S) raised its 2026 operating profit guidance for the third time this year on Thursday, citing continued strength in its air logistics business and market share gains in sea logistics. The freight forwarder, which operates in more than 100 countries, expects recurring earnings before interest and taxes of 1.5 billion to 1.6 billion Swiss francs ($1.8 billion to $2.0 billion) in 2026, up from the 1.35 billion to 1.55 billion franc range [USN:L8N43P04C TEXT:"last raised"] in July. Analysts polled by the company had forecast a median operating profit of 1.5 billion francs for the year. ($1 = 0.8226 Swiss francs)

item.title: UK tax authority plans digital ambassadors to counter AI misinformation
item.description: HMRC plans to deploy digital ambassadors on platforms such as Reddit and make official guidance easier for AI models to access, amid concerns that chatbots are spreading inaccurate tax advice ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Tom Rees The UK’s tax authorities are worried that artificial intelligence is giving people bad advice. HM Revenue & Customs is trying to stem a flood of misinformation from AI and social media, with a plan to deploy “digital ambassadors” to clearly flag correct advice in online forums such as Reddit so that browsers don’t get confused. It’s also taking steps to make official information more easily picked up by large language models. “Where sources conflict, trust falls and the risk of costly errors rises,” James Baker, head of digital communications at HMRC, told Bloomberg. “The department’s conclusion is that proactive intervention, with the right content in the right places, can shape how the wider information ecosystem responds to and corrects misinformation quickly.” AI models have been picking up erroneous information about tax, often from social media, and missing official advice from HMRC. That is then given to Britons searching for advice or amplified on sites such as TikTok.  One such example came earlier this year when search engines and AI-generated summaries were giving wrong advice about value-added tax deadlines for businesses. An investigation by HMRC traced the error to a website which had been copied to other sites, spread more widely on social media and then picked up by AI. False information such as this could have led to taxpayers missing deadlines and receiving penalties. Baker said the “episode also demonstrated how fragmented the citizen information journey has become, with people moving rapidly between search engines, AI tools, apps and social platforms.” While AI companies have warned about the risk of hallucinations or mistakes, Britons are increasingly relying on chatbots for financial advice and investments. Around three in 10 Britons have turned to such tools for financial advice, according to a survey by comparison website Finder. Social media influencers may be amplifying bad advice with videos on how viewers can cut their tax bills. Erroneous advice is a headache for UK tax authorities as they look to close the country’s £59 billion ($79 billion) tax gap — the difference between what it is owed and what it takes. Small businesses are by far the largest reason for the gap but they also may not have the expertise to spot inaccuracies in online advice.  HMRC plans to deploy officials as trusted digital ambassadors to speak to users on online forums and social media, flagging correct information. Baker said the managers will be “a proactive digital equivalent to HMRC’s broadcast spokespeople” and “help to sign post correct information and build trust.” Officials have also set up a new “HMRC Verified” strategy, an alert system aimed at countering online misinformation and guiding LLMs toward the correct advice. The large language models have responded to the changes and highlighted the correct information, according to HMRC. HMRC is also scoping out a new AI-assisted tool that could find and check claims made online against its official advice before drafting a response for a human to review and sign-off. It has issued guidance to staff to make content “LLM ready” before its launch. “Authority no longer lives on your website alone,” Baker added. “It lives in how faithfully the entire machine-readable ecosystem, from Google’s sidebar to a chatbot’s summary to a Reddit thread, repeats what you actually said.”

item.title: Swedish bank SEB Q3 net profit below forecast, pauses share buybacks
item.description: Swedish banking group SEB reported third-quarter net earnings below market expectations on Thursday and said it was pausing share buybacks due to continued loan growth and temporarily higher capital requirements.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swedish banking group SEB (SEBa.ST) reported third-quarter net earnings below market expectations on Thursday and said it was pausing share buybacks due to continued loan growth and temporarily higher capital requirements. SEB's net profit fell to 7.50 billion Swedish crowns ($758.70 million) from a year-ago 7.68 billion, below the 7.91 billion expected by analysts polled by LSEG "Net financial income was negatively impacted by muted client activity and a challenging market-making environment for the fixed income, foreign exchange and commodities business," acting CEO Jonas Ahlstrom said Quarterly net interest income totalled 10.88 billion crowns versus 10.54 billion a year ago and a mean forecast of 10.97 billion SEB said net financial income, which includes trading and is subject to sharper quarterly swings, fell to 1.12 billion crowns from 1.77 billion a year ago Sweden's [USN:L8N460044 TEXT:"financial watchdog"] said earlier this month that SEB will temporarily be subject to higher capital requirements due to Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) model deficiencies. The new measure increases SEB's core tier one capital requirement by approximately 10 billion crowns SEB said costs are expected to come in below the 2026 full year cost target by approximately 500-600 million crowns ($1 = 9.8853 Swedish crowns)

item.title: Damian Lillard shines in return to Blazers during rout of Suns
item.description: Damian Lillard made six 3-pointers and scored 25 points in his first game in nearly 18 months and the Portland Trail Blazers opened the game with 21 consecutive points en route to a 124-83 dismantling of the visiting Phoenix Suns in the season opener for both teams on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Damian Lillard made six 3-pointers and scored 25 points in his first game in nearly 18 months and the Portland Trail Blazers opened the game with 21 consecutive points en route to a 124-83 dismantling of the visiting Phoenix Suns in the season opener for both teams on Wednesday. Lillard, who tore his left Achilles tendon during the 2025 postseason for the Milwaukee Bucks, excelled in 24 minutes in his first appearance in a Portland uniform in more than 3 1/2 years. The face of the franchise from 2012-23 also contributed six assists. He sat out the fourth quarter during a stellar performance in which the Trail Blazers posted their third-largest margin of victory in a season opener. Deni Avdija recorded 18 points and 10 rebounds and Toumani Camara also scored 18 points for Portland, which led by 31 after one quarter and by as many as 52 overall. Ja Morant registered 14 points and eight assists in his Trail Blazers debut after being acquired from the Memphis Grizzlies in the offseason. Scoot Henderson put up 15 points off the bench and Donovan Clingan added 11 points for Portland, which held a 56-39 rebounding advantage. Devin Booker scored 23 points for Phoenix. Dillon Brooks and Jalen Green added 10 points apiece for the Suns, who shot 35.7% from the field and just 6 of 31 (19.4%) from 3-point range. The Trail Blazers hit 19 of 47 (40.4%) from behind the arc and shot 47.9% overall. Portland made four 3-pointers in the first 3:18 of the game to lead by 14. The advantage reached 21-0 on Avdija's two free throws just before the midway point of the quarter. Phoenix's first points came on Booker's two free throws with 5:54 left in the period. The Suns missed their first 10 shots from the field until Oso Ighodaro's dunk with 4:27 remaining cut their deficit to 25-6. Portland's lead reached 30 when Lillard drilled a trey to make it 38-8 with 2:06 left. Henderson buried the Trail Blazers' eighth 3-pointer of the quarter to make it 43-12 with 6.9 seconds remaining. Camara hit two 3-pointers during a 12-0 run to push the lead to 62-24 with 4:07 to go in the second quarter. The Trail Blazers led 72-39 at the half behind Lillard's 17 points and Camara's 15. The margin reached 40 for the first time at 104-64 when Henderson stole the ball and raced for a layup with 1:14 remaining in the third. Lillard's sixth 3-pointer came with 40.9 seconds left as Portland took a 107-66 advantage into the final stanza. Yang Hansen drained a 3-pointer to push the Trail Blazers' lead to 122-70 with 3:38 remaining in the game. --Field Level Media

item.title: インドネシア大統領がＭＳＣＩを批判 市場再分類問題巡り
item.description: [ジャカルタ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ジャカルタ ２１日 ロイター] - インドネシアのプラボウォ大統領は２１日の閣議で、指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩが同国に対して「脅しをかけようとしている」と批判した。ＭＳＣＩがインドネシア株式市場の再分類を警告して以来、大統領が公の場で反応を示したのは初めて。

ＭＳＣＩは先週インドネシア株式市場について、市場参加者による協調的な取引慣行への対策が不十分だとして、新興国市場指数から除外して「スタンドアローン市場」に変更する可能性があると発表した。

この発表を受け、インドネシア株式市場は２日間で過去最大の下落率を記録。変更が実施された場合、大規模な資本流出を招き、主要な新興国株指数への組み入れに伴う資金流入から切り離される恐れがある。

プラボウォ氏は閣議で「ＭＳＣＩはわれわれを威嚇しようとした。ＭＳＣＩに言いたい。インドネシア国民は誰も恐れないし、屈することもない」と語った上で「われわれには力があり、勇気があり、犠牲を払う覚悟があり、決して降伏しない」と強調した。

これに対しＭＳＣＩは電子メールで、同社の判断は透明性があり、ルールに基づく手法に沿って行われているとコメントした。また「今後もインドネシア市場の動向を注視し、市場関係者や当局と対話を続ける」と付け加えた。

インドネシアの政界からもＭＳＣＩの警告に対する強い反発が相次いでいる。ルトフィ元貿易相は２０日に自身のインスタグラムで、シンガポール政府系投資会社のテマセクとＧＩＣが、ＭＳＣＩにインドネシアへの警告を出すよう圧力をかけたと主張した。ただテマセクの関係者は同発言について「全く事実に反する」と否定。ＧＩＣも同様に関与を否定したとメディアで伝えられている。

ハルタルト調整相（経済担当）は先週、ＭＳＣＩが警告発表の数日前にバンコクでインドネシア当局者と会談した際、この問題を取り上げなかったことについて「大きな疑問符が残る」と述べた。

与党有力議員のハニフ・ダキリ氏は、ＭＳＣＩの評価手法について透明性と客観性、一貫性を求めた。ロイターに「その根拠や客観性を検証せずに評価を受け入れるべきではない」などと語っている。

item.title: Kraken, Mammoth enter matchup riding hot streaks
item.description: If the Seattle Kraken have shown anything thus far this season, it's that they're surprisingly resilient.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: If the Seattle Kraken have shown anything thus far this season, it's that they're surprisingly resilient. Even after blowing a three-goal lead in the third period Tuesday night against Detroit -- allowing the tying goal with 17 seconds remaining in regulation on a turnover in front of their own net, with the Red Wings on a power play and the goalie pulled -- the Kraken came away with a 4-3 shootout victory in the opener of a four-game homestand. Seattle, 4-1-1 over its past six games, will look to continue its upward trajectory Thursday when it plays host to the equally hot Utah Mammoth, who have won four of their past five games. "We had two or three chances to make it 4-0," Kraken coach Lane Lambert said. "I thought we were on our toes (early in the third period), and then we ran into a little bit of penalty trouble, and it turned a little on a dime." Defenseman Brandon Montour, who missed Saturday's 8-3 loss at Florida with a lower-body injury, scored his first goal of the season for Seattle. Mackie Samoskevich and Ryker Evans also tallied, and goaltender Philipp Grubauer made 22 saves. "I like our attitude and how our guys pick each other up," forward Matty Beniers said. Bobby McMann scored the winner in the shootout. The Kraken improved to 2-0 in games decided by shootouts after going just 2-6 in those situations last season. "I like that we put a lot of focus on shootouts this year with (goalie coach Colin Zulianello)," Montour said. "Guys have really keyed in and (been) working on it." This will be the lone road game in a five-game stretch for the Mammoth. They beat Pittsburgh 5-4 on Monday in Salt Lake City as Clayton Keller, Nick Schmaltz, Kevin Stenlund and Nate Schmidt each recorded a goal and an assist. Kailer Yamamoto also tallied, and goaltender Sebastian Cossa made 15 saves to earn his first home win. "It was big. The guys played really well," Cossa said. "It wasn't the prettiest of games, but at the end of the day (we) got the win, so that's the most important thing." Mammoth coach Andre Tourigny said he wants to get the 23-year-old Cossa into a rhythm by providing him with consistent starts. "Like every young player who arrives in the league -- it's an expression (you've heard) before -- the game has to slow down for him," Tourigny said. "Right now, the game is probably fast for him and he gets surprised in some situations. "When we say that, that has nothing to do with your ability to play in (this) league. It's the ability to relax, slow down, be comfortable." After the game, Cossa gave Schmidt a big hug. "I think (Cossa) squeezed me pretty hard at the end of that one," Schmidt joked. "But he deserves it. I might have to get an oxygen tank." Schmidt's goal broke a 2-2 tie midway through the second period, and he assisted on Yamamoto's tally that helped the Mammoth build a three-goal lead early in the third. "I just liked our directness, especially early in the game, and especially after the goals," Schmidt said. "I just love the way that we can kind of gain that momentum back because that really does change the hockey game and change the way that your team feels when you're in a situation where you give up a goal." --Field Level Media

item.title: Coal supply to power plants to normalise soon, Indian official says
item.description: Coal supply to Indian power plants is expected to normalise soon, a senior power ministry official said on Thursday, adding that the country is supplying a record 2.6 million tons of coal to power plants every day.
item.dc:creator: Sethuraman R
item.content:encoded: Coal supply to Indian power plants is expected to normalise soon, a senior power ministry official said on Thursday, adding that the country is supplying a record 2.6 million tons of coal to power plants every day. The comments come as the number of power plants with critically low coal stocks — enough fuel to generate power for less than three days — rose to 96 as of October 19 from 60 in mid-September, according to data from the Central Electricity Authority India increased coal supply to plants, including top power generator NTPC (NTPC.NS) , after scattered rains in mining areas disrupted deliveries Reduced hydropower use is adding pressure on coal-fired plants as the El Niño weather pattern has affected rainfall, the official said Daily peak electricity demand has risen by about 45 to 50 gigawatts from a year earlier, driven by hotter weather and higher industrial production The federal power ministry has allocated additional power to Gujarat, India's top industrial state, and there is no power or coal shortage in the state, the official said Reuters [USN:L4N4670ND TEXT:"reported"] on Wednesday that Gujarat has asked factories to curb electricity use during evening hours to avoid power shortages due to surging demand Gujarat state authorities declined to comment on the report

item.title: フィリピン、台湾と海底ケーブル保護で協力強化模索
item.description:
David Brunnstrom
[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Brunnstrom

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - フィリピンのカリノ駐米次席公使は２１日、海底ケーブルの保護や「グレーゾーン」活動への対処を巡り、台湾との協力強化を模索していると述べた。フィリピンは台湾ではなく中国を承認する「一つの中国」政策を維持しているが、協力を進める方針を示した。

フィリピンと台湾は、直接的な対立を避けながら圧力をかける中国の活動に繰り返し不満を表明してきた。中国は台湾を自国領と主張しており、南シナ海では台湾、フィリピンの双方と領有権の主張が重複している。

カリノ氏はワシントンのシンクタンク、新米国安全保障センターのセミナーで、台湾とフィリピンの間にあるバシー海峡で共通の利益を守るため、台湾とのこうした「現実的かつ実務的なアプローチ」が必要だと述べた。

カリノ氏は海底ケーブルの安全確保と南シナ海の緊張を関連付けたが、中国を名指しすることはなかった。

同氏は、大陸間のデータ通信のほぼ全てが海底ケーブルを経由していることに加え、「サイバー事案の６０─６７％がわれわれの地域で発生している」ことから、海底ケーブルの安全確保は極めて重要だと指摘した。

「海底ケーブルは保護すべき極めて重要なインフラであり、それゆえ台湾の友人との協力強化を模索している」と述べ、「一つの中国」政策を維持しながらも、こうした取り組みを進めていると説明した。

フィリピンと台湾は「知識の共有や能力構築を含む、実務的でより現実的な協力の進め方」を模索しているとし、「この協力は、われわれの地域におけるグレーゾーンの問題への対処につながると考えている」と語った。

共同巡視や、通信を妨害した船舶の責任追及も協力に含まれ得るかとの質問には、詳細は把握していないとした上で、「この協力は絶えず発展していると確信しており、今挙げられた取り組みの一部は実際に実現しつつあるかもしれない」と述べた。

台湾当局は、中国と関係する船舶が絡む海底ケーブルの事案が相次いだことを受け、台湾と世界を結ぶ上で不可欠な海底通信回線の保護を強化している。

フィリピン沿岸警備隊は今月、北部バタネス州沖の海底ケーブル敷設ルート付近で活動していた中国の調査船に対処するため、保有する最大の船舶と航空機１機を派遣したと発表した。

同じセミナーに出席した台湾の楊懿珊駐米副代表は、海底ケーブルを損傷させた中国人船長が台湾で収監された件に言及。台湾は海洋監視を強化するため、無人システムの開発に一段と資源を投入すると述べた。

楊氏は、海底ケーブルへの妨害は国連で取り上げるべき問題であり、国連は「不適切な行動」を防ぐ仕組みを検討すべきだと述べた。

item.title: マレーシア、公務員の「ウェイズ」利用禁止 イスラエル発地図アプリ
item.description: [クアラルンプール ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[クアラルンプール ２１日 ロイター] - マレーシア政府は２１日、米グーグル傘下のナビゲーションアプリ「Ｗａｚｅ（ウェイズ）」について、イスラエル発祥のサービスである点と関連した安全保障上の懸念を理由に、公務員による利用を禁止したことを明らかにした。

イスラム教徒が多数を占めるマレーシアはパレスチナ支援の立場を取っており、イスラエルとは外交関係を持っていない。

アンワル首相は、公務員によるウェイズ利用禁止を指示。首相府は声明で、禁止の理由について「イスラエル政権による不正利用の脅威から政府情報および利用者の個人データを保護するため」と説明した。

グーグルおよびシンガポールにあるイスラエル大使館は、ロイターのコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

アンワル氏は前日のフェイスブックへの投稿で、ウェイズが「イスラエルの法律に拘束されている」と指摘し、同アプリの利用に伴う潜在的な安全保障リスクを政府が調査していると説明している。代替手段として、マレーシア高速道路庁が開発した国産地図アプリ「ＴｕＪｕ」の利用を推奨した。

利用禁止は全ての公務員が対象。ロイターが確認した２０日付の書簡によると、この措置はアンワル氏が議長を務めた会議での決定を受けたもので、即時実施される。

首相府当局者も、同書簡が本物であることを認めた。

ウェイズはイスラエルで設立された企業が開発したアプリで、衛星測位信号や利用者から提供される走行データを活用し、リアルタイムの交通情報を提供している。２０１３年にアルファベット子会社グーグルが買収した。

item.title: Meta-Émission de nouvelles actions, prévisions supérieures aux attentes au T4
item.description: Meta a dit mercredi prévoir pour le trimestre actuel un chiffre d'affaires supérieur aux attentes et a annoncé son intention d'émettre de nouvelles actions sans droit de vote, une mesure qui devrait contribuer à financer son expansion coûteuse dans le domaine de l'intelligence artificielle (IA).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta (META.O) a dit mercredi prévoir pour le trimestre actuel un chiffre d'affaires supérieur aux attentes et a annoncé son intention d'émettre de nouvelles actions sans droit de vote, une mesure qui devrait contribuer à financer son expansion coûteuse dans le domaine de l'intelligence artificielle (IA). Le géant technologique a également relevé le bas de la fourchette de ses prévisions de dépenses cette année. Dans les échanges boursiers d'après-clôture, le titre du groupe dirigé par Mark Zuckerberg progressait de plus de 4%. Meta a investi massivement dans les puces de pointe et les centres de données afin de concurrencer davantage OpenAI et Anthropic, ce qui a allégé son flux de trésorerie disponible, historiquement solide. La maison-mère des réseaux sociaux Facebook et Instagram émettra en janvier prochain une nouvelle catégorie d'actions ordinaires de classe C sans droit de vote, ce qui se traduira concrètement par un fractionnement de deux pour un, afin de financer des acquisitions et de conserver les talents tout en préservant le contrôle de Mark Zuckerberg, dans un contexte de course à l'IA qui s'intensifie dans la Silicon Valley. Pour l'année 2026, Meta dit désormais anticiper des dépenses d'investissement comprises entre 135 milliards et 145 milliards de dollars, contre une fourchette de 130 milliards à 145 milliards de dollars auparavant. Le groupe prévoit au quatrième trimestre un chiffre d'affaires compris entre 73 milliards et 76 milliards de dollars, alors que les analystes anticipaient en moyenne un montant de 73,73 milliards de dollars. Au troisième trimestre, il a publié un chiffre d'affaires de 64,60 milliards de dollars, battant le consensus qui ressortait à 63,37 milliards de dollars selon des données LSEG. Meta a enregistré sur la période juillet-septembre un déficit de flux de trésorerie disponible de 2,12 milliards de dollars, contre un flux de trésorerie disponible positif de 10,63 milliards de dollars un an plus tôt. "Nos investissements portent leurs fruits, notre cœur de métier est solide et nous constatons une dynamique positive à tous les niveaux", a déclaré Mark Zuckerberg dans un communiqué. Le succès rapide de son agent IA destiné au grand public, Muse, et le lancement d’une nouvelle gamme compétitive de modèles d’IA ont aidé Meta à justifier ces dépenses auprès des investisseurs, même si certaines entreprises restreignent l'accès de Muse à leurs sites pour des raisons de sécurité. Par ailleurs, les procédures judiciaires à l'encontre du groupe se multiplient. Meta communiquait ses résultats après qu'un juge du Nouveau-Mexique lui a ordonné plus tôt dans la journée de verser 25 milliards de dollars de pénalités pour avoir induit en erreur des utilisateurs de Facebook à propos de la protection de leurs données privées. En août dernier, Meta a conclu un accord à l'amiable dans le cadre duquel il est convenu de verser quelque 18 milliards de dollars sur une période de dix ans et de restreindre l'utilisation de ses réseaux sociaux par les adolescents à la suite d'une plainte déposée par la plupart des Etats américains. Le bénéfice dilué par action de Meta s'est établi au troisième trimestre à 3,83 dollars au cours du trimestre, un montant qui aurait atteint 7,40 dollars sans une charge de 9,89 milliards de dollars liée à cet accord.

item.title: 中国ディープシーク、150億ドル調達完了へ ＡＩ競争に弾み
item.description:
Kane Wu
[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 中国の人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業ディープシークが、既存および新規の投資...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国ディープシーク、150億ドル調達完了へ　ＡＩ競争に弾み 13:44 配信

ディープシークのロゴ。10月19日に撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Kane Wu

[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 中国の人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業ディープシークが、既存および新規の投資家から約１０００億元（１４９億８０００万ドル）を集め、最新の資金調達ラウンドを完了しつつあることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が２２日、明らかにした。

関係者によると、中国の車載電池大手、寧徳時代新能源科技（ＣＡＴＬ）と、通信アプリの微信（ウィーチャット）を運営する騰訊控股（テンセント・ホールディングス）が主要な出資者に名を連ねた。

資金調達は数日中に完了する見通し。ただ、金額などの詳細は確定しておらず、変わる可能性がある。

ディープシーク、ＣＡＴＬ、テンセントからのコメントは直ちに得られなかった。

ブルームバーグは２２日、関係筋の話として、ディープシークがＣＡＴＬとテンセントを主な出資者とする最新の資金調達ラウンドで１５０億ドルを集めたと最初に報じた。

ディープシークは当初の調達目標額だった５００億元の２倍を集めることになる。中国が米国とのＡＩ競争で優位に立つことを目指す中、政府や大企業の支援を受ける投資家を中心に、強い関心が寄せられていることを示している。

今回の資金調達は、ディープシークが株式公開による資金調達に近づいていることも示している。ロイターは９月、同社が上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向け、中信証券を起用したと報じた。

同社は９月、最新モデル「ＤｅｅｐＳｅｅｋ─Ｖ４．１─Ｆｌａｓｈ」を公開した。能力の向上、推論の高速化、処理量の拡大、より大規模なモデルへの拡張を目指した設計だとしている。

item.title: USA-Des chaînes de télévision accusées de relayer de "faux sondages" avant les 'midterms'
item.description: Le patron de la Commission fédérale des communications (FCC), chargée notamment d'attribuer et superviser les licences accordées aux chaînes de télévision aux Etats-Unis, a déclaré mercredi que des chaînes diffusaient "des sondages totalement faux", constituant une possible violation de leurs obligations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le patron de la Commission fédérale des communications (FCC), chargée notamment d'attribuer et superviser les licences accordées aux chaînes de télévision aux Etats-Unis, a déclaré mercredi que des chaînes diffusaient "des sondages totalement faux", constituant une possible violation de leurs obligations. Via le réseau social X, Brendan Carr a déclaré qu'il y avait en amont des élections de mi-mandat au Congrès américain ("[USN:L8N4560J1 TEXT:"midterms"]"), le 3 novembre, une multiplication de sondages "destinés seulement à interférer dans le fonctionnement régulier du processus électoral et à altérer les schémas normaux de participation et d'enthousiasme des électeurs". Brendan Carr, nommé à la tête de la FCC par le président Donald Trump, n'a fourni aucune preuve de ses dires ni de précisions sur les enquêtes d'opinion concernées. Aucun commentaire n'a été obtenu dans l'immédiat auprès des chaînes de télévision NBC, détenue par Comcast (CMCSA.O) , CBS, propriété de Skydance (SKYD.N) , ABC et Fox News (FOXA.O) . La FCC n'a pas répondu pour l'heure à une demande de commentaire. Depuis son retour à la Maison blanche en janvier 2025, Donald Trump s'est servi de son pouvoir exécutif et de procédures en justice pour punir les commentaires dans les médias peu flatteurs à son égard, les qualifiant de diffamatoires ou d'erronés. Plusieurs chaînes de télévision se sont vu retirer le mois dernier leur [USN:L8N45G19L TEXT:"accès à la Maison blanche"], avant qu'une décision de justice ne suspende la mesure prise par la présidence américaine. Donald Trump a appelé l'an dernier à [USN:L5N3V51PG TEXT:"retirer la licence"] de diffusion des chaînes de télévision américaines qui effectuaient une couverture médiatique jugée "négative" de son administration. Les lois fédérales interdisent à la FCC de retirer une licence en raison de commentaires qui déplaisent au gouvernement. Un sondage publié plus tôt cette semaine par Reuters montre que la cote de popularité de Donald Trump a chuté à un plus bas inédit au cours de ses mandats présidentiels, avec 31% des Américains interrogés disant approuver sa politique. Le président républicain ne cesse de rejeter les enquêtes d'opinion le concernant, de même que les sondages indiquant que les démocrates devancent nettement les républicains dans les intentions de vote pour les élections au Congrès. "Je pense que ce sont de faux sondages. Les sondages signifient quelque chose, mais beaucoup d'entre eux sont truqués", a dit lundi Donald Trump, qui a toujours refusé de reconnaître sa défaite lors de l'élection présidentielle de 2020 et jette régulièrement un doute sur l'équité des 'midterms' du mois prochain. En avril dernier, Brendan Carr a pris la décision sans précédent d'ordonner un examen des licences de huit chaînes locales d'ABC, détenue par Disney (DIS.N) , alors que le réseau télévisé s'est retrouvé dans le collimateur de l'administration Trump en raison de propos de Jimmy Kimmel, animateur vedette du 'late show' éponyme.

item.title: 米ダナハー、ＡＩ創薬分野で主導的立場へ＝ＣＥＯ
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] - 米ライフサイエンス大手ダナハーのジュリー・モンゴメリー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２１日、製薬...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ダナハー、ＡＩ創薬分野で主導的立場へ＝ＣＥＯ 13:41 配信

[２１日 ロイター] - 米ライフサイエンス大手ダナハーのジュリー・モンゴメリー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２１日、製薬各社が新薬開発に人工知能（ＡＩ）の導入を進める中で、同社が恩恵を受ける好位置にあるとの見方を示した。

企業が標的とする薬剤の特定、分子の設計、研究の効率化のために機械学習モデルを活用するのに伴い、ＡＩを活用した創薬への関心は急増している。ＡＩ技術は開発期間の短縮や研究生産性の向上につながると広く期待されている。

モンゴメリー氏は決算発表後の電話会議で「ＡＩを活用した創薬を当社にとっての重要な長期的な機会ととらえている。ダナハーはこの市場を形作る上で独自の立場にあると考えている。率直に言って、当社は必要な構成要素を全て備えているからだ」と述べた。

ダナハーは、保有する広範な計測機器、分子デバイス、技術のポートフォリオが新興のＡＩを活用した創薬市場において競争上の優位性をもたらす可能性があるとし、全社的にＡＩの導入を加速させ、ＡＩ関連の提携関係を構築していると説明した。

モンゴメリー氏は「当社には先端ＡＩ開発企業から優先パートナーとして選ばれるだけの事業規模がある。現時点では業績面で財務的に重要性をもたらす段階には至っていないものの、受注や売上高にはすでに緩やかな恩恵が出始めている。事実、ライフサイエンス分野の顧客との会話では常に最前線の話題になっている」とし、顧客がＡＩを導入する中で同社が主導的なパートナーとなることを目指していると訴えた。

item.title: Iran's IRGC Navy says seven vessels hit, warns US of wider response
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy said on Thursday that four vessels involved in illegal oil transfers in the northern Persian Gulf were simultaneously hit and caught fire after being tracked by its forces on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy said on Thursday that four vessels involved in illegal oil transfers in the northern Persian Gulf were simultaneously hit and caught fire after being tracked by its forces on Wednesday. The IRGC added that three more vessels collided with mines west of the Strait of Hormuz, and warned the US military that continued provocations could lead to a wider response against its regional bases.

item.title: 米政権、緊急暖房油備蓄の3割強を貸与へ 価格抑制狙い
item.description:
Timothy Gardner
[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timothy Gardner

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米エネルギー省は２１日、急騰しているヒーティングオイル（暖房油）価格の抑制を目指し、１００万バレル規模の緊急暖房油備蓄の最大約３分の１を貸し出す方針を発表した。

同省は、北東部メーン、マサチューセッツ、コネティカットの各州にある暖房油備蓄から最大３１万５０００バレルを貸し出すと説明した。受け渡しは１１月１３日までに完了する予定。

この措置は、与野党の上院議員らが政府に対し備蓄から暖房油を放出するよう求めていたことを受けた動きだ。

暖房油は軽油（ディーゼル燃料）と成分が類似している。軽油価格は、イラン戦争による中東地域での混乱を背景に１ガロン当たり６．５０ドルを超える過去最高水準に達している。

エネルギー省の関係者によると、政権はさらなる備蓄放出が必要かどうかについても検証する方針だ。

米国が北東部家庭用暖房油備蓄を活用したのは、２０１２年にハリケーン「サンディ」が同地域に襲来して以来一度しかない。この緊急備蓄はニュージャージー、コネティカット、マサチューセッツ、メーン各州の施設に保管されている。

ニューイングランド地域では住宅の約３分の１が暖房油を使用しており、メーン州ではその割合が約半分に達する。

暖房油価格の高騰は、１１月３日の中間選挙を前に重要な争点として浮上している。トランプ大統領率いる共和党は連邦議会上下両院での多数派維持を目指しており、接戦となっている複数の上院選挙区にも暖房油の高騰が影響を及ぼしている。

共和党のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員（メーン州選出）は再選へ向け厳しい選挙戦に直面しているほか、ニューハンプシャー州の上院議席を巡っては、民主党のクリス・パパス氏と共和党のジョン・スヌヌ氏が互角の戦いを展開中だ。

ライト米エネルギー長官は「エネルギーコストを引き下げるために、あらゆる措置を講じる」と表明した。エネルギー省によると、燃料小売業者や石油ターミナル運営会社を対象に競争入札を実施し、燃料不足に直面する地域へ供給を行う。

一方、アナリストらはこの措置に懐疑的だ。ガルフ・オイルの首席エネルギー顧問トム・クロザ氏はＸに、この措置について「不可解であり、恐らく効果は限定的だ」と投稿し、価格への影響はないとの見方を示した。

item.title: USA-Meta condamné à verser $25 mds pour manquements à la protection de données lors de la présidentielle 2016
item.description: Un tribunal du Nouveau-Mexique a ordonné mercredi à Meta de verser 25 milliards de dollars de pénalités pour manquements à la protection de la vie privée, après qu'un jury a déclaré coupable en septembre le géant technologique d'avoir induit en erreur les consommateurs à propos de leurs données.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un tribunal du Nouveau-Mexique a ordonné mercredi à Meta (META.O) de verser 25 milliards de dollars de pénalités pour manquements à la protection de la vie privée, après qu'un jury a déclaré coupable en septembre le géant technologique d'avoir induit en erreur les consommateurs à propos de leurs données. Cette affaire est née d'accusations selon lesquelles une firme de conseil politique impliquée dans la campagne de Donald Trump pour l'élection présidentielle américaine de 2016 a obtenu les données de millions d'utilisateurs de Facebook, propriété de Meta, sans leur accord. Un porte-parole de Meta n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire. Le procureur général du Nouveau-Mexique avait engagé en 2021 une procédure judiciaire contre Meta à la suite de révélations selon lesquelles la firme britannique Cambridge Analytica avait récolté les données personnelles de quelque 87 millions d'utilisateurs de Facebook via des applications tierces. Meta a été accusé par le Nouveau-Mexique d'avoir menti aux utilisateurs de Facebook dans cet Etat à propos de l'accès à leurs données personnelles ainsi que de la lutte contre les discours haineux et la désinformation sur la plateforme. D'après la plainte, le groupe dirigé par Mark Zuckerberg savait que de tierces parties avaient un vaste accès aux données personnelles des utilisateurs et tolérait également les contenus haineux ou nocifs lorsque cela profitait aux revenus du groupe. Le 25 septembre, un jury a déclaré que Meta a enfreint les lois de protection des consommateurs du Nouveau-Mexique plus de 43 millions de fois, sur la base du nombre d'utilisateurs de Facebook dans l'Etat.

item.title: Review finds KPMG Australia mishandled whistleblower claims, pause on government work extended
item.description: A probe into KPMG Australia has found it mishandled whistleblower allegations of client data leaks and let cultural and governance weaknesses persist for years, but stopped short of recommending a permanent ban on the firm from federal government work.
item.dc:creator: Christine Chen
item.content:encoded: A probe into KPMG Australia has found it mishandled whistleblower allegations of client data leaks and let cultural and governance weaknesses persist for years, but stopped short of recommending a permanent ban on the firm from federal government work. The Department of Finance, which commissioned the review by former bureaucrat Ian Watt, said KPMG has instead agreed to not bid for new federal work until February next year while the firm undertakes further governance reforms, [USN:L1N42N06L TEXT:"extending a pause"] in place since June. "The review considers that KPMG should not be treated as permanently unsuitable for Commonwealth work, but nor should confidence be restored on the strength of assurances and encouraging early signs alone," it said. The review was launched to probe KPMG's governance, culture and ethics following a whistleblower's allegations that staff [USN:L1N44B005 TEXT:"misused confidential information"] to bid for new audit contracts. "KPMG mishandled the whistleblower matter. Its response was misguided, fragmented, prolonged and, at critical points, lacked clear ownership," the report released on Thursday said. KPMG did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The report said despite the whistleblower raising concerns of unethical conduct arising from commercial pressure and a fear of retaliation, KPMG primarily treated it as an "employment matter" and was more focused on the legal implications and organisational risks, paying inadequate attention to whether the allegations might be accurate. "These shortcomings significantly damaged the whistleblower's confidence in KPMG's handling of the claims. It also damaged client and public confidence and KPMG's credibility," it said. KPMG's mishandling of the whistleblower's complaint also reflected broader weaknesses in its culture and governance, which have persisted for years at the firm. The report said that by 2020, KPMG had already identified issues around "the primacy of financial returns, inconsistent ethical leadership, reluctance to challenge senior personnel, barriers to reporting misconduct and weaknesses in ethical decision-making". But there was little evidence the firm adequately addressed them, it found. It recommended the government should not allow KPMG to bid for new contracts again until it independently verified it was implementing reforms and that they were "changing behaviour in practice". Federal government work made up A$207.1 million, or 9.5%, of KPMG's revenue in the 2026 financial year, the report said. Since the scandal became public in March, KPMG has lost major blue-chip clients and [USN:L1N42600F TEXT:"replaced key leaders"], including its CEO, chairman and audit chief.

item.title: ユナイテッド航空ＣＥＯ、燃料高止まり予想 利益率目標達成に課題
item.description:
Rajesh Kumar Singh Shivansh Tiwary
[シカゴ ２１日 ロイター] - 米ユナイテッド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユナイテッド航空ＣＥＯ、燃料高止まり予想　利益率目標達成に課題 13:34 配信

ユナイテッド航空機。　米フロリダ州のフォートローダーデール・ハリウッド国際空港で4月撮影。REUTERS/Marco Bello

Rajesh Kumar Singh　Shivansh Tiwary

[シカゴ ２１日 ロイター] - 米ユナイテッド航空のスコット・カービー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２１日、燃料価格の高止まりが２０２７年を通じて続くとの見通しを示した。

カービー氏は、同社が掲げる来年の２桁の税引き前利益率目標を達成するには、燃料価格の低下や業界全体の供給能力の伸び鈍化か、搭乗率の向上よりも運賃引き上げを各社が優先し続けることが不可欠になると述べた。

ユナイテッド航空は前日、第４・四半期利益見通しとして市場予想を大幅に下回る水準を示した。同社は運賃が大幅に上昇しているにもかかわらず、収益面で燃料コスト上昇をなお十分に吸収できていない。第３・四半期において、追加的な燃料コストのうち収益増加で回収できた割合は７２％にとどまった。

カービー氏は決算説明会で、業界全体の供給能力は来年さらに拡大する見通しだと発言した。座席供給の増加は航空会社の価格決定力を弱め、燃料コスト増を補うための十分な運賃引き上げが難しくなりかねない。

ユナイテッド航空は第４・四半期の航空燃料価格を１ガロン当たり４．８０ドルと見込んでいる。業界団体エアラインズ・フォー・アメリカによると、米国の航空燃料スポット価格は２０日時点で１ガロン当たり４．７７ドルだった。

マイク・レスキネン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、第４・四半期も第３・四半期と同程度の割合で燃料コスト増を回収すると予想していると述べており、従来想定していた全額回収には届かない形になる。

ユナイテッド航空は２０２７年に追加燃料コストを収益増加によって完全に回収することを目指しているが、経営陣は燃料価格上昇に対して運賃値上げが追いつくまでには時間がかかると認めている。

カービー氏は、製品や技術への投資によって来年の収益拡大が期待できるとしながらも、それだけでは２桁の税引き前利益率達成には十分ではないだろうと予想した。

ユナイテッド航空は、全ての路線と市場における供給能力を精査しており、２７年の運航計画についても柔軟に対応する方針を打ち出した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める アングル：世界の航空運賃高止まりか、燃料費負担軽減でも乗客に恩恵届かず アングル：航空会社の機内Ｗｉ―Ｆｉ競争過熱、スターリンクとアマゾンが主導権争い アングル：ユナイテッド航空のアメリカン合併案、反トラスト法懸念で懐疑論 焦点：米航空会社、感謝祭目前で政府閉鎖の影響に苦慮 最終更新: 10/22(木) 13:34 ロイター

item.title: Morning Bid: France's debt strains, AI in focus
item.description: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Jiaxing Li.
item.dc:creator: Jiaxing Li
item.content:encoded: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Jiaxing Li. French bonds remain in hot water. After the benchmark 10-year yield topped 5% for the first time since 2002, it has continued to creep higher as investors assess France's ability to restore its fragile finances. With more protests planned in the coming days, President Emmanuel Macron pledged on Wednesday to prevent a repeat of violence. However, limited progress in addressing the political chaos has left investors on edge, fearing prolonged unrest could complicate government efforts to rein in spending at a time of mounting budget pressures. Investors will be keeping a close eye on Moody's, which is due to review France's Aa3 sovereign rating on October 23. The ratings agency has a negative outlook on the country, meaning the next move is more likely to be a downgrade than an upgrade, which could add to pressure on French borrowing costs. The euro, however, has largely steadied after a month-long slide even with fiscal concerns in France and Europe's energy fragility attracting short sellers, as it has emerged as a favoured channel for bets on a stronger dollar. Elsewhere, earnings from Wall Street's tech giants boosted the tech-heavy Nasdaq and led Wall Street to a higher close. But while better-than-expected earnings, including SpaceX reporting its first profit as a public company, eased some concerns over the sustainability and profitability of massive AI build-outs, the mood in Asian markets remained cautious. In early European trades, the pan-region Euro Stoxx 50 futures were down 0.7% at 6,175. US stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis , were down 0.63% at 7,751.3. Key developments that could influence markets on Thursday: - Barclays (BARC.L) Q3 earnings - Lockheed Martin , Blackstone , and Dow Q3 earnings

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street grimpe, aidée par l'appétit pour l'IA
item.description: La Bourse de New York a fini en hausse mercredi, après la publication des résultats trimestriels de SpaceX et de Super Micro Computer, qui ont redynamisé l'appétit des investisseurs pour les titres liés à l'intelligence artificielle (IA), au lendemain de pertes enregistrées par le secteur technologique.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a fini en hausse mercredi, après la publication des résultats trimestriels de SpaceX et de Super Micro Computer, qui ont redynamisé l'appétit des investisseurs pour les titres liés à l'intelligence artificielle (IA), au lendemain de pertes enregistrées par le secteur technologique. L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a gagné 0,69%, ou 360,21 points, à 52.856,09 points. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a pris 44,60 points, soit 0,58%, à 7.757,17 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a avancé de son côté de 278,04 points (1,05%) à 26.702,86 points. Après la publication mardi soir de ses résultats du troisième trimestre, SpaceX (SPCX.O) a pris 7,8% pour avoir communiqué son premier bénéfice en tant qu'entreprise publique. Son propriétaire, Elon Musk, a déclaré mercredi qu'une fusion avec l'une de ses autres firmes, le constructeur automobile Tesla (TSLA.O) , serait une "bonne idée". Pour sa part, Super Micro (SMCI.O) a réalisé l'une des meilleures performances du jour sur le S&P-500, bondissant de 9,6%, après avoir dit prévoir un chiffre d'affaires et un bénéfice supérieurs aux attentes pour le trimestre actuel, citant une demande solide pour l'IA. Cela a profité à d'autres titres du secteur et semblé apaiser les craintes des investisseurs à propos des dépenses massives dans les infrastructures d'IA et de la pérennité de ces investissements. La "tech" avait enregistré la semaine dernière un repli provoqué par un retrait des valeurs liées à l'IA au profit de secteurs plus défensifs. Les résultats communiqués par SpaceX "repoussent en partie les craintes des investisseurs" à propos de l'IA, a commenté Angelo Kourkafas, stratégiste senior chez Edward Jones. Il a toutefois ajouté que cela "ne répondra pas à toutes les questions sur les retours sur investissement pour l'IA, mais c'est un bon début". Meta (META.O) et Tesla publiaient après la clôture leurs résultats trimestriels, très attendus. Parmi les secteurs majeurs du S&P-500, les technologies de l'information (.SPLRCT) ont connu mercredi la plus forte hausse, prenant 1,6%. A l'inverse, les services de communication (.SPLRCL) ont décliné de 1,3%, en raison des pertes d'AT&T (T.N) , qui a pourtant communiqué des résultats trimestriels supérieurs aux attentes, et de Netflix (NFLX.O) qui a cédé 5,3% après avoir dit anticiper un bénéfice au quatrième trimestre inférieur au consensus. item.title: Ukraine to be able to buy military supplies via NATO agency, FT reports
item.description: NATO will allow Ukraine to buy weapons, ammunition and military equipment via its centralised procurement agency, potentially allowing Kyiv to obtain defence supplies faster and more cheaply, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NATO will allow Ukraine to buy weapons, ammunition and military equipment via its centralised procurement agency, potentially allowing Kyiv to obtain defence supplies faster and more cheaply, the Financial Times reported on Thursday. "It provides Ukraine with the ability to have a more structured framework to leverage a broad range of capabilities that we offer: procurement expertise, support services and access to established industrial base," the NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA) director of support to operations, Jacqueline Borsboom, told the FT. The deal comes amid worsening US-Ukraine relations since US President Donald Trump announced a diesel export deal with Russia this month to lower US fuel prices. Ukraine has complained of disruption to some intelligence sharing and its use of the Starshield satellite system, though Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said a meeting in Oslo on Tuesday had agreed to resolve those issues.

item.title: トルコ、サウジへの軍要員派遣承認案を議会に提出へ＝与党議員
item.description: [アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] - トルコは、サウジアラビアおよびパキスタンとの共同防衛協定に基づき、サウジへの軍要員派遣を可能にする議案を議会に提出する。与党・公正発展党（ＡＫＰ）の議員が２１日、匿名を条件にロイターに語った。

軍要員派遣の承認案は協定の批准法案が可決され次第、議会に送付されるという。

トルコは２０日、３カ国が８月に署名した「メッカ共同防衛協定」を批准に向けて議会に提出した。これにより、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）で軍の規模が２番目に大きいトルコは、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃を受けるサウジとの正式な相互防衛の約束に一歩近づいた。

同議員は、協定に基づき他国に派遣されるトルコ軍部隊が攻撃作戦に参加することはないと説明。当初は技術要員や専門家を派遣し、防空や電子戦技術、その他の防衛支援に当たるとした。

これに先立ち、２人の当局者はロイターに対し、トルコの貢献は軍事装備、情報共有、兵器システムに限られる見通しだとし、同盟の枠組みでは、これまでそれ以外の形での派遣・配備は行われていないと述べていた。

フーシ派の攻撃を非難しているトルコは、紅海での航行の安全を確保するため、サウジ主導の有志連合に参加することにも合意している。

item.title: Nuggets bring revamped bench into tricky opener against Thunder
item.description: With a new-look bench unit, the Denver Nuggets open the season Thursday night on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: With a new-look bench unit, the Denver Nuggets open the season Thursday night on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder. "We've had a lot of classic games with them over the years," Nuggets coach David Adelman said. "Have tons of respect for them, the team, the coaching staff. So yeah, we know what kind of high-level game it's going to be, obviously." Denver dealt away Peyton Watson in a sign-and-trade, lost Tim Hardaway Jr. to free agency and signed DeMar DeRozan and Marvin Bagley III in their major offseason moves. Still, the Nuggets have high expectations, though those aren't necessarily to compete at the top of the Western Conference with the Thunder and the San Antonio Spurs -- during the regular season at least. "If you don't have those expectations, this league is daunting," Adelman said. "I've been on the other side of this. Our expectation is to get in the top six. You're in the top six in the West, you can win the West. I'd love to be one." While Denver's bench will look significantly different from last year's team that fell in the opening round of the playoffs to the Minnesota Timberwolves, or the 2024-25 team that lost in the second round to Oklahoma City, the starting core is the same with Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray and Aaron Gordon leading the way. In recent seasons, Luguentz Dort often defended Murray for Oklahoma City. However, with Dort having been traded to the Atlanta Hawks in the offseason, the Thunder's defensive approach to Murray will be much different. "I'll be interested to see how they match up with him," Adelman said. "Lu Dort's not there anymore. Obviously they have a lot of very, very capable defenders, so I'm interested to see how they see us." While it will be the season opener for the Nuggets, the Thunder have already played, opening their season with a 116-104 win at San Antonio on Tuesday in a rematch of last season's Western Conference finals. That game was particularly notable for Chet Holmgren, who struggled against the Spurs in last season's playoff series but had 14 points, seven rebounds and four blocked shots on Tuesday as Oklahoma City held Victor Wembanyama to 12 points on 1-of-13 shooting. "Chet is an All-NBA talent on both ends of the floor," Thunder star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander said. "When he's himself, your team is better. It's as simple as that. When he's aggressive, when he's confident, when he's out there playing his game, he makes your basketball team better. ... "The box score doesn't show everything he does out there. He changes everything for us." Against Jokic and the Nuggets, he figures to need another strong game if Oklahoma City is to win its home opener. Holmgren said he didn't just blindly react to last season's struggles against Wembanyama and the Spurs as he looked to make improvements ahead of this season. "Emotions don't really help you," Holmgren said. "You have to be able to look at things objectively and look at the facts, and that's what tells you where and how you can improve. That's the first thing I tried to (do), just remove emotions from it and then look at the tangible things." The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series with the Nuggets 3-1. --Field Level Media

item.title: Saka injury doesn't look good, says Arsenal manager Arteta
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he is worried about the severity of Bukayo Saka's quadriceps injury after the winger left the pitch in the 10th minute of Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he is worried about the severity of Bukayo Saka's quadriceps injury after the winger left the pitch in the 10th minute of Wednesday's [USN:L6N46719Q TEXT:"2-2 Champions League draw"] at Bayern Munich. The 25-year-old clutched his left thigh after falling while attempting a pass and was replaced by Eberechi Eze. "When a player has to come off with sharp pain it is never good news. We have to wait and see," Arteta told TNT Sports. "He doesn't look good at all, but we'll have to wait and see." Saka missed seven games last season with an Achilles problem and had hamstring surgery in December 2024 which sidelined him for more than three months. Arsenal can ill afford to lose another winger after Christos Tzolis picked up a hamstring injury on international duty.

item.title: Musk’s public endorsement of SpaceX-Tesla deal may throw a wrench in talks
item.description: Some insiders involved in the discussions worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk's [USN:L4N4661IU TEXT:"public endorsement"] this week of a potential $3.5 trillion merger between SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) has rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, according to a person with direct knowledge of the talks. The disclosure created a "mess" for the process, as it could lead to questions about how well Tesla shareholders' interests would be represented, the person said. The concerns reflect similarities some participants see with Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, which sparked years of litigation over Musk's role in the deal. Musk, who serves as CEO of both SpaceX and Tesla and owns significant stakes in each company, this week told investors that the two companies were examining what would be the largest corporate transaction in history and revealed that both had formed special committees to evaluate it. The backlash to those remarks is reported here for the first time. The parties have hired advisers, but discussions are at an early stage, three sources familiar with the matter said. SpaceX approached Tesla in recent weeks, and the companies have been discussing a range of transaction structures, including a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a merger under a newly formed holding company, the person familiar with the matter said. They are weighing different forms of merger consideration, including an all-stock deal, the person said. These details of the talks have not been previously reported. Tesla, SpaceX and Musk did not respond to requests for comment. SHAREHOLDER LITIGATION OVER TESLA'S SOLARCITY DEAL In related-party transactions such as a SpaceX-Tesla merger, independent board members typically oversee the process to safeguard public shareholders' interests. That issue loomed large in Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, which triggered [USN:L1N36V3J9 TEXT:"years of litigation"] after shareholders alleged the world's richest man had influenced the process to bail out his investment in the struggling rooftop solar company. At the time, Musk owned roughly 22% of both Tesla and SolarCity, which was founded by his cousins. Shareholders argued that Musk's involvement and public support undermined the deal's fairness. Central to the case were [USN:L2N2OL1K9 TEXT:"claims that despite his minority stake"], Musk was a controlling shareholder of Tesla due to his ties to board members and domineering style. The Delaware Supreme Court later noted that plaintiffs' contention of the absence of an independent committee, together with "certain other facts concerning Musk's involvement in and public support for the transaction," warranted the finding of unfair dealing. The courts ultimately upheld the acquisition as fair, though it took several years for the case to be resolved and Tesla directors settled allegations for $60 million. MUSK CANNOT BE INVOLVED IN TALKS Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and just under half of SpaceX, and analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity. On Tuesday's call with investors, Musk acknowledged that as a conflicted party he cannot be part of the discussions of the special committees. Advisers are also in contact with his lawyers to ensure Musk is recused from the merger discussions, the source familiar with the talks said. Eric Talley, a law professor at Columbia University, said a merger could benefit shareholders by eliminating the need for Musk to divide his time between the two companies. He added that any legal challenge may be harder to predict than the SolarCity case because Tesla is now incorporated in Texas rather than Delaware. “The Texas thing is a wild card. No one knows how Texas deals with cases like this because Texas never dealt with cases like this,” Talley said, noting that Texas has sought to establish itself as a business-friendly alternative to Delaware, and Musk’s comments so far were not necessarily problematic. Ultimately, he said, litigation risk would hinge on the terms of any transaction. "Who's going to get the better side of this deal? And that's usually what gives rise to litigation," Talley said. MUSK'S COMMENTS COULD AFFECT DISCUSSIONS People involved in the process worry Musk's public endorsement of the merger and disclosure of talks could intensify investor scrutiny, as interested parties typically avoid expressing views publicly while independent directors evaluate a deal, the source said. The SolarCity case could become a reference point for investors and courts assessing any future SpaceX-Tesla transaction if advisers fail to fully insulate the special committees from Musk's influence, the source added. A tie-up between Tesla and SpaceX would be the biggest deal in history, creating one of the world's largest industrial and technology groups. It would surpass Musk's acquisition earlier this year of his artificial intelligence company xAI by SpaceX, which ranks among the largest corporate transactions ever announced. A deal of this size would also face scrutiny from global regulators, especially due to Tesla’s business in China and SpaceX’s work in US defense and AI.

item.title: ロシアとウクライナ、攻撃応酬続く 米特使は和平仲介
item.description: ［キーウ ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［キーウ　２２日　ロイター］ - ウクライナの首都キーウで２２日未明、ミサイルが着弾した。ロイター記者が明らかにした。一方、ウクライナは夜間に数百機のドローン（無人機）をロシアの首都モスクワに向けて発射した。戦争終結に向けた米国の仲介にもかかわらず、両国は激しい攻撃を続けている。

キーウ当局によると、ロシアの攻撃で１５人が負傷し、市内を流れるドニプロ川に架かる南橋の地下鉄設備が損傷。橋の通行も制限された。キーウでは２１日夕にも攻撃があり、６人が負傷している。

ウクライナ北東部ハルキウ州のシネグボフ知事は通信アプリ「テレグラム」で、ロシアの攻撃により女性１人が死亡し、他に４人が負傷したと明らかにした。

ポルタワ州クレメンチュク地区でもエネルギーインフラにドローンが着弾した。クレメンチュクは主要な工業都市で、ウクライナ最大級の製油所がある。

ロシアでは、ソビャニン・モスクワ市長がテレグラムで、夜間に６３０機のドローンが首都に向けて飛来し、近郊で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。

トランプ米政権のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、戦争終結を仲介するため、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、ロシアのプーチン大統領と協議した。

item.title: New Zealand court strikes down puberty blocker ban
item.description: New Zealand's High Court has struck down regulations banning new prescriptions of puberty blockers for adolescents with gender dysphoria, ruling that the measures were made unlawfully and amounted to unjustified discrimination.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Zealand's High Court has struck down regulations banning new prescriptions of puberty blockers for adolescents with gender dysphoria, ruling that the measures were made unlawfully and amounted to unjustified discrimination. Justice Dale La Hood set aside the regulations, introduced [USN:L6N3WV0CO TEXT:"in late 2025"], which barred new patients under 18 from receiving gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogues for gender dysphoria or gender incongruence La Hood, in a summary released on Wednesday, found the government had failed to meet consultation obligations under the Medicines Act because groups approached by the Ministry of Health had not been clearly told that an outright prohibition on new prescriptions was under consideration The judge also said there was insufficient urgency to justify not consulting directly with gender-diverse young people The decision followed a judicial review brought by the Professional Association for Transgender Health Aotearoa, or PATHA, against Health Minister Simeon Brown The government had argued the restrictions were a precautionary response to uncertainty over the long-term benefits and risks of puberty blockers, and reflected bans on the drugs overseas, including in Britain following the landmark [USN:L2N3GI2RA TEXT:"Cass Review"] into gender care for adolescents An earlier interim court order had prevented the measures' enforcement while the challenge was heard A spokesperson for the Health Minister said the Government was committed to introducing new safeguards on the prescribing of gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogues, while ensuring patients with medical needs could continue to access appropriate care and was seeking advice on next steps
