item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ニューヨーク市議会は10月22日、2028年6月での観光馬車廃止に向けた法案の採決を行う。1800年代から続く伝統である一方、安全性や動物愛護の観点から反対の声も強く、市長も支持している。廃止論は今年の夏、セントラルパークで18歳のインド人観光客が馬車から投げ出され死亡したのをきっかけに高まった。事業者からは生活の糧を奪われると反発や懸念の声が上がるなど、存続を巡り議論が続いている。

＜ブラーブ＞ ニューヨーク市議会は10月22日、2028年6月での観光馬車廃止に向けた法案の採決を行う。1800年代から続く伝統である一方、安全性や動物愛護の観点から反対の声も強く、市長も支持している。廃止論は今年の夏、セントラルパークで18歳のインド人観光客が馬車から投げ出され死亡したのをきっかけに高まった。事業者からは生活の糧を奪われると反発や懸念の声が上がるなど、存続を巡り議論が続いている。

＜字幕本編＞ NY市議会は2028年6月に観光馬車を廃止する法案を採決する。

馬車のオーナー・御者 アーメット・ビリシさん 「何も悪いことはしていない、市から許可証をもらっている。市が私に許可証をくれたんだ。 何も悪いことはしていないのに、なぜ市がやって来て私の商売を奪うのか。小さな商売だ、何も悪いことはしていない。これではまるでマフィアやギャングのやり口だ。こんなことは許されない。 他人の財産を奪って追い出すようなマフィアの真似は許されない」

馬車は1800年代からセントラルパークを走ってきたが、近年では動物愛護活動家から非難されている。廃止論は、18歳の観光客が馬車から投げ出され死亡したのをきっかけに高まった。

地元住民 「街を見るにはもっと良い方法がある、もうそういう時代は過ぎ去ってしまった。ウマを見ると悲しくなる」 「時代遅れという意味か」 「かつては馬車が当たり前の時代もあったが、今はほかに多くの選択肢がある。動物を苦しめなくても同じくらい楽しめる」

観光客 「ニューヨーク訪問は初めてで最初に馬車に乗りたかった。馬車禁止は最善の考えだとは思えない。多くの人々の生計が馬車にかかっているらしいし、私としては残念だ。セントラルパークと言えば馬車を思い浮かべる人も多い」

item.title: China snaps up Australian canola as improved ties, lower tariffs fuel demand
item.description: Chinese oilseed buyers have purchased around 1 million metric tons of Australian canola in recent deals, as improved Beijing-Canberra ties, lower tariffs and stronger processing margins boost demand, three Asia-based traders told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Ella Cao, Naveen Thukral
item.content:encoded: Chinese oilseed buyers have purchased around 1 million metric tons of Australian canola in recent deals, as improved Beijing-Canberra ties, lower tariffs and stronger processing margins boost demand, three Asia-based traders told Reuters. The cargoes, for arrival in early 2027, were bought at about $695 to $705 per ton, including cost and freight (C&F) to China, said one of the sources with direct knowledge of the deals. "Attractive crushing margins in both the futures and spot markets for Australian canola prompted the purchases," said one Beijing-based agricultural broker. The broker and three traders did not want to be identified as they are not authorised to speak to the media. The purchases mark a further normalization in China-Australia trade after Beijing began reopening its canola market to Australian supplies around the middle of last year . Initial imports were limited to trial purchases by state-owned trader COFCO, while private crushers were excluded until Beijing [USN:L1N43F04S TEXT:"expanded access"] in July this year. COFCO's purchases last year came after Beijing imposed preliminary anti-dumping duties of 75.8% on Canadian canola in August 2025, bringing shipments nearly to a halt. An initial trade deal with Ottawa in January led China to cut its final anti-dumping tariff to 5.9% [USN:L1N3ZO02P TEXT:"the next month"]. China now imposes an effective duty of 14.9% on Canadian canola, compared with a standard 9% import tariff on Australian cargoes. Both state-owned and private buyers made the latest purchases, traders said. Australian canola is cheaper than Canadian supplies because of lower tariffs and freight costs. China is the world's biggest importer of canola, which is also called rapeseed. Canada is the world's biggest canola exporter and Australia is the No. 2 supplier of the oilseed, which is crushed to produce protein-rich meal and oil.

item.title: Ministro del Interior de Colombia sale del Gobierno
item.description: El ministro del Interior de Colombia, Rodrigo Lara, dejará el cargo, más de dos meses después de su posesión, anunció el miércoles el presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, quien nombró en su reemplazo al abogado Alejandro Ordóñez.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El ministro del Interior de Colombia, Rodrigo Lara, dejará el cargo, más de dos meses después de su posesión, anunció el miércoles el presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, quien nombró en su reemplazo al abogado Alejandro Ordóñez. "Agradezco al doctor Rodrigo Lara Restrepo por su servicio a Colombia", dijo el mandatario en su cuenta en X. Se trata del segundo ministro que sale del gabinete de De La Espriella, quien asumió el 7 de agosto. Previamente, la ministra de Educación, Viviane Morales, renunció por motivos personales. El mandatario no explicó las causas del cambio ministerial, que se produjo horas después de que el proyecto de ley de presupuesto de gastos para 2027, por 634,9 billones de pesos (200.679 millones de dólares), se hundió por un vicio de trámite pese a haber sido aprobado por el Congreso de Colombia, lo que obligó al Gobierno a fijarlo por decreto. "Doy la bienvenida al doctor Alejandro Ordóñez Maldonado, quien asumirá como nuevo ministro del Interior. Su experiencia, carácter y trayectoria serán fundamentales para afrontar los grandes desafíos de nuestra Nación", aseguró el presidente. "Nuestro Gobierno continúa trabajando con determinación, firmeza y compromiso por el bienestar de todos los colombianos", agregó el mandatario. El ministro del Interior maneja las relaciones del Gobierno con el Congreso y una de sus principales funciones es impulsar la aprobación de leyes. Actualmente, el Gobierno de De La Espriella busca la aprobación en el Congreso de una ley de sometimiento y un estatuto antiterrorista, considerados clave para desarticular los grupos armados ilegales y las organizaciones criminales, junto con una ofensiva de las Fuerzas Militares y de la Policía Nacional. El nuevo ministro del Interior es un experimentado político y abogado de 71 años que fue procurador general y actualmente se desempeña como embajador de Colombia ante la Organización de los Estados Americanos.

item.title: Anthony Edwards (45), Wolves spoil Giannis Antetokounmpo’s Heat debut
item.description: Anthony Edwards scored 45 points as he and the Minnesota Timberwolves spoiled Giannis Antetokounmpo's debut with the Miami Heat in an emphatic 131-106 season-opening win Wednesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Anthony Edwards scored 45 points as he and the Minnesota Timberwolves spoiled Giannis Antetokounmpo's debut with the Miami Heat in an emphatic 131-106 season-opening win Wednesday night. Edwards became just the third player in NBA history to record multiple 40-point games in season openers, joining Wilt Chamberlain and Michael Jordan. Antetokounmpo scored 35 points and grabbed six rebounds after joining Miami in an offseason trade with the Milwaukee Bucks. Edwards checked out with 3:51 remaining and Minnesota leading by 28. He shot 16-for-29 from the floor, including 9-for-17 from 3-point range, and added 10 rebounds. His 45 points were the most by a Minnesota player in a season opener and marked his 125th career game with at least 30 points. LaMelo Ball, making his Timberwolves debut, hit five 3-pointers and finished with 21 points and six assists. Jaden McDaniels scored 17 points, and Rudy Gobert grabbed 15 rebounds for Minnesota. Antetokounmpo checked out with seven minutes remaining after hearing MVP chants from the home crowd early in the game. He shot 13-for-19 from the floor but also airballed a free throw and was assessed a flagrant foul after elbowing Terrence Shannon Jr. in the head on a drive. Antetokounmpo was Miami's most productive scorer. Bam Adebayo had 15 points, Andrew Wiggins and Davion Mitchell added 11 apiece, and Mitchell also dished out 10 assists. Klay Thompson scored 10 points in his Miami debut. Minnesota made 21 3-pointers, compared with eight for Miami. Edwards and Antetokounmpo each scored 21 points in the first half, but Minnesota carried a 10-point lead into the break. The Timberwolves opened 11-for-14 from the floor and led 27-19 after eight minutes. Miami pushed back in the second quarter and briefly took a 50-49 lead on a 3-pointer by Bobby Portis Jr. Minnesota controlled the final five minutes of the half. Shannon hit a pair of corner 3-pointers, Edwards recorded a steal and an easy dunk, and Ball scored on a drive and added two free throws to make it 69-59. The momentum carried over into the third quarter. Edwards and Ball each hit a 3-pointer in the opening 2:30. Edwards added another as Minnesota extended its lead to 78-61, and the Timberwolves remained in control the rest of the way. --Field Level Media

item.title: DeepSeek wrapping up $15 billion fundraising to fuel AI race
item.description: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is wrapping up its latest funding round having generated about 100 billion yuan ($14.98 billion) from existing and new investors, two people with knowledge of the matter said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Kane Wu
item.content:encoded: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is wrapping up its latest funding round having generated about 100 billion yuan ($14.98 billion) from existing and new investors, two people with knowledge of the matter said on Thursday. Battery maker Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL) (300750.SZ) and WeChat operator Tencent Holdings (0700.HK) were among the biggest investors in the round, said one of the people, who both declined to be named as the information was confidential. The fundraising is set to be complete in the coming days, but financial details are not ironclad and could still change, the other person said. DeepSeek, CATL and Tencent could not be immediately reached for comment. On Thursday, Bloomberg first reported, citing sources, that DeepSeek had raised $15 billion in the latest funding round, with CATL and Tencent as its main backers. DeepSeek will have doubled its original fundraising target of 50 billion yuan, underscoring strong interest from investors - many backed by the state and big corporations - as China aims to get ahead in the AI race against the US. The fundraising also signals that DeepSeek is getting closer to tapping public markets. In September, Reuters reported that the company had hired CITIC Securities to [USN:L4N4500M5 TEXT:"prepare for"] a potential STAR Market initial public offering. Last month, the [USN:P8N42U0CJ TEXT:"company"] released its latest model, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which it said was designed for greater capability, faster inference, higher throughput and scaling to larger models. ($1 = 6.6749 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: Raptors open season with romp past Bulls
item.description: Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard scored a game-high 23 points apiece as the Toronto Raptors rolled to a 135-92 victory over the visiting Chicago Bulls in the season opener for both teams on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard scored a game-high 23 points apiece as the Toronto Raptors rolled to a 135-92 victory over the visiting Chicago Bulls in the season opener for both teams on Wednesday. RJ Barrett added 20 points, while Quickley dished out seven assists. Leonard was reacquired by the Raptors in a Sept. 14 trade that reunited the 2019 NBA Finals MVP with the team he led to its first championship. Ja'Kobe Walter pitched in 10 points for Toronto, which held a 34-13 edge in fast-break points. Matas Buzelis led the Bulls with 17 points, connecting on 13 of 16 free-throw attempts. Chicago rookie Caleb Wilson, the No. 4 overall pick in June's NBA draft, scored 16 points in his debut. Jalen Smith and Norman Powell each tallied 15 points and Tre Jones added 13 points off the bench. The Bulls never led as the Raptors burst out of the gates, building a 43-23 first-quarter lead. Quickley tallied 14 points in the opening period, connecting on 3 of 4 3-point attempts. Toronto opened the game on a 7-0 run, with Barrett sandwiching a pair of baskets around a Leonard 3-pointer. The Raptors doubled up the Bulls at 16-8 on Collin Murray-Boyles' left-handed dunk. Quickley kept rolling in the second quarter, draining a trey from the wing to extend Toronto's advantage to 51-23 as part of an 11-0 run that spanned the first two quarters. Barrett was fouled as he flipped in a one-handed fadeaway in the lane, with his three-point play swelling Toronto's lead to 82-52 with 8:08 remaining in the third quarter. Chicago committed 27 turnovers to just 11 for Toronto. The Raptors continued to pull away with two minutes remaining in the third quarter when Walter harassed Josh Giddey into a backcourt turnover before shoveling a pass to Barnes for a two-handed dunk and a 101-62 lead. Leonard and Barrett scored back-to-back transition baskets early in the fourth quarter as the Raptors maintained a commanding 108-71 advantage. --Field Level Media

item.title: Senators rout Panthers despite Brady Tkachuk's goal in return to Ottawa
item.description: Tim Stutzle and Stephen Halliday each had a goal and an assist for the Ottawa Senators, who spoiled the return of former teammate Brady Tkachuk with the 5-1 win against the visiting Florida Panthers on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tim Stutzle and Stephen Halliday each had a goal and an assist for the Ottawa Senators, who spoiled the return of former teammate Brady Tkachuk with the 5-1 win against the visiting Florida Panthers on Wednesday. Claude Giroux, Shane Pinto and Warren Foegele also scored for Ottawa, which has won five of its past seven games. Jake Sanderson had two assists, and Linus Ullmark made 16 saves before leaving early in the third period with a lower-body injury. Samuel Ersson replaced him and stopped the only shot he faced. Tkachuk scored for the Panthers in his first return to Ottawa since the former captain was traded to Florida in June for a slew of draft picks. He was greeted by boos and negative chants from the crowd. Akira Schmid made 25 saves for the Panthers, who had won three in a row. Tkachuk gave Florida a 1-0 lead with a power-play goal midway through the first period. Artem Zub was in the box serving one of the 11 first-period penalties when Tkachuk received a pass while stationed to the side of the crease. He quickly spun to face Ullmark and shoved the puck under the goalie's pads for his seventh tally of the season. The Senators were on a power play when Stutzle tied it 1-1 at 14:13 of the first. Stutzle took a slap shot from just above the hashmarks that was blocked by Seth Jones. The puck caromed to Sanderson in the left circle, and he quickly passed to Stutzle at the inside edge of the right circle for the goal on a one-timer. Giroux gave the Senators a 2-1 lead at 9:34 of the second period. He received a back pass near the left point, skated above the hashmarks and scored with a wrist shot while Dylan Cozens provided a screen. Sanderson fed the puck ahead to Pinto, who had just one player to beat, but he held off Niko Mikkola as he slid the puck under a sprawled Schmid to make it 3-1 at 17:18 of the second. Foegele scored short-handed with a one-timer from the left hashmarks off a feed from Cozens to make it 4-1 at 7:58 of the third, and Halliday added the night's final goal when he scored off a short-handed rush at 14:57. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性、現時点で政府機関など被害の報告受けていない＝官房長官
item.description: [東京 ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は２２日午前の記者会見で、ウェブサイトで広く使われているプログラミング言語ＰＨＰに深刻な脆弱性が見つかった問題に関し、脆弱性をついたサイバー攻撃の被害などが報告されているか問われ、現時点で政府機関や重要インフラ事業者に関係する被害の報告は受けていないと明らかにした。

政府関連機関や重要インフラ事業者などには幅広く修正パッチ適用で注意喚起を行ったところで、ＰＨＰを使用したウェブサイトを運営する事業者に速やかに修正パッチの適用を推奨するほか、迅速に修正パッチを適用することが困難な場合にはウェブサイトを一時的に停止させるなどしてリスクを低減させることも有効な対策の一つだと語った。「今後も必要な注意喚起を発出するなど、適切な対応を実施していく」と述べた。

item.title: 米最高裁、トランス受刑者の医療制限で即時実施認めず 政権側の申請却下
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米連邦最高裁は２１日、連邦刑務所に収容されているトランスジェンダーの受刑者に対する性自認に沿った医療措置を制限する政策について、即時実施を求めたトランプ政権の申請を却下した。トランスジェンダーの権利を巡り、最高裁が当事者側に有利な判断を示すのは異例。

最高裁は、政策の是非を争う訴訟が続く間、連邦刑務所局（ＢＯＰ）による政策実施を差し止めた連邦地裁の命令を解除するよう求めた司法省の緊急申請を退けた。

２月に公表された政策は、薬物治療や外科手術のほか、外見を性自認に合わせるための衣服や脱毛器具の提供など、あらゆる「社会生活上の配慮」を禁じる。精神科医療の提供は引き続き認める。

ニュージャージー、フロリダ、ミネソタ各州の連邦矯正施設に収容されているトランスジェンダーの受刑者３人が、この政策に異議を唱えて集団訴訟を起こしていた。

最高裁は判断理由を示さなかった。緊急申請への対応では一般的な措置だ。保守派のクラレンス・トーマス、サミュエル・アリート両判事は反対意見を明らかにした。

トランプ氏は２０２５年１月の大統領復帰以来、トランスジェンダーの権利に厳しい姿勢を取っている。

item.title: Grayson Allen, Naz Reid power Hornets past Nets
item.description: Grayson Allen scored 21 points off the bench while Naz Reid totaled 20 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists as the duo made a strong first impression for their new team as the Charlotte Hornets earned a 110-103 victory over the Brooklyn Nets Wednesday night in New York.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Grayson Allen scored 21 points off the bench while Naz Reid totaled 20 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists as the duo made a strong first impression for their new team as the Charlotte Hornets earned a 110-103 victory over the Brooklyn Nets Wednesday night in New York. Acquired from Phoenix in an offseason deal for Miles Bridges, Allen made 6 of 9 shots and sank five of Charlotte's 15 3-pointers. The Hornets also outscored the Nets by 20 points in his 29 minutes. Obtained from Minnesota for LaMelo Ball in the offseason, Reid made 8 of 18 shots, including 4 of 10 from distance. Reid finished with his 17th career 20-10 game and helped Charlotte score 20 second-chance points. Dennis Schroder debuted for his 12th NBA team by contributing 19 points and six assists. Brandon Miller contributed 18 and Moussa Diabate finished with 17 for the Hornets. The Hornets shot 44.6% and hit 15 of 48 3-point tries. Julius Randle led all scorers with 33 points in his debut for the Nets. Michael Porter Jr. began his second season in Brooklyn by finishing with 26 points and seven rebounds, but the veteran duo were the only two in double figures for the Nets. Brooklyn newcomers Keon Ellis and Moritz Wagner were held to seven points apiece. First-round pick Mikel Brown debuted with six points while second-year point guard Egor Demin finished with four on 2-of-10 shooting. The Nets shot 45% and made 12 of 31 3-point tries but took 12 fewer shots than Charlotte. Miller scored 12 first-quarter points, including eight straight at one point as Charlotte held a 27-23 lead through the opening quarter. The Hornets briefly held a nine-point lead late in the second and took a 54-48 lead by halftime on Diabate's open layup with 1.2 seconds left. Diabate's 3-point play gave Charlotte a 10-point lead less than two minutes into the third quarter and the Nets countered with 12 straight points for a 64-62 lead on Porter's four-point play with 8:12 left. Two free throws by Nolan Traore forged a 72-all tie with 4:13 left and Brooklyn used a timeout after Allen sank open 3s on consecutive possessions for a 78-72 lead with 3:03 remaining. Charlotte expanded its lead to 83-74 on Reid's 3-pointer with 1:53 left and held an 86-81 advantage into the fourth. Schroder scored eight straight Charlotte points and his drive opened a 102-92 lead with 5:38 left to put the Hornets in control. --Field Level Media

item.title: Australian TV reporter rescues man from sinking car during floods
item.description: An Australian television reporter and a bystander rescued a man from a car as it was engulfed by flood waters on Thursday, footage of the incident showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Australian television reporter and a bystander rescued a man from a car as it was engulfed by flood waters on Thursday, footage of the incident showed. Will Murray, a journalist with Australia's public broadcaster ABC, was reporting on flooding north of the city of Brisbane in Queensland state, when a man drove a four-wheel drive through water. It then stalled and started to sink, the ABC said. Murray and another man swam out to the car and pulled the driver from the vehicle, moments before it was completely submerged. "The pair of them definitely saved that man's life," said ABC camera operator Liz Pickering, who witnessed the incident, according to the broadcaster. "No doubt about that." About 170 mm of rain (6.7 inches) had fallen in the town of Morayfield on Thursday when the incident took place, the ABC said.

item.title: Tom Cruise to be honoured with American Film Institute award
item.description: The ceremony will take place in April.
item.dc:creator: CNA Lifestyle
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Tom Cruise to be honoured with American Film Institute award

The ceremony will take place in April.

FILE PHOTO: Cast member Tom Cruise attends a premiere for the film Digger in Los Angeles, California, US Sep 28, 2026. REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni/File Photo

FAST

Actor Tom Cruise, known for movies from Risky Business to Top Gun, will receive the American Film Institute's Life Achievement Award at a Hollywood ceremony in April, organisers said on Wednesday (Oct 21). The AFI, a nonprofit dedicated to preserving and promoting movies, has bestowed the honour annually since 1973. Previous recipients include Bette Davis, Gene Kelley, Elizabeth Taylor and Tom Hanks. Cruise is known throughout the film business as one of the biggest champions of cinemas.  “As an actor and producer, he brings an extraordinary commitment to everything he does," said producer Kathleen Kennedy, chair of AFI's board of trustees. "What I especially admire is his deep belief in movies and their ability to bring people together." Cruise has been nominated for three Academy Awards for acting and received an honorary Oscar last year for his lifetime of work. His films include Jerry Maguire, Minority Report, A Few Good Men, Rain Man and the Mission: Impossible series. Cruise's latest movie, the big-budget dark comedy Digger, has struggled at the box office, finishing fifth on US and Canadian charts in its opening weekend in October.

Source: Reuters/sr

item.title: Indian shares slip as high oil prices fuel inflation worries
item.description: Indian shares declined on Thursday, extending losses from the previous two sessions, as an escalating Middle East war kept oil above $110 per barrel, stoking inflation concerns for the world's third-largest importer of crude.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
item.content:encoded: Indian shares declined on Thursday, extending losses from the previous two sessions, as an escalating Middle East war kept oil above $110 per barrel, stoking inflation concerns for the world's third-largest importer of crude. The benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.73% to 22,647.90, and the Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.49% to 73,343.98, as of 9:50 a.m. IST (0420 GMT). Fifteen of the 16 major sectors logged losses. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) dropped 1.2% each. Brent crude futures were up 1.7% at $110.7 per barrel as more attacks in [USN:L6N46718Z TEXT:"Saudi Arabia"] by Yemen's Houthis prompted the United States to order some diplomats and family members to leave its missions in the kingdom. Members of India's [USN:L1N4670J9 TEXT:"rate-setting panel"] indicated that further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, minutes of the committee's latest policy meeting released on Wednesday showed. "Global weakness and persistent concerns over inflation and interest rates are keeping traders defensive," said Deepesh Sarawagi, technical research analyst at Choice Broking. "Earnings-led moves will determine whether the Nifty finds support at lower levels or extends its recent decline." Among stocks, heavyweights HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) and Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) fell 1.6% and 1%, respectively. Oil-marketing companies, paint makers and tyre makers declined on higher crude prices. Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services (MMFS.NS) slid 6% with multiple brokerages flagging pressure from mounting funding costs and risks from insurance distribution reforms. Nestle India (NEST.NS) dipped 3%, while Abbott India (ABOT.NS) and Zydus Wellness (ZYDS.NS) dropped 1.4% and 2%, respectively, after the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) issued notices saying promotional claims of some of their products breached rules. An Abbott spokesperson said the company was neither involved in nor aware of the social media content cited in the regulator's notice until it received the FSSAI notice and did not endorse the claims in it and had shared this with the regulator. Nestle said the regulator's communication reiterated earlier concerns over product labels and that it had submitted a detailed response. Zydus Wellness did not respond to Reuters request for comment.

item.title: Taiwan probes organised crime links to China's 'transnational repression'
item.description: Taiwan is probing organised crime's links to Chinese efforts to carry out "transnational repression", a security official said on Thursday, after Taipei's government said Beijing was behind an attack on a comedian who mocked President Xi Jinping.
item.dc:creator: Ben Blanchard, Yimou Lee
item.content:encoded: Taiwan is probing organised crime's links to Chinese efforts to carry out "transnational repression", a security official said on Thursday, after Taipei's government said Beijing was behind an attack on a [USN:L4N4670DY TEXT:"comedian"] who mocked President Xi Jinping. Taiwan, which China views as its own territory over the island's objections, has complained that Beijing is using various underhanded methods to go after Taiwanese who the Chinese government views as separatists or are otherwise politically suspect. Speaking to reporters at parliament, Taiwan National Security Bureau Director-General Tsai Ming-yen said the local networks that cooperate in incidents like the comedian attack are mostly criminal gangs, or private investigation firms linked to organised crime. "The National Security Bureau is more concerned with whether anyone behind them has been directed and funded by the Chinese Communist Party. How to dismantle the entire criminal group and network is a key focus for us," Tsai said. China's Taiwan Affairs Office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. It has not responded to previous questions on the assault on the comedian. Other China critics in Taiwan have also been attacked, including Hong Kong singer and activist Denise Ho. She was attacked in 2019 in Taipei by a masked man who threw red paint at her. Tsai said Taiwan might need to amend its laws to better deal with China's activities. "Comprehensively curbing the Chinese communists' transnational repression in Taiwan's democratic and rule-of-law society is also very important, and the legal framework for it has been lacking," he added. Taiwan's Supreme Prosecutors Office said in a separate statement on Thursday that the public should "raise their vigilance and never assist hostile foreign forces or allow themselves to be exploited as local collaborators". MARITIME PRESSURE Taiwan, whose government rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims, says it is facing a stepped-up pressure campaign by China, including in the waters around the island where China's military and Coast Guard operate daily. Tsai said Chinese Coast Guard activities to the east of Taiwan, where Beijing began what it calls "law enforcement" patrols in June, are becoming more and more routine, often taking place with Chinese research vessels. He added that he was particularly concerned with the appearance of Chinese [USN:L4N45S05G TEXT:"militia"] boats to Taiwan's east and southwest. "Generally speaking, militia fishing boats are more commonly seen in the South China Sea, so the emergence of this situation around Taiwan is significant," Tsai said. Earlier this month, the US State Department said China's actions off Taiwan's east coast are "deeply destabilising" and only worsen tension after Reuters reported the first known sighting of a [USN:L4N45S05G TEXT:"Chinese militia boat"] in those waters. Officials in Taiwan say they believe China is practicing for a possible maritime blockade using overlapping military, paramilitary and civilian assets. China has repeatedly said its [USN:L1N46603C TEXT:"operations"] off Taiwan's east coast are "legitimate and lawful" given those are Chinese waters, a position Taipei's government strongly rejects.

item.title: Newcomer Cole Knuble anchors Flyers’ third straight win over Sabres
item.description: Playing in just his second NHL game, Cole Knuble scored twice to lift the Philadelphia Flyers to a 3-1 road victory over the Buffalo Sabres on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Playing in just his second NHL game, Cole Knuble scored twice to lift the Philadelphia Flyers to a 3-1 road victory over the Buffalo Sabres on Wednesday. Knuble's strong effort guided Philadelphia to its third straight win since the team started the season 0-6-3. The Flyers have scored three goals in each of those three victories after failing to reach that mark in any of their first nine contests. Trevor Zegras also scored for the Flyers, while Oliver Bonk had two assists and Dan Vladar made 27 saves. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen turned aside 23 shots and Jason Zucker tallied the only goal for the Sabres, who have lost five of their last seven games. Knuble opened the scoring at 14:49 of the first period, grabbing a rebound of a Bonk shot which was saved and burying it on his backhand for a 1-0 lead. The Flyers made it 2-0 on a power-play goal with 43 seconds left in the period. Luukkonen saved Matvei Michkov's initial shot, but Zegras batted the rebound out of the air and into the net for his third goal of the year. Meanwhile, Vladar was steady on the other end as Buffalo held a 16-9 edge in shots despite trailing 2-0 at the first intermission. The only goal of the middle session was Zucker's first of the year -- a power-play goal in which Jack Quinn's shot hit off Zucker on the doorstep and found its way into the net. The Flyers failed to score on a 5-on-3 that lasted over a minute late in the second period. Shortly thereafter, Philadelphia defenseman Travis Sanheim was whistled for high-sticking, leading to Zucker's power-play goal. Knuble's second of the night came at 3:03 of the third period. He carried the puck on an offensive rush before Luukkonen cut off his angle. However, the rookie quickly banked the puck off Luukkonen and into the net on a shot from just behind the goal line. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nickeil Alexander-Walker's late baskets key Hawks' win over Magic
item.description: Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 31 points and hit a pair of clutch 3-pointers in the final two minutes to help the visiting Atlanta Hawks defeat the Orlando Magic 132-125 on Wednesday in the season opener for both teams.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 31 points and hit a pair of clutch 3-pointers in the final two minutes to help the visiting Atlanta Hawks defeat the Orlando Magic 132-125 on Wednesday in the season opener for both teams. The result ruined the debut of first-year Orlando coach Sean Sweeney. Alexander-Walker's two treys enabled the Hawks to stretch their lead from 122-121 to five points 128-123, an advantage they never relinquished down the stretch. Walker shot 5-for-8 from 3-point range and 10-for-13 from the foul line. Atlanta also got 20 points and five steals from Dyson Daniels, 20 points and 14 rebounds from Jalen Johnson, and 19 points from CJ McCollum. Orlando's Paolo Banchero scored 35 points, making 10 of 12 from the floor, and added seven rebounds and 10 assists. He had words with Johnson after the game. The Magic got 22 points apiece from Wendell Carter Jr. and Franz Wagner and 18 points from Desmond Bane. It was Atlanta's sixth consecutive win over Orlando. The Magic led by as many as 10 points in the first quarter and took a 33-28 advantage into the second. The Hawks changed the momentum and enjoyed a 52-42 lead after a drive by Johnson with 5:14 left in the half. Atlanta led by as many as 13 on a McCollum 3-pointer and was up 72-62 at halftime. Banchero scored 22 and teammate Tristan da Silva made four 3-pointers and had 12 in the opening half. Daniels led the Hawks with 16 points at the break. Atlanta led by as many as 14 points in the third quarter, only to have Orlando catch up at the foul line. The Magic outscored the Hawks 20-7 on free throws in the period and took a 98-95 lead on back-to-back three-point plays by Goga Bitadze and Banchero. Orlando took a 100-99 edge into the final quarter. The Hawks led by one point with 4:27 left when Johnson was called for an offensive foul, which would have been his sixth personal. Atlanta challenged the call and it was reversed after a lengthy video review, allowing the Hawks to build momentum for the closing minutes. --Field Level Media

item.title: Oilers, Hurricanes bring high-powered offenses into clash
item.description: Two of the highest-scoring teams in the young season meet Thursday night in Edmonton.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Two of the highest-scoring teams in the young season meet Thursday night in Edmonton. The Carolina Hurricanes have excelled despite a rash of injuries among their forwards, while the Oilers could be getting even stronger a few weeks into the season. Center Ryan Nugent-Hopkins is set to make his season debut against Carolina, which should help the Oilers further stabilize their line combinations. "So, the minutes won't be out of whack," Edmonton coach Mike Babcock said. "We'll be able to just roll out the door and let everyone go, and suddenly we'll be in a way better situation center-wise. ... I'm excited to get some guys back and get up and running like we should be." Zach Hyman was in the lineup as the Oilers won consecutive games against the Utah Mammoth and Minnesota Wild. But they aim to become even stronger with more top-level players available. "I think we're way better than this," Babcock said. Injuries have continued to mount for the Hurricanes, who have still won eight of their last nine games. Thursday's matchup is the fourth stop on their five-game road trip. Carolina beat the Vancouver Canucks 6-3 on Tuesday, getting a boost from Nicolas Deslauriers, who scored his first two goals as a Hurricane. Carolina acquired him in March. "I've said it often, I don't expect to score goals, but it's fun when it happens," Deslauriers said. "I know what my job is, and I'm not going to deviate from that and (think) I have to score goals now. It's not my job, but it's fun." The Hurricanes have yet to have winger Seth Jarvis in action this season, while forwards Taylor Hall, Mark Jankowski and Jordan Staal are sidelined with injuries. Jarvis was activated Wednesday and is expected to make his season debut Thursday, while Jankowski left the team during the road trip to return to Raleigh, N.C., for further evaluation. Those injuries have led to unexpected line combinations for Carolina, which has won six of its seven road games. Defenseman Juuso Valimaki made his Hurricanes debut Tuesday night, paired with Shayne Gostisbehere. "He played really well for not having played since training camp," Carolina coach Rod Brind'Amour said. "There was a lot to worry about, but I thought he had his hands on the first goal with a nice little quick up pass. I thought he played well. Good on him to contribute." The Oilers have demonstrated plenty of firepower but want to tighten up defensively. "You can't give out gifts," Babcock said. "If they earn them, no problem." Edmonton edged Minnesota 4-3 in overtime Tuesday. Superstar forward Connor McDavid has recorded at least one point in all nine games. With 20 assists, he became the first player in NHL history to reach that mark in the first nine games of a season. He also has six goals for a league-leading 26 points. McDavid logged more than 25 minutes Tuesday. Edmonton has enough talent on its roster to generate scoring chances on any shift. "These guys are going to make their own breaks," Babcock said. Thursday marks the second game of Edmonton's five-game homestand. --Field Level Media Two of the highest-scoring teams in the young season meet Thursday night in Edmonton. item.title: サッカー＝マンＵフェルナンデスが戦術に疑問、コモ戦の4失点大敗で
item.description: ［２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、マンチェスター・ユナイテッド（マンＵ）のブルーノ・フェルナンデスは、２１日に行われた欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）のコモ（イタリア）戦での大敗後、チームの戦術に疑問を呈した。

マンＵはこの試合で開始２分で先制を許すと、後半にも３失点。同アディショナルタイムにジョシュア・ザークツィーのゴールで１点を返したが、１─４で敗れた。

先発出場し、後半２１分に交代したフェルナンデスは試合後、ＴＮＴスポーツに「ボールに対するプレスが不十分で、ボール非保持時の動きも良くなかった。うまくいかないことばかりだった。マンツーマンでプレスをかけず、あえてスペースを残して相手を待ち構えてボールを奪おうとするのは、（コーチ陣の）戦術的な判断だ。だが、このような相手にスペースを与えてしまえば、彼らに自信を持たせてしまうことになる」と述べた。

この発言はマイケル・キャリック監督の戦術に対する批判かと問われたフェルナンデスは「それは私ではなく、監督やスタッフがどう受け取るかの話。時にはプレッシャーの中でもっと勇気を持って、リスクを冒して高い位置からプレスをかけて相手を苦しめることが必要だ」と語った。

ＣＬで３試合を終えて勝ち点３のマンＵは現在、公式戦７試合未勝利。プレミアリーグでは１３位と苦しんでいる。

item.title: Asian markets dip as investors weigh tech earnings, Gulf tensions
item.description: Asian stocks struggled to stay above water in early trade on Thursday, as tech earnings optimism provided only fleeting support amid lingering concerns over AI and uncertainty in the Gulf.
item.dc:creator: Jiaxing Li
item.content:encoded: Asian stocks struggled to stay above water in early trade on Thursday, as tech earnings optimism provided only fleeting support amid lingering concerns over AI and uncertainty in the Gulf. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) was down 0.2%, on track for a fourth straight week of decline. Japan's Nikkei stock index (.N225) gave up earlier gains to trade 0.4% lower, while Korean shares (.KS11) were down more than 1%. US stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis, were down 0.4% at 7,765.8. Overnight, the tech-heavy Nasdaq led Wall Street to a [USN:L6N4671AW TEXT:"higher close"] as better-than-expected earnings reports from market heavyweights helped ease some concerns over the sustainability and profitability of massive AI build-outs. Space X (SPCX.O) posted its first profit as a public company, Meta (META.O) reported third-quarter revenue that beat expectations, while AI server maker Super Micro (SMCI.O) forecast quarterly revenue and profit margin that both topped estimates. However, Meta's [USN:L4N4671S3 TEXT:"plan"] to issue non-voting Class C common stock drew renewed scrutiny on AI spending. "There's a lot of noise out there at the moment and investors are still digesting this morning's results," said Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com. "Also, we're really only at the start of the meaty part of earnings season, which is coming at the same time that investors are tackling the uncertainty from an upcoming Fed decision, geopolitical risks, and US mid-terms." In a sign of subdued risk sentiment, the yield on benchmark 10-year Treasury notes was down 4.2 basis points at 5.1065%, while the yield on 30-year notes was at a one-week low of 5.3968%. Meanwhile, Brent crude rose 1.1% to $110.03 a barrel, near a five-month high. The US ordered diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes, while the New York Times reported the US and Israeli militaries had developed specific plans for renewed attacks on Iran after the US midterm elections, which take place on November 3. In currencies, the dollar index , which tracks the greenback against a basket of currencies of other major trading partners, dipped to 102.2. The euro was little changed at $1.1231. The yen was also flat at 158.125, after Deputy Bank of Japan Governor Ryozo Himino [USN:L1N46703F TEXT:"signalled his readiness"] to raise borrowing costs. The Korean won was muted at 1325.9, after the Bank of Korea left its benchmark interest rate [USN:L4N467041 TEXT:"unchanged"] at 3.00% on Thursday. Gold was slightly lower at $4115.5 per ounce. Bitcoin was down 0.4% at $84,284.05, while ether was 0.6% lower at $2,476.34.

item.title: Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia sign defence cooperation accord, Ankara says
item.description: ANKARA: Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement on Wednesday (Oct 21) to boost defence cooperation and strengthen defensive capabilities, the Turkish Defence Ministry said.In a statement, the ministry said the countries signed the Badr Memorandum of Understanding in Doha as a sign of thei
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia sign defence cooperation accord, Ankara says

Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement on Wednesday to boost defence cooperation and strengthen defensive capabilities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on Oct 5, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Saudi Press Agency)

ANKARA: Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement on Wednesday (Oct 21) to boost defence cooperation and strengthen defensive capabilities, the Turkish Defence Ministry said. In a statement, the ministry said the countries signed the Badr Memorandum of Understanding in Doha as a sign of their desire to further deepen cooperation and develop partnerships. "The agreement holds substantial economic importance," it said, adding the accord sought to foster cooperation in military production, boost military capabilities, and help collaboration in technical military training, research and development. "By leveraging the unique military production capabilities of each country, the initiative will facilitate cooperation and integration, enhance defence industrial capacities, and enable the fulfilment of the needs of allied and friendly nations," it added.

Türkiye, which has NATO's second-largest army and a robust defence industry, has been helping Gulf nations, including Qatar, where it has a military base, bolster their defences amid the Iran war. In August, it signed a mutual defence pact with nuclear-armed Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, under which an attack on one party constitutes an attack on all. Ankara also has close ties with Indonesia, notably in the defence industry. The ministry said the Badr accord would strengthen ties between the countries' defence industries and bolster collaboration to promote security and achieve shared objectives. Haluk Gorgun, the chairman of Türkiye's Defence Industry Presidency, said the accord formed the foundation of a "strategic cooperation" to develop joint production and technology. "Technology sharing, joint development and strengthening domestic production capabilities lie at the heart of sustainable defence industry. As Türkiye, we value partnerships that go beyond off-the-shelf procurement models, that foster the development of a nation’s own human capital and industrial infrastructure," Gorgun said in a statement. "We believe that the Badr Memorandum of Understanding will contribute to transforming the complementary capabilities of Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia, and Türkiye into concrete projects," he added.

item.title: トランプ氏、グラム氏の上院選支援 牙城サウスカロライナで予想外の接戦
item.description: ［クレムソン（米サウスカロライナ州） ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［クレムソン（米サウスカロライナ州）　２１日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２１日、南部サウスカロライナ州で中間選挙の上院選に臨む共和党のダーリン・グラム氏の応援演説を行った。同州は通常は共和党の牙城とされているが、世論調査によると予想外の接戦となっている。

ダーリン氏は、サウスカロライナ州選出の上院議員だった兄のリンゼー氏が７月に死去したことを受け、残りの任期である来年１月初めまでの暫定議員に任命。その後、共和党予備選を経て正式な党候補となり、中間選挙で民主党のアニー・アンドリューズ候補と対決する。

支持率が過去最低に落ち込む中、トランプ氏は共和党による連邦議会上下両院の多数派維持に向け、各州で精力的に遊説を続けている。

トランプ氏はクレムソン大学での演説の冒頭に、ダーリン・グラム氏への支持を改めて表明。心臓疾患で突然死去した兄のリンゼー氏をたたえた。

クレムソン大での集会は、ダーリン・グラム氏にとって微妙な時期に行われた。トランプ氏は先週、ウクライナ支援を主導する共和党の論客だった兄のリンゼー氏が死去前の数カ月間に推進していた対ロシア制裁を免除した。ダーリン氏はトランプ氏をおおむね支持する一方、制裁免除については大統領と意見が異なると述べている。

item.title: Anthony Davis (34 points), Wizards ride 21-2 surge to upend Bucks
item.description: Anthony Davis scored 34 points and grabbed 12 rebounds to lead the Washington Wizards to a 128-116 victory over the visiting Milwaukee Bucks in the teams' season opener Wednesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Anthony Davis scored 34 points and grabbed 12 rebounds to lead the Washington Wizards to a 128-116 victory over the visiting Milwaukee Bucks in the teams' season opener Wednesday night. Trae Young added 20 points and a game-high 13 assists for the Wizards, while Kyshawn George scored 18 points. In their first game with Milwaukee after being included in the offseason trade that sent Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami, Tyler Herro led the Bucks with 24 points and Jaime Jaquez Jr. scored 22. Fellow former Heat player Kasparas Jakucionis added 15 points off the bench. Leading 93-90 entering the fourth quarter, Washington took over in front of its home crowd. After trailing by as many as eight, the Wizards went on a 21-2 run in the fourth to build a 111-98 lead. Washington opened the quarter by making its first nine shots from the floor. The scoring in the fourth came from a variety of sources, with seven players posting at least four points as Washington outscored Milwaukee 38-23 to secure the victory. The Wizards did most of their damage without the 3-pointer. They made just three shots from beyond the arc in the second half while scoring 77 points. Davis made his presence felt early, scoring 10 points and grabbing six rebounds in the first quarter. The Wizards took a 25-23 lead into the second. Milwaukee bounced back in the second, outscoring Washington 33-26 behind seven points from Herro, who also scored seven in the first quarter. The Bucks led 56-51 at halftime despite shooting 5-for-17 from 3-point range. Washington was 3-for-17. The shooting improved in the third, as Milwaukee went 6-for-11 from beyond the arc and was led by Jaquez's 10 points. However, another dominant stretch from Davis, who scored 18 points, helped Washington win the quarter 39-37 and take a 93-90 lead into the fourth. Washington has won four straight games against Milwaukee after taking the final three meetings last season, snapping the Bucks' seven-year winning streak in the season series. --Field Level Media

item.title: Dip in the dollar takes a breather with Fed in focus
item.description: A downdraft in the dollar took a pause on Thursday as investors began hunkering down ahead of a slew of central bank meetings next week, where hawkish holds are expected on interest rates in Japan, the US and Europe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A downdraft in the dollar took a pause on Thursday as investors began hunkering down ahead of a slew of central bank meetings next week, where hawkish holds are expected on interest rates in Japan, the US and Europe. The currency market is long the dollar on the assumption the AI boom keeps the US economy humming and that strong growth supports interest rates staying higher for longer. Recent gains for sterling and currencies in Canada, Australia and New Zealand, all of which have lately touched their highest on the dollar in several weeks, suggest dollar bets have been pared a bit, though moves on Thursday were slight. Sterling , which hit a one-month high of $1.3409 earlier in the week, has been supported hotter-than-expected British inflation and held at $1.33955. The Australian dollar , which made a three-week top on Wednesday, is hanging on above 70 US cents at $0.7025, while expectations for a rate hike next week in New Zealand hoisting the kiwi to a one-month high of $0.5709. Reserve Bank of Australia Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said on Wednesday that the inflation outlook was looking "materially worse" in part due to high oil prices, pushing up market bets on whether the next hike in Australia comes as soon as next month. The Bank of Canada is also expected to hike next week and the loonie was supported near a one-month top of C$1.4032 per dollar. The euro and yen have settled into tight ranges, with the threat of intervention and prospect of rate hikes holding Japan's currency around 158 to the dollar . The euro has spent about a month on the slide, emerging as a favoured channel for putting a bet on a stronger dollar, as fiscal concerns in France and Europe's energy fragility attract short sellers. French 10-year yields hit their highest since 2022 on Wednesday as weekend unrest across France, fuelled in part by cuts to public services, has highlighted how politically difficult it will be to bring budget deficits under control. But aside from a brief dip in the thin trade of Monday morning in Asia, the euro has kept fairly steady above $1.12. "The euro cannot sell off—and it cannot rally," said Spectra Markets' president Brent Donnelly. "We are in a stalemate where the overhang of bad news just about perfectly offsets the market positioning." The European Central Bank is expected to hold its benchmark rate at 2.5% next week, though a hike is all but priced in before the year's end. Markets have priced a hold in Tokyo, too, with the next hike — to 1.5% — expected early next year. The Federal Reserve is seen on hold in October, with the Fed funds rate window at 3.75-4%, but hiking in December.

item.title: インド中銀、追加利上げ示唆 積極引き締めには慎重＝議事要旨
item.description: [ムンバイ ２１日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（ＲＢＩ、中央銀行）は２１日、７日に開いた金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）の議...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インド中銀、追加利上げ示唆　積極引き締めには慎重＝議事要旨 11:07 配信

ムンバイにあるインド準備銀行（RBI）本部で8月撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

[ムンバイ ２１日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（ＲＢＩ、中央銀行）は２１日、７日に開いた金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）の議事要旨を公表した。それによると、委員らはインフレ抑制のために追加利上げが必要になる可能性を示唆した一方、経済成長へのリスクを踏まえ、積極的な金融引き締めサイクルを支持するまでには至らなかった。

ＲＢＩは７日、主要政策金利であるレポ金利を全会一致で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、５．５０％とした。利上げは約４年ぶり。金融政策のスタンスは「中立」から「調整された引き締め」へ変更した。マルホトラ総裁はこの変更は実質的に利下げの可能性がなくなったことを示していると述べた。

インドでは中東戦争による原油価格の急騰やモンスーン降雨量の不足を受けて食品価格が上昇し、インフレ懸念が強まっている。このため市場では、今後１２カ月間で１００ｂｐ強の利上げが織り込まれている。

マルホトラ総裁は議事要旨で「インフレが幅広い分野に広がりつつある兆候が強まっている」と指摘した。

インドの９月の消費者物価上昇率（ＣＰＩ）は５．５４％と、市場予想を上回る伸びとなり、中銀の許容上限である６％に近づいた。これにより追加利上げの必要性が強まっている。

中銀は最新の見通しで、１０－１２月期の平均インフレ率が６％になると予測している。

グプタ副総裁はこうした状況を踏まえ「インフレの広がりを示す、より決定的な証拠を待つよりも、金融政策の効果には時間差があることを意識すべきだ」と主張。「インフレ率を低水準に抑え、インフレ期待を安定させるためには、政策金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ＭＰＣ委員のサウガタ・バタチャリヤ氏は議事要旨で「あらゆる情報を総括すると、現時点では金融政策を引き締める強い経済的根拠がある」と指摘し、「あまりに急速な政策金利の調整は、成長を抑制するリスクがある」と付け加えた。

ただ最終的にどの程度の金融引き締めが必要になるかについては、委員やエコノミストの間で見方が分かれている。

ＭＰＣ委員のナゲシュ・クマール氏とラム・シン氏はともに、金融政策スタンスの変更に反対した。シン氏は特に、この変更が長期にわたる利上げサイクルを示唆する可能性があるが、現時点ではその必要性はないと主張した。

シン氏は議事要旨で「現段階では、長期にわたる利上げサイクルの継続ではなく、小幅かつ段階的なレポ金利の引き上げが妥当だ」と指摘。積極的な金融引き締めの見通しは、金利に敏感な分野にとどまらず、需要全体を弱める可能性があると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 コラム：ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が問う見通しのあり方、3つの論点＝井上哲也氏 アングル：世界的な中銀の金融引き締め姿勢、米イラン合意でも潮目変わらず 最終更新: 10/22(木) 11:07 ロイター

item.title: 「偽の世論調査」放送は規則違反の可能性、米ＦＣＣ委員長が警告
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）のカー委員長は２１日、米放送ネットワークが「完全に捏造された世論調査や投票を抑制する世論調査」を放送すれば、規制上の義務に違反する恐れがあるという見解を示した。

カー氏はＸへの投稿で、１１月の中間選挙を前に、「選挙プロセスの正常な機能を妨げ、有権者の投票行動や投票意欲の通常パターンを変えることだけを目的とした」こうした調査が大幅に増えていると主張した。

根拠を示さず、どの調査を指しているかも具体的に説明しなかった。

カー氏はＦＣＣがこの問題を深刻に受け止めているとし、報道の歪曲を禁じる規則に違反する可能性を示唆した。

コムキャスト傘下のＮＢＣ、スカイダンス傘下のＣＢＳ、ＡＢＣ、フォックスからコメントは直ちに得られなかった。

カー氏はトランプ米大統領から、米放送局や記者への取り締まりを強化するよう圧力を受けてきた。

ＦＣＣは世論調査に関する正式な指針を示すかどうかについて、コメントの要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

ロイターは今週初め、トランプ氏の支持率が過去最低に低下したと報じた。１９日に終了したロイター／イプソスの世論調査によると、トランプ氏の支持率は３１％と、２週間前から１％ポイント低下し、大統領１期目、２期目を通して最低水準となった。

トランプ氏はこうした調査や、中間選挙で民主党が共和党を大幅にリードしていることを示す調査を繰り返し否定し、ＮＢＣのクリステン・ウェルカー氏ら記者を処罰するようカー氏に求めてきた。

トランプ氏は１９日、「偽の世論調査だと思う。世論調査には意味があるが、多くは不正に操作されている」と述べた。

item.title: Meta strikes deal to keep Zuckerberg in California after wealth tax concerns
item.description: Meta Platforms has struck a deal with Mark Zuckerberg to keep him living in California after the CEO warned he was considering leaving the state that houses the company's headquarters if voters pass a wealth tax proposal next month.
item.dc:creator: Carlos Méndez
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) has struck a deal with Mark Zuckerberg to keep him living in California after the CEO warned he was considering leaving the state that houses the company's headquarters if voters pass a wealth tax proposal next month. Under the deal, Zuckerberg will get non-voting shares he can sell to potentially foot a multi-billion-dollar tax bill in the event the proposal is approved, in exchange for a commitment to remain a resident of California, or wherever Meta maintains its headquarters, for eight years, Meta said on Wednesday. Zuckerberg, the world's sixth richest person according to Forbes, told Meta he was considering moving his primary residence outside California because Proposition 40, a ballot measure dubbed the "California wealth tax", could expose him to a massive tax liability, potentially forcing him to sell voting shares to pay it. Proposition 40, which asks Californians whether to impose a one-time 5% [USN:L6N4511DT TEXT:"tax"] on the state's billionaires, is far from certain to pass, political analysts say. The state is home to as many as 250 billionaires collectively worth upwards of $2 trillion. Zuckerberg, who has a net worth of about $240 billion, can immediately sell 20% of the Class C shares he receives, representing 10% of his overall economic stake in the company, allowing him to pay a potential tax bill without losing voting control. The company [USN:L4N4671S3 TEXT:"said"] on Wednesday it will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining Zuckerberg's control. Meta's long-term forecasts, as described in the filing, showed it would need to raise "hundreds of billions of dollars" over several years, beginning as early as fall 2026, as it expects to need capital to finance its AI-related growth plan. The parent of Facebook and Instagram said a special committee of its board concluded it was "critically important" that Zuckerberg remain in a leadership role and continue to manage the company from its California headquarters, particularly during what it described as "unprecedented challenge and competition in our industry" driven by AI.

item.title: Canada's Carney visits Turkey in push to ease US trade dependence
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney will meet President Tayyip Erdogan in Turkey on Thursday, marking the first bilateral visit by a Canadian leader, as he seeks to deepen trade with other "middle powers" and ease dependence on the US.
item.dc:creator: Maria Cheng
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Mark Carney will meet President Tayyip Erdogan in Turkey on Thursday, marking the [USN:L6N45N1A5 TEXT:"first bilateral visit"] by a Canadian leader, as he seeks to deepen trade with other "middle powers" and ease dependence on the US. Carney and Erdogan are [USN:L8N4660GU TEXT:"expected to sign"] a declaration deepening cooperation in four areas including defense and energy, a person briefed on the matter said. Carney is on a global trade blitz that he hopes will help buffer Canada from a [USN:SPN44J009 TEXT:"trade war"] with the US, where President Donald Trump has applied sweeping tariffs and questioned the neighboring country's sovereignty. NATO member Turkey seeks new investment and collaboration for its burgeoning defence industry, new nuclear power plants and mining sector. Carney's office said the visit aims “to position Canada as a key partner in trade and investment". Although trade between Canada and Turkey is tiny – Turkey accounted for less than 0.3% of Canada’s total merchandise trade or C$4.34 billion ($3.09 billion) – bilateral trade has risen by nearly 50% in the past five years. “This trip is part of the geopolitical necessity of signaling to Americans that we are not sitting around waiting for them,” said Bessma Momani, professor of political science at the University of Waterloo. In the last year, Canada has signed more than 20 trade deals as part of Carney’s push to double non-US exports in the next decade. He flew to Beijing in January to reset fractured relations with [USN:P8N3X30AH TEXT:"China"], striking a deal that slashed tariffs on electric vehicles and canola. Despite criticism that China is a security risk, given Canadian authorities previously found China had interfered in at least two federal elections, Carney has described China as a “more predictable” trading partner than the US. However, Canada still sends nearly 70% of exports to the US. Turkey's crackdown on the opposition since 2024, and arrests targeting the LGBTQ+ community have drawn criticism. But Carney has focused less on rights than predecessors. “Carney will have to walk a very fine line in Turkey between opening new economic possibilities for Canada while trying to maintain Canada’s middle power role in fighting for equality,” said Anna Agathangelou, a professor of politics at York University. Ankara says the judiciary is independent, denying that investigations or court cases are politically motivated. At the NATO leaders' summit in July, Carney and Erdogan [USN:FWN43909C TEXT:"launched negotiations"] for a free-trade agreement, where Turkey also agreed to join Canada’s Defence, Security and Resilience Bank as a founding member. Turkey has held talks with Canadian engineering firm AtkinsRealis ATRL.TO as well as South Korea's Korea Electric Power Corporation and China's State Power Investment Corporation about potentially building its planned second and third nuclear power plants. In 2024, Canada removed weapons-export controls on Turkey, including on optical technology used in drones that Turkey exports to dozens of nations. Canada mainly exports lentils, aircraft and electronics to Turkey, and imports medical devices, fishing vessels, aircraft engines and jewelry. ($1 = 1.4052 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Japan's strong-armed $21 bln chip bet is low risk
item.description: Tokyo is funding two US factories and will share the profits with Washington under a trade pact. Returns on making low-end commoditised chips will underwhelm. Still, Abu Dhabi's GlobalFoundries is a safe partner and the deal could shore up supply chains at Japanese automakers.
item.dc:creator: Robyn Mak
item.content:encoded: Being bullied into a $21 billion deal is hardly ideal but that's the situation Tokyo finds itself in after agreeing to fund up to two new chip factories in the US. It falls under a $550 billion investment pact it struck last year with Washington in return for lower US tariffs on Japanese imports and as a way of [USN:L4N46102G TEXT:"dealing with"] President Donald Trump. At least for this venture, the risks look as low as the returns. The biggest winner is $26 billion GlobalFoundries (GFS.O) , owned by Abu Dhabi sovereign fund Mubadala. The contract chipmaker will construct and operate the first $10 billion factory without having to commit a single dollar of capital. In return, it will receive technology, construction and operating fees, as well as an undisclosed share of EBITDA after 2030, when the facility is due to start production. All together, GlobalFoundries executives reckon that will amount to $3 billion in cumulative adjusted free cash flow over the first 10 years. A second $11 billion factory is also under consideration, presumably with the same arrangement. It means Japan is bearing all of the risk. Per the wider terms of the 2025 agreement, Tokyo will also share half of available cash flows from the project with the US until it recoups its investment amount plus interest payments, after which 90% of profits will go to the US. Assuming a 5% discount rate, roughly the yield on 30-year US Treasuries, one analysis estimates projects would need to generate annual returns of at least 13% for Japan just to break even, reflecting the large share of profits that go to the US. Washington will also [USN:L6N45Z1AZ TEXT:"more than double"] its stake in GlobalFoundries to 7% as part of the deal, allowing it to capture more of the gains. Hitting that returns hurdle will be hard. GlobalFoundries specialises in churning out commoditised chips used in cars and smartphones. It had an average pre-tax return on invested capital of just 10.4% over the past five years, according to Visible Alpha, far below the roughly 50% at Taiwan's TSMC, which dominates in higher-margin cutting-edge processors. Tokyo can salvage some value elsewhere. The US factory can use Japanese equipment and components, boosting suppliers like Tokyo Electron. Moreover, Renesas, which designs semiconductors for auto giants like Toyota, can also benefit from diversifying manufacturing towards the new GlobalFoundries fabs and away from Taiwan, a democratically ruled island that Beijing claims as its own. And there are worse partners for Tokyo than Abu Dhabi. Perhaps the rich Gulf emirate will ultimately find a way to repay Japan in other ways. Follow Robyn Mak on X . GlobalFoundries on October 15 said it will operate two new semiconductor manufacturing facilities at its New York site. As part of the agreement, Japan will initially invest approximately $10 billion for the first factory that will begin construction by the end of 2026, and potentially another $11 billion in the future. GlobalFoundries, which is owned by Abu Dhabi's sovereign fund Mubadala, will provide technology as well as operating and construction expertise, and receive fees and eventually a share of earnings. The project falls under a US-Japan pact struck last year for Japan to invest $550 billion in the US in return for Washington lowering import trade tariffs. Per the arrangement with the US, Trump selects projects to be funded by Japan. Available free cash flow from investments will be split evenly between the two countries until Japan recoups an agreed-upon amount, after which 90% will go to the US. In a separate agreement, the US Department of Commerce will receive equity in GlobalFoundries of approximately 4%. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: テスラ、サイバーキャブの年内販売目指す 米当局は調査継続
item.description:
Abhirup Roy
[サンフランシスコ ２１日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは２１日、ロボタクシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テスラ、サイバーキャブの年内販売目指す　米当局は調査継続 10:56 配信

イーロン・マスク氏のイメージとテスラのロゴ。6月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Abhirup Roy

[サンフランシスコ ２１日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは２１日、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」の一般向け販売を年末までに開始することを目指していると明らかにした。同車には連邦規則が通常義務付けている手動操作装置がなく、米自動車安全当局が調査を進めている。

サイバーキャブは金色の２人乗り車両で、バタフライドアを備え、ハンドルやペダル、ミラーなしで自動走行する。

車両技術担当副社長のラース・モラビー氏は、第３・四半期決算発表後のアナリスト向け説明会で「テスラの成長に伴い、顧客に提供する車両は、自動運転専用に設計されたものが中心になる。サイバーキャブがその第１弾となる」と述べた。

「２０２６年末までにサイバーキャブを顧客に届けようとしている」とし、「今年は小規模にスタートし、顧客の手に渡る自動運転車の納車や保有、車両群の管理について学びながら規模を拡大していく」と語った。

テスラは９月上旬、テキサス州オースティンで少数のサイバーキャブによる有料乗車サービスを開始。しかし、その直後、米道路交通安全局（ＮＨＴＳＡ）は、同社がサイバーキャブについて連邦の自動車安全規則に適合すると判断した根拠を調べるため、調査を開始したと発表した。

大半の国では新型車や新技術の投入前に規制当局の承認が必要だが、米国では自動車メーカーが連邦基準への適合を自己認証すれば、公道に投入できる。

ＮＨＴＳＡはコメントを控えた。同局は９月、テスラによるサイバーキャブ認証の根拠と、どの範囲の基準について同車に適用されないと判断したのかを調べていると説明した。同社の回答期限は１０月３０日となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：減速するテスラ、頼みの綱は国内ライバル勢の出遅れ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 アングル：ロボタクシー拡大に慎重になったテスラ　投資家の不満解消できるか アングル：テスラのロボタクシー、導入済みテキサス3都市では課題山積 アングル：テスラの納車台数、26年予想下振れ　3年連続減少の見方も 最終更新: 10/22(木) 10:56 ロイター

item.title: Wild's top line likely to test Flames at both ends
item.description: The Minnesota Wild's top line is known for its offense.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Minnesota Wild's top line is known for its offense. Yet the trio of Kirill Kaprizov, Matt Boldy and Joel Eriksson Ek takes at least as much pride in its defense. Their coach thinks it means as much to them to shut down opposing lines as it does to score at the other end of the rink. The star-powered line will look to lead the way again when Minnesota faces the host Calgary Flames on Thursday night. The Wild are coming off one day of rest, while the Flames return to the ice after a three-day break. Kaprizov is the Wild's top threat with 17 points (11 goals, six assists) in 10 games. Quinn Hughes is next with 13 (two goals, 11 assists), Boldy is third with nine (five goals, four assists), and Eriksson Ek rounds out the top four with seven (two goals, five assists). Wild coach John Hynes praised Kaprizov, Boldy and Eriksson Ek for setting the tone at both ends of the ice during the team's hot start to the season. "It's really both," Hynes said. "Those three guys are as good on the offensive side of the puck as they are on the defensive side of the puck. They care about checking and defending. They pay strong attention to detail. ... That's why you respect that line because they play both sides of the puck really hard." Calgary is led by three players with five points apiece through the team's first eight games. The trio includes Morgan Frost (three goals, two assists), Matthew Coronato (two goals, three assists) and Joel Farabee (five assists). The Flames have lost six of their first eight games but are coming off a 3-2 home win over the defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes on Sunday. Calgary coach Ryan Huska said he was encouraged by his team's production against Carolina. During practice this week, he emphasized the importance of getting the puck deep into the offensive zone to set up scoring chances. "A lot of our issues this year have been giving up chances and 'Grade A' chances off the rush," Huska said. "A lot of it is sometimes poor decision (making) with the puck, a turnover higher in the zone or not making your opposing defenseman have to turn and go back to get pucks to wear them down as the night goes on. So, the better we are at that, the more we play in the offensive zone. "There's different ways you can go about doing that. Sometimes it's skating it into the zone. Other times, you're going to have to give it up and put it into an area where you can get it back." Minnesota's options in net include Jesper Wallstedt and Calvin Pickard. Wallstedt is 6-1-2 with a 2.20 goals-against average and a .915 save percentage in nine starts, while Pickard is 0-1-0 with a 5.00 GAA and an .800 save percentage in one start. Calgary could go with Dustin Wolf or Devin Cooley. Wolf is 1-4-0 with a 4.85 GAA and an .834 save percentage in five starts, while Cooley is 1-2-0 with a 4.01 GAA and an .868 save percentage in three starts. Flames captain Mikael Backlund missed practice this week because of an upper-body injury, and his status for Thursday is uncertain. If he cannot play, forward Ben Jones could make his team debut. --Field Level Media

item.title: 欧州新興企業、域外に大量流出リスク 規制など制約多く＝ＡＷＳ幹部
item.description:
Mehnaz Yasmin Deborah Mary Sophia
[２１日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コム...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州新興企業、域外に大量流出リスク　規制など制約多く＝ＡＷＳ幹部 10:44 配信

米アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウドサービス部門ＡＷＳのロゴ。2024年4月、独ハノーバーで撮影。 REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

Mehnaz Yasmin　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウドサービス部門ＡＷＳの幹部は２１日、ロイターのインタビューで、欧州の有望なスタートアップ企業が域外に大量流出するリスクが高まっていると警告した。規制上の障壁や資金不足、人材のスキル不足を背景に、これらの企業は域外への移転を検討しているという。

欧州は人工知能（ＡＩ）分野で米国や中国との差を縮めるのに苦戦。厳格な規制に加え、エネルギー制約やデータプライバシーへの懸念が足かせとなっており、最先端のＡＩモデルを独自に生み出した例は少ない。現在はオープンＡＩやアンソロピックなど海外企業への依存が続いている。

こうした中でＡＷＳの欧州・中東・アフリカ（ＥＭＥＡ）地域担当マネジングディレクター、タヌジャ・ランデリー氏は「欧州企業は１ユーロを投じるごとに最大０．４０ユーロを規制対応に費やしており、その分を技術投資に回せていないと話している」と述べた。

またＡＷＳが実施した調査を引用して「欧州のスタートアップのおよそ１０社に４社が、事業拡大のため域外への移転を検討している。急成長企業に限れば、その割合は半数を超える。スタートアップ企業は十分な資金や支援を得られないことから、拠点の見直しを進めていると訴えている」と語った。

ランデリー氏によると、欧州企業の半数超がＡＩを活用している一方、明確なＡＩ戦略を持ち、ＡＩガバナンス体制を整備し、業務変革に向けた投資を進めている企業は５社に１社にとどまる。特に推論分野への投資を進める必要があるという。

欧州では世界で最も厳しいＡＩ規制の１つとされる欧州連合（ＥＵ）のＡＩ法や、深刻な電力・送電網制約が発展の妨げとなっている。

ランデリー氏は「欧州はより迅速に行動する必要がある。安全性と進歩は二者択一ではなく、両立できるものだ」と強調した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：長時間労働・残業に不満の中国労働者、ＥＵの対中圧力に「共感」 最終更新: 10/22(木) 10:44 ロイター

item.title: India bank capital fail is more farce than tragedy
item.description: Sumitomo-backed Yes Bank has been ordered to restore $884 mln of AT1 bonds written off in its 2020 rescue. Their role was a comedy of errors from start to finish. The irony is that the lender's turnaround has made it strong enough to take this latest, painful hit in its stride.
item.dc:creator: Ujjaini Dutta
item.content:encoded: Yes Bank (YESB.NS) is being forced to revisit an existential crisis. Last week India's Supreme Court upheld a ruling ordering the $5.6 billion lender to restore 84 billion rupees ($884 million) of additional Tier 1 capital bonds written off as part of its 2020 collapse. The Reserve Bank of India and the government joined the bank in unsuccessfully appealing the decision. The ruling caps what has been a comedy of errors. The irony is that the lender's turnaround has made it strong enough to take this latest, painful hit in its stride. The rescue itself was necessary and successful. The lender was pushed into administration in March 2020 after bad loans piled up. Authorities stitched together a $1.4 billion bailout led by State Bank of India (SBI.NS) with help from HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) , ICICI Bank (ICBK.NS) and five others. The lender returned to profitability two years later and until last week's ruling boasted a common equity Tier 1 capital ratio higher than its state-backed rescuer. Yes Bank also bagged a new deep-pocketed shareholder : Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (8316.T) picked up a 25% stake last year. The AT1 bonds case has come back to haunt the bank, though, because of a series of curious flubs at the time. First, the draft turnaround plan explicitly provided for writing them down, but the key bond clause was missing in the final version. Second, India's regulatory framework mandates that AT1 capital be written down before the restructuring process takes effect, not as part of it. And the bank's administrator lacked the authority to wipe them out anyway. Yes Bank's strong comeback at least means reviving the bonds won't kill it. Sure, accounting for the reappearance of the AT1 bonds means its near-11 billion rupee profit in the three months to the end of September would dive to a 52 billion rupee loss. It would also lop 2.3 percentage points off its Common Equity Tier 1 ratio, reducing it to 11.4%, lower than many of its rivals. The prospect of paying the up to 9.5% coupon on the bonds - possibly including accrued interest since 2020 - would sting even more. But the bank is in good enough shape to weather this new storm. Boss Vinay Muralidhar Tonse says that there's no immediate rush to raise capital. And while shareholders wiped some 20%, or $1.4 billion, off the bank's stock market value in the three trading sessions after the ruling, the dip suggests they're concerned only about lost earnings, not a return to a full-blown crisis. That's not the victory the bank was hoping for, but it could have been far worse. Follow Ujjaini Dutta on LinkedIn and X . India's Supreme Court on October 15 set aside Yes Bank's write-off of 84 billion rupees in additional Tier 1 bonds under a restructuring scheme six years ago. The Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation-backed lender’s AT1 bondholders had challenged the write-off, and the Bombay High Court ruled in their favour in 2023. Yes Bank, the Reserve Bank of India and the federal government appealed that ruling, but the Supreme Court upheld the lower court's decision. The Supreme Court said the bank's administrator did not have the power to write down the bonds after the restructuring scheme was finalised, and ruled that the write-off was "impermissible". The lender on October 17 reported a 65% jump in net profit to 10.80 billion Indian rupees for the September quarter, but said the figure does not reflect the impact of court ruling. Had the impact been recognised, the bank would have posted a quarterly loss of 52.17 billion rupees, it said in a filing. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Epic's 'Fortnite' back on Apple App Store in Australia after antitrust ruling
item.description: Epic Games said its shooter title "Fortnite" will return to Apple's App Store in Australia on Thursday after a federal court ordered the iPhone maker to open up its iOS operating system, having found it violated competition law.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Epic Games said its shooter title "Fortnite" will return to Apple's (AAPL.O) App Store in Australia on Thursday after a federal court ordered the iPhone maker to open up its iOS operating system, having found it violated competition law. Apple said it disagreed with many of the court's findings and would seek to challenge them. "We will request a stay and appeal the outcome to seek a resolution that respects our intellectual property and protects the safe, secure experience that consumers and developers expect from the App Store," an Apple spokesperson told Reuters.

item.title: ロシア、日本に「敵対的行為」と警告 テラドローンのウクライナ納入巡り
item.description: ロシア外務省は21日、日本企業のテラドローンによるウクライナへのドローン（無人機）販売を「敵対的」な行為と見なすと表明し、厳しい対応を取ると警告した。 ザハロワ報道官は、テラドローンがウクライナへのドローン納入を先週発表したことを受けた対応だと説明。定例記者会見で「テラドローンがウクライナ軍と協力していることは単なる『民間主導の取り組み』に過ぎないとして、これを正当化しようとする日本当局の試みは全く説得力に欠ける」と述べた。
