item.title: STRICTLY EMBARGOED UNTIL WEDS 11PM - U.S. climate champion Gina McCarthy honoured in Reuters Global Sustainability awards
item.description: Gina McCarthy seems remarkably chipper given the seemingly relentless opposition to climate action, led by her own government under President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Oliver Balch
item.content:encoded: Gina McCarthy seems remarkably chipper given the seemingly relentless opposition to climate action, led by her own government under President Donald Trump. McCarthy, who was head of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency during the Obama administration, and White House climate adviser under Joe Biden, accepts that her view isn’t universally held. “It may sound a little crazy to people,” she says. “But I'm really bullish on what's happening next.” She spoke to The Ethical Corporation on the eve of Reuters Global Sustainability Awards, where she was honoured with a Lifetime Achievement award, in recognition of spending more than three decades “at the forefront of America's fight for cleaner air, safer water, and a liveable climate”. Her bullishness was also clear in her acceptance speech, which was delivered by video from her home outside Boston. “Despite all the nonsense from my federal government and their fossil fuel allies, there has been a massive surge this past year in clean energy,” she said, with state and local governments from across the U.S. “working together to drive a more aggressive energy transition ... with a relentless spirit of optimism”. McCarthy will be taking that optimistic spirit to next month’s United Nations’ climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, as chair of America Is All In , a coalition of pro-climate U.S. cities, states, corporations and community groups. Newly assembled solar panels at a new solar facility in Humble, Texas, US, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Antranik Tavitian “We don't want the rest of the world to think that the United States is what Trump says. The United States is what our state and local governments say,” she tells The Ethical Corporation. With the U.S. midterm elections, in the week prior to COP31, expected to restore the House of Representatives to Democratic control and weaken Republicans’ grip on the Senate, that message will be even easier to sell. She cites Illinois, which has passed legislation to add 3 gigawatts of battery storage to its grid by 2030, and California, which plans to modernise its already pioneering carbon credit programme. Cleveland, Ohio, meanwhile, is pursuing a new five-year plan to cut emissions by nearly two-thirds (against 2018 levels). Sceptics will note that all the examples derive from strongly Democrat-controlled constituencies, but McCarthy points out that the Republican stronghold of Texas is home to a substantial portion of the record additions of solar and battery projects added to the U.S. grid in the past year. McCarthy has long believed that for the average U.S. voter, economics trump ideology when it comes to powering their homes and businesses. A drone view shows California’s largest battery storage facility, as it nears completion on a 43-acre site in Menifee, California, U.S., March 28, 2024. REUTERS/Mike Blake The relative affordability of renewable power compared to fossil fuels makes it increasingly attractive to householders, in the face of a monthly inflation rate of 3.4%. Corporations, meanwhile, have been leaning heavily into renewable energy, mindful not only of rising energy costs but growing threats to energy security. According to the business-backed Corporate Energy Buyers Association (CEBA), corporate-sponsored clean energy projects in 2025 exceeded the total power generation of 45 individual U.S. states. With U.S. investment in the global clean energy transition now running at around $378 billion, it may seem like supporters of America Is All In, who collectively represent 63% of the U.S. population and 74% of U.S. GDP, can rest easy. Gina McCarthy pictured in Washington in 2014 as she arrives to sign a proposal under the Clean Air Act to cut carbon pollution from existing power plants. REUTERS/Joshua Roberts Yet having seen many of the environmental advances made under her watch rolled back by the Trump Administration, McCarthy is far from complacent. In mid-September, for example, the EPA, which she headed up between 2013 and 2017, said it planned to desist from regulating greenhouse gas emissions from the power sector. According to America Is All In, the proposed move could see a potential ten-fold increase in coal-fired power, with severe impacts on greenhouse gas emissions but also human health. “To have this (Clean Power Plan) arbitrarily taken off the books by this administration was absolutely ludicrous. It had nothing but benefits,” she says. Another policy reversal that she admits was “not easy” to watch was the scrapping of the EPA’s landmark 2009 Greenhouse Gas Endangerment Finding , barring the agency from tracking and capping emissions from cars and heavy-duty vehicles. But it was the dilution of the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) that McCarthy deems the most consequential of all the Trump administration’s recent moves to halt transition efforts. Introduced in the wake of the COVID pandemic, the IRA earmarked around $485 billion in public spending and tax breaks for investments in healthcare, clean tech and other transition-related investments. Its dismantlement continues to incense McCarthy, who describes it as “one of the biggest opportunities that our country ever had” to provide U.S. citizens with clean, secure and affordable energy. A drone view shows Elon Musk's xAI Colossus 2 "Macrohard" data centre in Southaven, Mississippi, U.S., May 30, 2026. REUTERS/Kevin Wurm Yet her response is typically indefatigable. “You know, we all have to pull up our big boy, big girl pants when these challenges happen.” Fuelling her confidence are two fundamental convictions; namely, that people will be ultimately won over by clean power’s cost competitiveness, and will also realise that “this administration isn’t forever”. She takes heart from the multiple lawsuits now being brought by state authorities and campaign groups against various efforts by the Trump administration to weaken environmental protections. Earlier this month, a coalition of 25 cities and states – including New York, California, North Carolina and Washington D.C. – issued a petition to the U.S. court of appeals for the District of Columbia to review the EPA’s proposal to remove emission standards for power plants. Also encouraging is the spirit of cross-sector collaboration that is now emerging across the U.S. She points to the C40 Global Urban Data Centres Pact . A new mayor-led initiative endorsed by 49 cities, including 22 in the U.S., seeks to promote greater public accountability in the management of resource-hungry data centres. The pact, which includes Chicago, Austin, Seattle and Miami, comes on the back of increasing disquiet in the U.S. over the water and energy consumption of AI data centres. While McCarthy acknowledges the potential economic benefits of such facilities, she argues that companies and regulators have not paid enough attention at their environmental and community impacts. She would like to see tax revenues from data centres used to help fund renewable energy projects and community infrastructure. “They (data centres) are one of the fastest-growing challenges that we have in the United States,” she says. “There has to be a way to ensure that they can do their thing without destroying us.” Reuters Events Global Sustainability Awards 2026: other winners AI for Sustainability Excellence Award — Winner : Tracera; Highly Commended : Jupiter Intelligence Biodiversity Champion Award — Winner: Olam Agri; Highly Commended : Rainforest Expeditions Business Transformation Award — Winner : Pure Data Centres Group; Highly Commende d: Pandora Circularity Award — Winner : LIXIL Corporation; Highly Commended : Groupe SEB Data-driven Sustainability Communication Award — Winner : Syngenta Group; Highly Commended : Diversified Energy Company Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Award — Winner : Atlas Renewable Energy; Highly Commended : Halkbank Leadership in Water Stewardship Award — Winner : SPG Dry Cooling; Highly Commended : Nestle Waters & Premium Beverages Net Zero: Leadership Award — Winner : Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited; Highly Commended : Edison International Net Zero: Operations Transformation Award — Winner : Cushman & Wakefield and Standard Chartered; Highly Commended : Bodycote plc Net Zero: Supply Chain Decarbonisation Award — Winner : Schneider Electric; Highly Commended : AstraZeneca Partnership of the Year Award — Winner : Hindustan Unilever Limited; Highly Commended : Aviva Product Innovation Award — Winner : Hitachi Energy; Highly Commended : Fairphone Responsible Investor of the Year Award — Winner : Circulate Capital; Highly Commended : EFG Holding Rising Sustainability Star Award — Winner : Daniel Kopp; Highly Commended: Marine Sanouiller SDG Pioneer of the Year Award — Winner : Telkom Indonesia; Highly Commended : Sunbeth Global Concepts Ltd. item.title: North Korea's Kim Yo Jong warns South Korea, says border loudspeakers to be ready within days
item.description: North Korea will place anti-South Korea loudspeakers on standby along the entire border within days and has put unspecified new countermeasures on alert, Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea's leader, said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: North Korea will place anti-South Korea loudspeakers on standby along the entire border within days and has put unspecified new countermeasures on alert, Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea's leader, said on Thursday. The statement came with a warning to Seoul of "the most horrible and distressing situation" if South Korea continued what Pyongyang calls interference in the North's internal affairs. On Wednesday evening, after she visited fortification sites with senior military officials, Kim said North Korea would [USN:L1N46706V TEXT:"activate"] anti-South Korea loudspeakers across the border by the end of October. She said North Korean tactical units had taken up new positions and accused South Korean troops of conducting warning broadcasts and warning shots at multiple locations near the border. South Korea said warning shots had been fired as "legitimate and defensive measures". Kim warned that North Korean troops would "mercilessly eliminate" South Korean forces if warning fire resulted in harm to North Korean territory or personnel. South Korea's military and Unification Ministry urged North Korea to return to talks to resolve differences. The military said Kim's statements showed that measures taken with the UN Command to strengthen control in the demilitarized zone were having an effect. The defence ministry told a news briefing that Seoul would take "proportionate measures" if North Korea acted on its threats, although no decision had been made. LOUDSPEAKER THREAT ADDS PRESSURE ON SEOUL The fresh threats from Pyongyang deal a blow to South Korean President Lee Jae Myung’s efforts to ease inter-Korean hostility and raise tensions along the heavily fortified frontier to their highest level since he took office in June last year. Both North and South Korea have historically used loudspeakers to broadcast propaganda across the border, with South Korean broadcasts featuring K-pop music and news that have long irked Pyongyang and prompted tit-for-tat responses. The two Koreas are separated by a demilitarized zone established after the 1950-53 Korean War ended in an armistice. North Korea has been reinforcing its side of the DMZ with mines, barriers and fencing since 2024 as it seeks to establish what it calls a permanent border with South Korea. South Korea says North Korean mines planted as part of its fortification activity in the DMZ caused a blast last month that seriously wounded two soldiers. North Korea denies responsibility, calling the incident a South Korean fabrication. Since taking office, Lee has pursued a policy of diplomatic engagement and tension reduction with North Korea despite Pyongyang's refusal to resume dialogue and its designation of South Korea as a hostile state. His administration halted South Korean loudspeaker broadcasts and [USN:L1N3TW05E TEXT:"dismantled"] fixed border loudspeakers last year, steps Seoul described as key confidence-building measures, and after which North Korea suspended its own broadcasts toward the South. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Seoul's Kyungnam University, said Kim's latest warnings did not necessarily mean the loudspeakers would be immediately activated. But they presented Lee's administration with an "enormous dilemma", he said, as it faced a choice between maintaining its policy of peaceful engagement and containing aggressive North Korean military activity along the border.

item.title: Fernandes questions United's tactics after Como hammering
item.description: Manager Michael Carrick's position is under pressure with United winless in seven matches.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes said his side failed to apply enough pressure and adopted a "mood of defeat" after conceding early in Wednesday's [USN:L6N46717X TEXT:"4–1 Champions League loss at Como"], a result that increased scrutiny on manager Michael Carrick. Como opened the scoring in the second minute and United collapsed, with only a stoppage‑time consolation goal from Joshua Zirkzee making the scoreline slightly less severe. "We started on the wrong foot and they scored very early," Fernandes told TNT Sports. "There was not enough pressure on the ball and not many good movements off the ball. There were many things not going our way. "It's a decision from the (coaching) staff not to press man-to-man and sometimes leave space behind and try to get the ball, wait for them, but sometimes when you give space to these teams they get confidence," he said. Asked if his comments amounted to criticism of Carrick's tactics, Fernandes said: "That's on the manager and staff to see, not me. "Sometimes you have to be more brave under pressure, take the risk of pressing high and making them uncomfortable." Carrick's position has come under increasing pressure with United now winless in seven matches. "It was more than disappointing," the 45-year-old manager told TNT Sports. "I think everybody's got to take responsibility for that. I'll take responsibility for the overall team and performance, it stops with me and I'm fine with that. "But as a supporter of this football club, to see a performance like that is unacceptable, I have to say." Carrick said his side had failed to show the required intensity. "It's the motivation and the purpose and the intensity of a game of football that you have to bring. We didn't bring that today," he said. "I've got to apologise for the performance." Fernandes also questioned United's mentality after the early setback. "Conceding early makes us go into the game with a mood of defeat," he said. United have three points from their opening three Champions League matches and host AS Roma in their next fixture in the competition.

item.title: Chinese-linked hackers compromise ConnectWise, target hundreds in global attack, Microsoft says
item.description: Microsoft said the hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise as part of a campaign targeting hundreds of organizations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Chinese state-aligned hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise as part of a campaign that targeted hundreds of organizations globally, Microsoft said on Wednesday. Based on Microsoft's analysis and evidence available to ConnectWise, "it appears that a China state-aligned group was responsible for the attack on ConnectWise Cloud Backup," ConnectWise CEO Manny Rivelo said in a separate statement . Rivelo said ConnectWise "contained the affected application connections and are restoring services in controlled phases," and that "those actions do not remove unauthorized access that may have already been established within individual customer tenants, which require separate review." A spokesperson for the Chinese Embassy in Washington said China "opposes and fights hacking activities in accordance with the law. At the same time, we oppose smears and attacks against China under the excuse of cybersecurity issues." The hackers, which Microsoft tracks as Storm-0940, used an open-source penetration testing framework called ARTEX to carry out the campaign, Microsoft said. There are multiple tools used to conduct penetration testing, a form of legitimate testing of the security of networks or services. ARTEX allows users to use any AI model to automate a variety of penetration testing tasks and can be configured to run autonomous tasks including reconnaissance and data exfiltration, Microsoft said. The attack targeted organizations across a variety of sectors, including aerospace, defense, automotive, chemicals, energy, financial services, government, legal, manufacturing, media, military, semiconductor, software, technology, think tanks and non-profit organizations, Microsoft said. While the majority of targeting was not successful, Microsoft said, Storm-0940 achieved privileged cloud persistence — or high-level access that could continue even after cleanup efforts — at many organizations in a brief time.

Oct 21 : Walmart on Wednesday intrduced new tools that will allow artificial intelligence agents to shop and complete transactions for customers, as the retailer seeks to position itself in the growing use of AI-powered assistants in online commerce. The move underscores Walmart's push into AI-enabled shopping, and strikes a contrast with Amazon, which has sought to limit third-party AI shopping agents' access to its platform. Here are the details: • The retailer said it will roll out "Agent Profiles" next month, enabling shoppers to authorize individual AI agents, track their purchases separately and set spending limit or require approval for each transaction

• Walmart said customers would be able to monitor purchases made by AI agents separately from their own orders and revoke agent access at any time • The tools instilled confidence in the "experimental" shopping process of agentic purchases, said Mizuho analyst David Bellinger in a note • "... the momentum and buy-in from top management teams seems to be making this into a real thing," Bellinger added. • The company also launched the "Walmart Agent Gateway," a platform that allows AI assistants such as OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini and Meta's Muse to connect directly with Walmart and Sam's Club systems to search products and complete purchases • Walmart said customers would remain in control of purchases, while AI agents would be barred from accessing payment card data and could be blocked for violating company rules • The company said the tools will be available to all Walmart account holders and will not require a Walmart+ membership

Oct 21 : Crocodilians — today's crocodiles, alligators, caimans and gharials and their many extinct relatives — have been a roaring success since debuting more than 240 million years ago. And new research identifies one important factor in their success — stubbornly keeping to warm climates throughout their history. In fact, the researchers said, this trait may help explain why crocs as a group survived the asteroid strike 66 million years ago that doomed the dinosaurs, along with certain physiological characteristics that make them one tough bunch of reptiles. The crocodilian evolutionary lineage, called Pseudosuchia, arose during the Triassic Period in the aftermath of Earth's worst mass extinction event at the end of the Permian, appearing on the scene millions of years before the first dinosaurs and mammals. The researchers tracked the geographic range for crocs during their entire history, guided by an evolutionary tree of more than 400 extinct and living species. They used data from more than 7,000 fossils and geographic records of modern crocs such as the alligators of Florida, saltwater crocodiles of Australia, gharials of India, caimans of Brazil and more.

They combined this information with 52 global palaeoclimate reconstructions to determine the climatic conditions under which crocs lived over time. While other groups such as dinosaurs and mammals conquered a variety of climates, the study showed that crocs consistently kept to warm climes. "Rather than continually adapting to new climatic conditions, they largely tracked suitable environments as these shifted geographically, expanding towards the poles during warmer periods and retreating towards the equator during cooler ones," said University College London vertebrate paleontologist Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, lead author of the research published in the journal Science Advances. For example, during an exceptionally warm moment in Earth's history around 50 million years ago, Chiarenza said, crocs inhabited high-latitude regions of North America, Europe and even Antarctica. "One of the most striking patterns is the repeated expansion and contraction of suitable habitat in response to global temperature changes," Chiarenza said. While living crocs are primarily semiaquatic ambush predators, their extinct relatives included a broad diversity of forms, University College London paleontologist and study co-author Philip Mannion said. "They have occupied almost every conceivable ecological role," Chiarenza said. There were fully land-dwelling apex predators like 30-foot-long (9-meter-long) Fasolasuchus, pug-snouted herbivores like Simosuchus, armored plant-eaters like Aetosaurus, mollusk-eaters like Kuttanacaiman, filter-feeders like Mourasuchus and ocean-going types like Metriorhynchus. During the age of dinosaurs, there also were semiaquatic crocs like Deinosuchus up to 40 feet (12 meters) long that may have rivaled Tyrannosaurus in mass. "Modern crocodilians are only the surviving remnants of a once extraordinarily diverse evolutionary group," Chiarenza said. DISASTER FROM ABOVE The asteroid strike at a site called Chicxulub off the coast of Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula at the end of the Cretaceous unleashed a global environmental cataclysm. Three-quarters of Earth's species including the dinosaurs, aside from their bird descendants, vanished. The crocs survived. "The Chicxulub impact caused a dramatic reduction in incoming sunlight, producing an impact winter and widespread environmental disruption. However, our climate simulations suggest that this cooling did not affect the availability of suitable climatic conditions equally for all groups," Chiarenza said. "Under all but the most extreme impact scenario we tested, tropical and subtropical regions retained climatic conditions suitable" for the crocs, Chiarenza said. This suggests that the longstanding association of crocs with warm and low-latitude environments may have placed some surviving populations in geographic refuges near the equator and in the subtropics where climatic conditions remained within their tolerances, Chiarenza said. For dinosaurs, there was a collapse of suitable habitat under these impact conditions. Crocs also possess physiological traits beneficial for times of environmental stress. They can enter states of dormancy to cope with harsh conditions — aestivation to survive extreme heat or drought, and brumation to withstand extreme cold. Crocs today, for instance, may dig burrows or encase themselves in hardened mud during severe droughts, slowing their heartbeat and breathing. "Following the Chicxulub impact, when sunlight was dramatically reduced and terrestrial primary productivity collapsed, the ability to reduce energy expenditure and survive periods of limited food availability could have been extremely advantageous," Chiarenza said. Crocs also are cold-blooded, while recent research points to at least some dinosaurs including Tyrannosaurus as warm-blooded. Baseline metabolic requirements for cold-blooded animals are much lower than for comparably sized warm-blooded animals. "That can become a significant advantage when food becomes scarce. Crocodilians can survive extended periods without feeding," Chiarenza said. "But even if an animal can survive prolonged starvation, it still needs environmental conditions that remain within its physiological limits."

Source: Reuters

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＩＢＭ、7─9月売上高・利益が予想超え　時間外で株価4％高 6:04 配信

米ＩＢＭのロゴ。スイス・ダボスで１月撮影。REUTERS/Romina Amato

Anhata Rooprai

[２１日　ロイター] - 米ＩＢＭが２１日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）決算は、売上高と利益が市場予想を上回った。ソフトウエア事業の年間売上高見通しも引き上げた。ジェームズ・カバノー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、前四半期に投資家の動揺を招いたソフトウエア契約の遅れについて、成約が始まりつつあると述べた。

カバノー氏はロイターのインタビューで、ＩＢＭの年間ソフトウエア売上高の伸び率は約７─８％になるとの新たな見通しを示した。従来予想は６─８％だった。ＩＢＭの株価は時間外取引で約４％上昇した。

同社の第３・四半期売上高は４．７％増の１７１億ドルで、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１６８億２０００万ドルを上回った。調整後１株当たり利益は２．９５ドルと、市場予想の２．８６ドルを上回った。

ソフトウエア売上高は８．３％増の７８億ドルと、市場予想の７６億２０００万ドルを上回った。インフラ部門の売上高は４．２％増の３７億１０００万ドル。

item.title: 米メタ、投資拡大へ無議決権株発行 ＡＩエージェント急拡大
item.description:
Jaspreet Singh
[２１日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは２１日、年間設備投資見通しの下限を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米メタ、投資拡大へ無議決権株発行　ＡＩエージェント急拡大 5:43 配信

２０２５年１月撮影　REUTERS/Yves Herman

Jaspreet Singh

[２１日　ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは２１日、年間設備投資見通しの下限を引き上げるとともに、無議決権株を新たに発行すると発表した。巨額の投資が必要なＡＩ（人工知能）事業拡大の資金を調達する。消費者向けＡＩエージェントアプリ「ミューズ」の利用が急拡大していることも明らかにした。

この日発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドル。ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回り、株価は時間外取引で４％超上昇した。

メタは２０２７年１月に議決権のない新たなクラスＣ普通株を発行する。実質的には１対２の株式分割となる。ＡＩ開発競争が激化する中、マーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の支配権を維持しつつ、企業買収や優秀な人材の確保に必要な資金を調達することが狙い。

ザッカーバーグ氏は、米国とカナダでは１カ月半で１０００万人超がミューズのアカウントを開設し、その後も力強い伸びが続いていると指摘。ミューズが「数十億人」に利用されるようになり、メタの平均的なユーザーよりも多くの収益を生み出す可能性があるとの見方を示した。

２６年の設備投資額見通しは１３５０億─１４５０億ドル。従来見通しは１３００億─１４５０億ドルだった。

第３・四半期のフリーキャッシュフロー（ＦＣＦ）は２１億２０００万ドルのマイナス。前年同期は１０６億３０００万ドルのプラスだった。

第４・四半期の業績見通しは、売上高が７３０億─７６０億ドル。市場予想は７３７億３０００万ドルだった。

ザッカーバーグ氏は声明で「われわれの投資は成果を上げている。中核事業は好調で、全分野で勢いがみられる」とした。

＜高いコスト＞

ただ、ザッカーバーグ氏は、ミューズにかかるコストが、これまで投入してきた多くの新製品より高いと認めた。収益化については「通常の進め方よりもやや早く」着手すると述べた。 スーザン・リー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、ＡＩ事業が２７年に収益の上積みに寄与し始め、「長期的には収益源の多様化に大きく貢献する」との見通しを示した。

消費者向けＡＩエージェントのミューズが早くも人気を集め、競争力のある新たなＡＩモデル群も公開されたことで、メタは投資家に巨額支出の妥当性を説明しやすくなった。ただ、セキュリティー懸念から、ミューズによるアクセスを制限している企業もある。

インベスティング・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、ジェシー・コーエン氏は「市場はメタの支出を嫌気する姿勢から、魅力的な製品の成長シナリオを評価する姿勢へと変わった」と述べた。

一方、法的問題も増えている。ニューメキシコ州の地裁は２１日、メタに対し２５０億ドルの支払いを命じた。１６年の米大統領選でトランプ陣営に関与した政治コンサルティング会社がフェイスブック利用者数百万人のデータを本人の同意なく取得したとされる問題を巡る訴訟で、陪審がメタは利用者を欺いていたと認定したことを受けた。

イーマーケターのシニアアナリスト、ミンダ・スマイリー氏は、２５０億ドルの制裁金について「メタが現在直面している法的問題の深刻さを改めて示している。こうした問題は２７年も続く」と述べた。さらに「ＡＩエージェントが一段と普及すれば、プライバシーと安全性に関する疑問や懸念は強まるばかりだ。この分野でのメタの評判を踏まえると、最終的に同社に打撃を与える可能性がある」と語った。

さらに８月には、メタのプラットフォームが子どもを依存させるよう設計されているとして米国のほぼ全州が起こした訴訟で、同社は１０年間で最大１８０億ドルを支払い、１０代の若者によるフェイスブックとインスタグラムの利用を制限することで和解した。

第３・四半期の希薄化後１株利益（ＥＰＳ）は３．８３ドルだったが、この和解に関連する９８億９０００万ドルの費用計上がなければ、７．４０ドルだったとしている。

この和解により、メタの株価の重しとなっていた規制面の大きな懸案が解消した。また、若年利用者への対応に関する社内文書がさらに公開される恐れがあった裁判も回避できた。

ただ、メタは２１日に示した業績見通しで、若年層に関する問題を巡る監視や米国での裁判に引き続き直面しており、業績に影響する可能性があると警告した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/22(木) 8:40 ロイター

Oct 21 : Texas Instruments forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign of recovery in industrial chip demand and growing momentum for its AI data-center chips. • Unlike Nvidia, which makes high-performance AI processors, Dallas, Texas-based TI produces analog chips that manage power and convert real-world inputs such as sound, light and temperature into digital signals for other semiconductors to process • The analog chipmaker expects fourth-quarter revenue between $5.80 billion and $6.30 billion, above analysts' average estimate of $5.73 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. • Quarterly profit is expected to be between $2.45 and $2.79 per share

item.title: 米テスラ、設備投資見通し引き下げ 第3四半期はフリーキャッシュフロー黒字
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２１日発表した第３・四半期決算は、人工知能（ＡＩ）とロボット事...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米テスラ、設備投資見通し引き下げ　第3四半期はフリーキャッシュフロー黒字 5:35 配信

米テスラのロゴとイーロン・マスク氏のシルエット。６月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２１日　ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２１日発表した第３・四半期決算は、人工知能（ＡＩ）とロボット事業への支出が市場予想を大幅に下回り、フリーキャッシュフロー（ＦＣＦ）が予想外の黒字となった。年間の設備投資見通しも２割引き下げた。

予想外のＦＣＦ黒字は、テスラにとって重要な局面で実現した。イーロン・マスク氏は２０日、自身が率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸとテスラの経営統合は「良い案だ」と述べ、両社が統合を協議する特別委員会を設置したことを明らかにした。

支出削減は統合に向けてテスラの財務基盤を強化する一方、ＡＩ、自動運転タクシー（ロボタクシー）、人型ロボットへの投資を抑えて手元資金を確保すれば、投資家が期待する成長シナリオそのものを損なう恐れがある。

テスラ株は時間外取引で、ＦＣＦの黒字や売上総利益率の上昇、市場予想を上回る売上高を受けて一時２％上昇したが、その後は２％安に転じた。２０２６年に入ってからの下落率は約１４％となっている。

テスラに連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を提供するディレクションで商品・戦略担当シニアバイスプレジデントを務めるライアン・リー氏は「フリーキャッシュフローが予想を上回ったのはうれしい驚きだったが、設備投資が予想を下回ったことと合わせて考えると、テスラの次の一手に疑問が生じる」と指摘。「設備投資の少なさは、ＡＩ開発競争に対する姿勢が、マスク氏から想像するほど『全力投入』ではないことを示唆している」と語った。

テスラは２６年の設備投資見通しを約２００億ドルとし、従来の２５０億ドル超から引き下げた。ただ、どの分野の支出を減らすかは明らかにしなかった。

第３・四半期の設備投資は４７億ドルと、前年同期の２倍超となったものの、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の７５億ドルを下回った。

フリーキャッシュフローは１５億３０００万ドルの黒字。予想は４９億２０００万ドルの赤字だった。

＜スペースＸとの統合協議＞

マスク氏は２１日のアナリスト向け電話会議で、テスラとスペースＸの経営統合について、これ以上話すことはないと述べた。

統合が実現すれば、ＡＩ、エネルギー、ロボット、通信に加え、地上から宇宙に至る輸送までを網羅する技術・製造の一大企業体が誕生し、マスク氏の長期構想の中核を担うことになる。

ただ、ロボタクシーの展開がマスク氏の公約より遅れる中、投資家は同氏の構想を商業化するのに十分な投資をテスラが行っているか、裏付けを求めるだろう。最近はエネルギー部門が自動車事業を補う役割を果たしている。世界の競合各社が、より新しく、多くの場合より安価なモデルを投入する中、テスラの自動車事業には依然厳しい目が向けられている。同社は発売から時間が経過した「モデル３」と「モデルＹ」に大きく依存している。

インベスティング・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、トーマス・モンテイロ氏は「（スペースＸとの）統合のハードルは依然として高いが、今晩の決算を受け、財務面での合理性は無視しにくくなった」とした上で「重要なのは、テスラの四半期キャッシュフローが予想外の黒字になったのは利益が増えたためではなく、支出が計画を数十億ドル下回ったためだという点だ。一方でスペースＸは、１四半期に最大４００億ドルを投資する準備を進めている」と述べた。

＜売上高横ばい、市場予想は上回る＞

第３・四半期の売上高は、２５年に販売を支えた米国の税額控除が終了したにもかかわらず、前年同期比で横ばいとなり、市場予想を上回った。純利益は４３％減少した。

テスラは声明で、乗用車の受注残が四半期末時点で過去４年間で最多となったと表明した。ガソリン高が特に欧州でＥＶ需要を押し上げた。

車両納車台数は４８万６５３２台で、年間ベースで３年ぶりの増加となる見通し。

マスク氏はアナリスト向け電話会議で「当社の車両への需要は急速に伸びており、生産を大幅に上回っている」と述べた。「一言で言えば、長年にわたり苦労が続き、ほぼ横ばいの状況だったが、今や大いに楽しみで、大幅な成長が見込める局面に向かっていると思う」と語った。

テスラによると、北米で納車した新車のうち、運転者の監視が必要な運転支援機能「ＦＳＤ」の利用契約を結んだ車両の割合は４分の３を超え、第２・四半期から約２０％ポイント上昇した。

規制クレジットを除く自動車部門の売上総利益率は１８．１％で、ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想の１６．７％を上回った。

テスラは年間生産台数について、２６年の見込みの２５０万台から、３０年ごろまでに５００万台に引き上げることを目指すとした。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：出遅れ気味の米不動産株、持ち直し期待高まる 焦点：後退する米企業役員の多様性、トランプ米大統領の政策反映 コラム：「米国例外主義」なお健在、外国投資家のテック株流入持続が示唆 アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで 最終更新: 10/22(木) 9:35 ロイター

item.title: Lawmakers say US briefing showed Russia targeting Democrats with misinformation
item.description: The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Landay
item.content:encoded: The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. The comments by Senator Mark Warner and Representative Jim Himes come as Republican President Donald Trump has in recent weeks eased economic sanctions on Russia and increased pressure on Ukraine to end its fight against Russian forces. Warner and Himes told reporters they were limited in revealing what they had learned in an election security briefing that they had requested from Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton because it was classified. But, they said, Russia was waging the same kind of online misinformation campaign that the US intelligence community had tracked in US elections in 2016, 2020, and 2024. "And the state of play, I would argue, is that, you know, Russia, similar to prior occasions, is going after Democrats," Warner said. He noted news reports that Democrat James Talarico, who is running for the US Senate in Texas, and Senator Jon Ossoff, who is seeking re-election in Georgia, "in particular are being dinged" by fake advertisements created with AI. The White House and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Russian embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Moscow in the past has denied meddling in US elections. Himes said the pair could not provide details of the misinformation spread by Russia because the material was classified. But he added that Moscow's conduct has been "the same old, same old." "The Russians are kind of throwing everything out there," said Himes. "Chaos, you know, don't trust your voting machines." He added there was "no reason to believe" that China has not been conducting "extremely targeted" efforts as it has done in the past to influence voters. Beijing has previously denied interfering in US elections and the Chinese Embassy in Washington on Wednesday described Himes' comment as "a false allegation and serious smear that has long been proved to be unfounded." Recent Reuters/Ipsos polling has shown Democrats leading Republicans on the generic congressional ballot by high single digits to low double digits nationally, bolstering Democratic hopes of regaining control of the House of Representatives and possibly the Senate. The lawmakers said they were concerned that Trump could pursue efforts to contest election results, including by claiming foreign hacking of voting infrastructure. Himes emphasized that there was no evidence that any country could penetrate US election systems and change results. "Nothing out there suggests that there is even the capability or the intent to do interference, whereas there is a pretty robust influence environment," said Himes.

item.content:encoded:

FAST

Oct 21 : Europe's largest tech company SAP on Wednesday achieved a €10 billion ($11.2 billion) quarterly revenue milestone for the first time, while reporting a 26 per cent rise in current cloud backlog and lifting its 2026 revenue outlook to the upper end of its range. Cloud revenue rose 26 per cent to €6.67 billion in the third quarter while non-IFRS operating profit rose 18 per cent to €3.03 billion. SAP's cloud backlog at constant currencies grew 26 per cent to €24.14 billion ($27.11 billion), ahead of the 24 per cent to 25 per cent growth UBS had forecast. SAP held its operating profit outlook at €11.8 billion to €12.2 billion at constant currencies, a range trimmed in July for its recent acquisitions. SAP's order book is watched as a gauge of enterprise tech spending worldwide as its software suite runs accounting and payroll at many of the world's biggest companies. A miss on the measure in January sent the shares down 15 per cent in one day.  "AI was the main driver behind customers move to the cloud," in the quarter, CEO Christian Klein told analysts, with companies signing subscription contracts to get access to SAP's Joule assistant platform connecting to over 70 AI models. "SAP is not committing to a preferred model," he said.

CFO Dominik Asam said the fourth quarter would decide how the year lands, describing a gloomy backdrop with rising oil prices and US interest rates that "start to develop teeth."  SAP said growth in cloud revenue was helped by customers returning from "financial distress." Its profit margin widened to 29.5 per cent from 28.3 per cent while free cash flow rose 36 per cent to €1.72 billion. SAP now expects 2026 subscription revenue — access to software customers rent remotely rather than buy and run themselves — toward the top of its €25.8 billion to €26.2 billion forecast, up 23 per cent to 25 per cent. Including the declining classic licence business, it sees revenue of €36.3 billion to €36.8 billion, up 12 per cent to 13 per cent, at the top of its range.  Klein called it "an outstanding quarter." Customers are "investing in the technology behind" the company's AI strategy, he said. New cloud customers included AstraZeneca, Infineon. ($1 = 0.8903 euros)

item.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック主導で上昇、決算受けＡＩ投資心理改善
item.description:
Purvi Agarwal
［ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック主導で上昇、決算受けＡＩ投資心理改善 5:14 配信

2026年9月28日に撮影 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Purvi Agarwal

［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合を中心に上昇した。スペースＸとスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターの四半期決算を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への投資意欲が改善した。ただ、通信サービス株の下落が上値を抑えた。

米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宙開発企業スペースＸは７．８％上昇。上場企業として初の黒字を計上した。マスク氏は決算発表後、スペースＸとテスラの合併は「良い考えだ」と述べ、テスラ株も買われた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバーメーカーのスーパー・マイクロは９．６％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の構成銘柄で上昇率上位に入った。四半期の売上高と利益率について市場予想を上回る見通しを示し、ＡＩ需要の底堅さを示唆した。同業にも買いが波及し、ＨＰＥは３．７％、デルは５．３％それぞれ上昇した。

両社の決算は、ＡＩインフラ整備への巨額投資の持続性や収益性を懸念していた投資家に一定の安心感を与えた。先週はデータセンター運営会社コアウィーブを中心にＡＩ関連株が売り込まれ、ハイテク株は大きな打撃を受けていた。

エドワード・ジョーンズのシニアグローバルストラテジスト、アンジェロ・クルカファス氏は、スペースＸのニュースがスーパー・マイクロの決算とともに、ＡＩに対する「投資家の懸念をある程度和らげている」と指摘。「ＡＩ投資のリターンに関する投資家の疑問全てに答えるものではないが、良い出発点だ」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の情報技術指数は１．６％上昇し、主要１１業種の中で上昇率トップとなった。

ハンティントン・バンクのマーク・ディザード最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「ＡＩのエコシステムに何らかの形で携わるほぼ全ての企業にとって、非常に前向きなニュースだ。ハイテク株の反応は、ＡＩ関連株を買う流れがなお健在であることを再確認するものだ」と指摘。その上で、ＡＩを巡る投資家心理は急速に変わり得るとし、投資家は他社の決算を見極めながら、強気の見方を裏付ける材料を探るだろうと語った。

メタ・プラットフォームズは通常取引終了後に四半期決算を発表し、時間外取引で３％上昇した。通常取引を３．４％高で終えたテスラも、引け後の決算発表を受け、時間外でさらに１．６％上昇した。

ハイテク株では半導体株が特に堅調で、フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２％上昇した。同指数は今月、８営業日続落するなど値動きの荒い展開となっている。

一方、通信サービス指数は１．３％下落し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の上値を抑えた。通信事業者の下げが目立ち、ＡＴ＆Ｔは第３・四半期の売上高と利益が予想を上回ったにもかかわらず、６．５％下落した。

ディザード氏によると、スペースＸの決算と最近の無線周波数帯の取得を受け、同社が通信業界で強力な競争相手になるとの懸念が強まった。ＴモバイルＵＳは２．５％、ベライゾン・コミュニケーションズは２．２％それぞれ下落した。

通信サービスでは、動画配信大手ネットフリックスも、第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、５．３％下落した。グーグルの親会社アルファベットも１．６％安となった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．３７対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．３対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６１億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億株。

item.title: Tesla cuts spending before potential SpaceX deal even as Musk bets future on AI, robots
item.description: The unexpected cash generated in the quarter comes at a critical moment for Tesla.
item.dc:creator: Akash Sriram, Abhirup Roy
item.content:encoded: Tesla (TSLA.O) cut its annual capital expenditure forecast by a fifth and posted surprise positive free cash flow in the third quarter on Wednesday, after investing far less in its AI and robotics ambitions than Wall Street had expected. The unexpected cash generated in the quarter comes at a critical moment for Tesla, as CEO Elon Musk [USN:L4N4661IU TEXT:"explores combining the EV maker"] with his far more capital-intensive space venture, SpaceX (SPCX.O) . While the lower spending strengthens Tesla’s financial position ahead of any deal, preserving cash at the expense of investment — in AI, robotaxis and humanoid robots — could undermine the very growth story investors are betting on. Tesla shares, which had risen 2% in after-hours trading after the company reported positive cash flow, higher gross margin and market-beating revenue, reversed course to trade down 2%. They have fallen about 14% this year. "The free cash flow beat was a pleasant surprise, but when combined with the lower-than-expected capex, raises questions on the next step for the automaker," said Ryan Lee, senior vice president of product and strategy at Direxion, which offers ETFs tied to Tesla. "Lower capex suggests less of an 'all-in' approach to the AI arms race than one would expect from Elon." Tesla said it expected capital expenses for 2026 to be roughly $20 billion, down from its previous forecast of more than $25 billion, but did not say what it would spend less on. In the third quarter ended September 30, Tesla spent $4.7 billion in capex, double that of a year ago, but lower than the $7.5 billion analysts on average were expecting, according to LSEG data. Tesla reported free cash flow of $1.53 billion, compared with an expected $4.92 billion cash burn. SPACEX MERGER UNDER DISCUSSION Musk said on Tuesday that a merger between Tesla and SpaceX was a "good idea" and that the companies had formed special committees to discuss a deal. On Wednesday, Musk said on a conference call with analysts that he had no more to say on the matter. A merger would create a single company at the center of Musk's[USN:L6N46214X TEXT:" long-term vision"]: an integrated technology and manufacturing empire spanning AI, energy, robotics, communications and transportation on Earth and beyond. Still, investors will seek evidence that Tesla is investing enough to turn Musk’s ambitions into commercial businesses, with the robotaxi rollout lagging his promises. Tesla's energy unit has recently offered a counterweight to its auto business, which remains under scrutiny as rivals globally launch newer, often cheaper models. Tesla still leans heavily on the aging Model 3 and Model Y. "The merger still faces a high bar, but tonight’s numbers make the financial logic harder to ignore," said Thomas Monteiro, a senior analyst at Investing.com. "The main takeaway is that Tesla's surprisingly positive cash flow quarter did not come from stronger profits, but from spending billions less than planned at a time when SpaceX is preparing to invest up to $40 billion in a single quarter." REVENUE FLAT BUT BEATS ESTIMATES Revenue was flat from a year earlier, despite the end of US tax credits that supported sales last year. That was enough to top Wall Street targets. Net income plunged 43%. Tesla said in a statement that it ended the quarter with the largest backlog for its passenger vehicles in four years. High gasoline prices have stoked demand for EVs, especially in Europe. With 486,532 vehicles delivered in the third quarter, Tesla is on track to increase annual deliveries for the first time in three years. "Demand is growing rapidly for our vehicles. It's exceeding our production by a significant margin," Musk said on the conference call with analysts. "In a nutshell, after many years of sort of grind and things being fairly flat, I think we're now headed for a lot of fun and significant growth." The FSD (supervised) attach rate reached over three-quarters of new vehicle deliveries in North America, a nearly 20-percentage-point increase from the second quarter, Tesla said. Automotive gross margin, excluding regulatory credits, came in at 18.1% in the third quarter, higher than analysts’ estimates of 16.7%, according to Visible Alpha data. Tesla said it was aiming to produce 5 million vehicles a year by about 2030, up from an expected 2.5 million this year.

item.title: Meta puts Muse agent at heart of AI strategy, plans new stock to power investments
item.description: Meta introduced new non-voting shares on Wednesday to help fund the social media giant's costly AI expansion, as executives laid out their vision for organizing the company's future around its nascent AI agent business.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Singh, Katie Paul
item.content:encoded: Meta (META.O) introduced new non-voting shares on Wednesday to help fund the social media giant's costly AI expansion, as executives laid out their vision for organizing the company's future around its nascent AI agent business. Shares of the Facebook and Instagram parent rose more than 4% in extended trading. Meta also forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates and reported strong growth of its new [USN:L6N4500XV TEXT:"consumer AI agent app Muse"]. The company has been pouring money into advanced chips and data centers to compete more aggressively with AI market leaders OpenAI and Anthropic, propelling it to the vanguard of an emerging consumer AI agent race while also eroding its historically strong free cash flow. Meta will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control. Zuckerberg said more than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half and growth remained strong. He said he expected Muse would eventually serve "billions of people" who would potentially generate more revenue than the average Meta user, forecasting the venture would give rise to the kind of network effect that helped build his social media empire. "Part of the reason why we're not just charging everyone up front to use this is we want to establish this Muse network, and we think that it's going to be more valuable for people at scale when there are a lot of people and businesses using Muse," Zuckerberg said on a conference call after Meta published its third-quarter financial report. HIGHER COSTS Still, Zuckerberg acknowledged that the costs of offering Muse were higher than those associated with many of Meta's other new products over the years, and said the company would move to monetize the agent "somewhat sooner on this than our normal playbook." Meta CFO Susan Li forecast the company's AI businesses would begin contributing incremental revenue in 2027 and become "a meaningful source of revenue diversification over time." The executives also emphasized that AI would be the focus moving forward for Meta’s loss-making Reality Labs unit, which had led the charge on the company’s vision to build the “metaverse,” an immersive digital world that inspired its name change from Facebook to Meta in 2021. In their financial report, they said they “remain focused on improving Reality Labs profitability” and forecast its losses would narrow next year to around $15 billion “as we reallocate investment toward other priority areas, primarily AI.” The company raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast, now expecting capital expenditure to be between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously. It reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier. Revenue for the third quarter came in better than expected at $64.60 billion, ahead of Wall Street estimates of $63.37 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Meta also projected fourth-quarter revenue between $73 billion and $76 billion, above estimates of $73.73 billion. The early popularity of Muse and the release of a competitive new [USN:L4N45Y13Q TEXT:"series of AI models"] have helped Meta justify its spending to investors, even though some enterprises are restricting the agent's access over security concerns. "The market has shifted from punishing Meta for spending to rewarding it for having a compelling product story," said Jesse Cohen, senior analyst at Investing.com. LEGAL CHALLENGES Legal challenges are mounting, including a $25 billion penalty [USN:L6N467165 TEXT:"ordered by a judge in New Mexico earlier"] on Wednesday after a jury found Meta misled the state's residents about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation in a case related to British political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica. The $25 billion penalty is a "stark reminder of the current legal challenges Meta faces, which will continue into next year," Emarketer senior analyst Minda Smiley said. "Questions and concerns related to privacy and safety will only ramp up should AI agents become more mainstream, which could ultimately hurt Meta considering its reputation in this area." In August, Meta [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"agreed to pay as much as $18 billion"] over a decade and restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram to settle claims by nearly all US states alleging that Meta's platforms were designed to addict children. Meta posted diluted earnings per share of $3.83 in the quarter, a figure that would have been $7.40 had it not been for a $9.89 billion charge related to the August settlement. The agreement [USN:L4N44N1N4 TEXT:"removed a significant regulatory hurdle"] that had weighed on Meta's stock and allowed the company to avoid a potentially lengthy trial that could have exposed more internal documents about its treatment of young users. Still, Meta warned in its guidance on Wednesday that it continued to face scrutiny and US trials around "youth-related issues" that could impact its financial results.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、原油高によるインフレ懸念を警戒 ＦＯＭＣ控え
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、原油高によるインフレ懸念を警戒　ＦＯＭＣ控え 4:48 配信

２０２５年５月撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を来週に控え、市場では原油高に伴うインフレ再燃リスクが意識されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．０２％高の１５８．１２円。 日銀の氷見野良三副総裁は衆院財務金融委員会で、９月の利上げについて、中長期の予想物価上昇率が引き続き上昇していることも踏まえれば「基調的な物価上昇率は２％にかなり近づいており、先行き物価安定の目標とおおむね整合的な水準となる」と指摘。こうした中心的な見通しに加え、金融環境が緩和的な状態にあることや物価の上振れリスクに留意する必要があることなどを踏まえて決めたとし、利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されており、引き続き経済活動はしっかりとサポートされている」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数＜＝USD＞は０．１４％安の１０１．６５。ユーロは対ドルで０．０１％高の１．１２３７ドル。

スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン主任ＦＸストラテジストは、「市場全体を左右する明確なテーマは現在のところ見当たらない。少なくとも来週のＦＯＭＣまでこうした状況が続く」と指摘。「連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が何を考えているのかを見極める必要がある」としている。

米国とイランの戦闘の終着点が見えない中、原油価格上昇を通じたインフレ圧力がＦＲＢの政策に影響を及ぼすとの懸念が高まっている。ＦＲＢが２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで追加利上げに動く可能性は小さいとみられており、次回の利上げは１２月８─９日の会合になるとの見方が優勢。来週のＦＯＭＣでウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が今後の政策運営について明確に示唆する可能性も低いとみられている。ただ、スコシアバンクのオズボーン氏は、今後の金利見通しや利上げ時期を巡る市場の見方は、来週にはある程度固まるとの見方を示している。

市場では、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄を中心とした相場上昇の持続可能性を巡る懸念も払しょくされていない。ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツのＦＸストラテジスト、ノア・バファム氏は「米国の成長はＡＩ相場によって大きくけん引されてきた。米国のインフレ率が（ＦＲＢの）目標を超える水準にとどまる要因にもなっており、米国は他の国よりも大きな影響を受けている」と述べた。

ユーロに対しては、フランスで反政府デモが広がっていることや財政見通しの悪化がこのところ重しになっている。仏１０年債利回りはこの日の取引で２００２年７月以来初めて５％台に乗せた。コペンハーゲンに拠点を置くサクソのグローバル・マクロ戦略責任者、ジョン・ハーディ氏は「フランスの債務問題は容易に解決できる状況ではない。債務残高の増加に歯止めをかける真剣な姿勢を示すためにも、政府は財政面で適切な調整を実施する必要がある」と述べた。

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy hopes for new talks with Russia, US by early November
item.description: President Zelenskiy said Ukraine supported a US proposal for talks to be held as soon as possible.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Wednesday that Ukraine supported a US proposal for three-way talks with Russia and the United States at the level of negotiators to be held as soon as possible, preferably no later than early November. Zelenskiy, speaking to journalists on WhatsApp as he returned to Kyiv from Norway, said he had spoken to US officials after presidential envoy Steve Witkoff's talks in St Petersburg with Russian President Vladimir Putin. "We have received feedback that...Russia supports a trilateral meeting at the level of our (negotiating) teams," Zelenskiy said. "The American side has proposed holding it as soon as possible and we support that...The Ukrainian side has been in contact with its American partners. They will do everything to ensure that the meeting takes place as early as possible, in November. I think no later than early November." Zelenskiy said that Kyiv supported "any proposals for a ceasefire, an end to the war, an energy ceasefire as well as humanitarian initiatives". Earlier, [USN:L6N4670P2 TEXT:"the Kremlin said"] Putin has agreed to resume US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine as soon as next month. Witkoff met Putin a day after holding talks with Zelenskiy in Norway amid concerns in Kyiv and among its allies that the United States was backing away from Ukraine.

item.description:

３営業日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。石油株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反発した。中型株で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（21日） 4:07 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

３営業日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。石油株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反発した。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．３１％高だった。

石油大手のＢＰは１．９％、シェルは０．２％それぞれ上昇。北海のジャックドー・ガス田の採掘を英政府が承認した。

資産運用会社アバディーンは４．１％安。一部で資金流入の回復が予想より遅れるとの見通しを示し、売られた。上半期決算を発表した自転車・自動車部品販売のハルフォーズは８．６％安。

９月の英消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）上昇率は前年同月比３．５％と、伸び率が前月から加速。市場予想３．４％を上回った。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場ではイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月に０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めることがほぼ確実視されている。

ヒーリー財務相の予算案発表を来週に控える中、公的部門の純借入額は２カ月連続で市場予想を上回った。公的債務残高は３兆ポンド（約４兆１００億ドル）を超えた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。堅調な業績を示した企業が物色される中、抗議デモ激化に伴う政治不安から下落していたフランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は１．０６％高と買い戻しの動きが出た。

オランダの人材サービス大手ランスタッドは２０．２％高。直近四半期決算が好感された。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は１．７２％高。フランスの高級眼鏡大手エシロールルックスオティカは１５．５％上昇。

増収決算となったデンマークの物流大手ＤＳＶは１５．１％上昇した。

一方、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種自動車・部品株指数は１．７２％安。フランスの大手タイヤメーカー、ミシュランは７．２％下落した。

フランスの小売大手カルフールは１３．８％安。暴動や略奪、夜間外出禁止令による影響を踏まえて通期業績予想を下方修正し、値下がりした。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが上昇した。フランスで抗議行動が広がり、ぜい弱な財政と政治的不透明感への懸念が一段と強まった。

フランスの指標となる１０年物国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは、２００２年７月以来初めて５％台に乗せた。この日は８ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）、今週では２０ｂｐ超上昇した。

独仏１０年債利回り格差＜DE１０FR１０=RR＞は１５０ｂｐと、ユーロ圏主要国債市場で最大となった。１０月初めに付けた約１６０ｂｐの１５年ぶり高水準に向けて再び拡大しつつある。

フランスの混乱は２０日までにいくぶん落ち着いたが、２４日にはさらなる抗議行動が予定されており、企業は財務面での打撃を感じ始めている。

投資家はイタリアにも注目している。生活費高騰を巡る抗議行動を受け、メローニ首相は２０日、より厳しい暴動対策を承認した。

ただイタリア国債は今週、フランス債よりも堅調で、１０年利回りの上昇は１２ｂｐにとどまった。

イタリア１０年債利回りは８ｂｐ上昇し４．６０４７％となった。独伊１０年債利回り格差は４ｂｐ拡大して１１６ｂｐとなった。

ドイツの１０年債利回りは３．４ｂｐ上昇の３．４２７４％と、今週はほぼ変わらず。２年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇し３．０９４０％となった。

item.title: メタに250億ドル支払い命令、米地裁 ＦＢ個人情報問題巡り
item.description:
Diana Novak Jones
[２１日 ロイター] - 米ニューメキシコ州の地裁は２１日、メタ・プラットフォーム...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
メタに250億ドル支払い命令、米地裁　ＦＢ個人情報問題巡り 4:00 配信

１０月１９日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Diana Novak Jones

[２１日 ロイター] - 米ニューメキシコ州の地裁は２１日、メタ・プラットフォームズに対し２５０億ドルの支払いを命じた。トランプ氏の２０１６年米大統領選陣営に関与した政治コンサルティング会社がフェイスブック利用者数百万人のデータを本人の同意なく取得したとされる問題を巡る訴訟で、州地裁陪審がメタは利用者を欺いたと認定していた。

ニューメキシコ州のラウル・トレス司法長官は、単独の州が企業を相手に勝ち取った判決として、米国史上最大級だと述べた。

地裁のフランシス・マシュー判事は陪審評決を受けた命令で、この件は「フェイスブックの中核的な事業慣行そのものに関わる問題だ」と指摘した。同判事は州法に基づけば２１９０億ドル超の制裁金が妥当と判断したが、２５０億ドルに減額した。

メタのＣ・Ｊ・マホニー最高法務責任者（ＣＬＯ）は声明で、控訴審で勝訴すると確信していると表明した。

同氏は「今回の判断と司法長官による法執行の進め方は、ニューメキシコ州で事業を営むことを事実上不可能にする」と指摘。「この訴訟は本質的に、人々がオンラインで何を発言できるかについて新たな規則を強制するため、言論に税を課そうとするものだ」と述べた。

メタはこれまで、数十億ドル規模の制裁金は、適正手続きや過大な罰金からの保護を受ける憲法上の権利を侵害する恐れがあると主張していた。

この件を巡っては、英政治コンサルティング会社ケンブリッジ・アナリティカがサードパーティー製アプリを通じて最大８７００万人分のフェイスブック利用者の個人データを収集していたことが明らかになり、ニューメキシコ州の司法長官が２０２１年にメタを提訴していた。

今回の制裁金は、ケンブリッジ・アナリティカ問題を受けてメタに科されたものとしては最大となる。同社は１９年にも、同じ問題を巡り米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）から５０億ドルの制裁金を科された。

item.title: Rice rescues Arsenal at Bayern as Real Madrid hit four
item.description: Declan Rice rescued Arsenal with a late equaliser in an electric 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich, while Real Madrid beat RB Leipzig 4-1 and Como handed Manchester United a bruising defeat by the same score.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Kallas
item.content:encoded: Declan Rice rescued Arsenal with a late equaliser in an electric 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich on Wednesday, while Real Madrid beat RB Leipzig 4-1 and Como handed Manchester United a bruising defeat by the same score. Arsenal's evening in Germany began ominously when Bukayo Saka limped out of the contest in the 10th minute, clutching his knee after falling while attempting a pass. Fifteen minutes later, however, Eberechi Eze raced on to Martin Odegaard's long ball and fired an angled shot past Manuel Neuer. Initially flagged offside, the goal was awarded following a VAR review. Bayern replied in the 35th minute when Harry Kane released Alphonso Davies down the left with a through ball from halfway, the Canadian breaking clear before beating David Raya with a composed right-footed finish. Kane put the hosts ahead from the penalty spot in the 61st minute after his shot struck Jurrien Timber's raised hand, blasting his 58th Champions League goal into the roof of the net. But Rice had the final say eight minutes from time, exchanging passes with Viktor Gyokeres inside the box before slotting past Neuer. COURTOIS KEEPS REAL AFLOAT At the Santiago Bernabeu, Real's emphatic scoreline owed much to goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who denied Romulo's close-range volley and thwarted Christopher Nkunku one-on-one before the hosts found their rhythm. Bernardo Silva broke the deadlock in the 43rd minute, pouncing to tap home almost on the goalline after Leipzig goalkeeper Maarten Vandevoordt spilled Federico Valverde's shot. Arda Guler doubled the lead seven minutes after halftime, beating a defender to Kylian Mbappe's goalbound header from Jude Bellingham's cross. Mbappe curled a shot into the top corner in the 83rd minute before Tidiam Gomis pulled one back a minute later. Substitute Yan Diomande capped Real's victory with a spectacular volley from Brahim Diaz's cross. Elsewhere, Galatasaray won 4-2 at Lille, Inter Milan edged Shakhtar Donetsk 1-0, Aston Villa beat Viking Stavanger 3-1 and Real Betis beat Feyenoord 1-0, while LASK stunned Sporting 3-2 in Lisbon. Paris St Germain, Aston Villa, Real Madrid, Liverpool and Real Betis top the standings having all made perfect starts to their Champions League campaigns, with three wins from three matches. Inter Milan overcame Alessandro Bastoni's dismissal to beat Shakhtar Donetsk, Carlos Augusto controlling Henrikh Mkhitaryan's long pass in his stride before scoring the 77th-minute winner. Bastoni had received a second booking eight minutes earlier for pushing an opponent away from the ball. Aston Villa comfortably beat Norway's Viking, Ross Barkley heading the opener from a corner before Emiliano Buendia converted a penalty and Alysson found the net with a deflected shot. Peter Christiansen struck Viking's late consolation. Isco's 59th-minute penalty following a handball gave Real Betis victory over Feyenoord in Seville, while Club Brugge beat Lens 3-0 through goals from Hans Vanaken, Joaquin Seys and Carlos Forbs. LASK stunned Sporting, recovering from Luis Suarez's early penalty with goals from Christoph Lang, Sasa Kalajdzic and Krystof Danek. Suarez scored again in the 89th minute but the hosts could not salvage a point. PAZ PUNISHES UNITED Earlier, Nico Paz tormented Manchester United with two goals and an assist as Como swept to victory in northern Italy, while Galatasaray won a six-goal thriller at Lille. Paz put Como ahead inside two minutes with a curling effort from the edge of the box, then helped double the lead four minutes after halftime, threading a perfectly weighted pass through for Anastasios Douvikas to finish first time past the advancing goalkeeper. The Argentine then robbed Carlos Baleba near the right touchline and surged diagonally for more than 30 metres before steering a left-footed finish inside the far post. Jacobo Ramon headed Como's fourth from substitute Kaiki Bruno's cross in the 76th minute, with Joshua Zirkzee grabbing United's stoppage-time consolation from Amad Diallo's delivery. In France, Galatasaray recovered from surrendering an early lead to beat Lille 4-2. Yunus Akgun fired the visitors ahead shortly after kickoff, but Soriba Diaoune equalised five minutes later and struck again in the 39th minute to put Lille in front. Alexey Batrakov headed Galatasaray level in the 44th minute before Lucas Torreira appeared to glance home a corner in the 52nd, although the effort was later credited as a Nabil Bentaleb own goal. Victor Osimhen completed the scoring nine minutes later with a powerful strike from the edge of the box.

item.title: US orders diplomats to depart Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes
item.description: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and other US missions in the region. The order came as fresh attacks were reported in Saudi Arabia.
item.dc:creator: Rami Ayyub, Humeyra Pamuk, Timour Azhari
item.content:encoded: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and plans to withdraw family members from a number of other US missions in the region, US officials told Reuters. The order came as attacks in Saudi Arabia killed at least one person and injured eight others at a civilian airport in Dammam and two people were killed in a [USN:L1N46710X TEXT:"drone attack on an oil field"]. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a post on X that the department ordered the departure of "non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only" amid [USN:L1N4610L5 TEXT:"attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis"] in Yemen on civilian targets in the country. Washington had returned some diplomatic personnel to the region in recent months after many were pulled out when Tehran launched attacks on US facilities after the US-Israeli war on Iran began in late February. "Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions," Pigott said. Four US officials told Reuters that US missions in other Gulf states would also be ordering family members to leave. Pigott did not address changes to other missions outside Saudi Arabia. The latest withdrawals follow an escalation of the fighting in Yemen, opening another front in the regional conflict triggered by the US-Israeli war on Iran. The wider conflict has snarled global energy trade and hurt Gulf economies. After the departure order, Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority reported an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam that killed one person and injured eight others. Earlier in the day, two people were killed after Saudi air defences intercepted a drone that was attempting to hit a facility at Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oilfield, the energy ministry said. The US embassy in Riyadh issued a security alert on Wednesday about possible further attacks by the Houthis on Saudi Arabia, after recent deadly strikes including [USN:S8N43T03L TEXT:"on Riyadh's airport"]. The embassy and a CIA station hosted there [USN:L1N3ZR1EN TEXT:"came under attack"] by drones in early March, as Iran began launching attacks across the region.

item.title: 情報ＢＯＸ：ＰＨＰの重大脆弱性、リスクと発見経緯
item.description:
Leo Marchandon
[２１日 ロイター] - 欧州各地で２１日、政府ウェブサイトの停止が相次いだ。ウェブで最...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
情報ＢＯＸ：ＰＨＰの重大脆弱性、リスクと発見経緯 1:40 配信

2026年10月21日、ドイツ・ベルリン。REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

Leo Marchandon

[２１日 ロイター] - 欧州各地で２１日、政府ウェブサイトの停止が相次いだ。ウェブで最も広く使われているプログラミング言語の一つ、ＰＨＰ（ハイパーテキスト・プリプロセッサ）で２件の重大な脆弱性が見つかったためだ。

以下に押さえておくべきポイントをまとめた。

＜ＰＨＰとは＞

ＰＨＰはウェブサイトを動かすプログラミング言語で、利用者から見えないところで働いている。利用者がページを読み込むと、ＰＨＰが稼働するサーバーがコンテンツを組み立て、完成したページをブラウザーに送る。

無料のオープンソースソフトウエアで、ボランティアが保守している。サイトの所有者が直接操作することはほとんどない。

ウェブ技術の調査サービス「Ｗ３Ｔｅｃｈｓ」によると、使用するプログラミング言語を特定できるウェブサイトの７０％近くがＰＨＰで動いている。ＰＨＰは、全ウェブサイトの約４０％を支えるソフトウエア「ワードプレス」の基盤でもある。これらにはブログ、中小企業のページ、政府のポータルサイト、オンラインショップ、ニュースサイトなどが含まれる。

＜脆弱性のリスクは＞

２件の脆弱性は、業界標準の深刻度評価システム「ＣＶＳＳ」のバージョン４．０で、１０点満点中９．２点と評価されている。ＥＵのサイバーセキュリティー対応チーム「ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵ」によると、この評価は認証なしで遠隔からコードを実行できることを示す。つまり、攻撃者はパスワードやアカウントがなくても、インターネット経由で脆弱なサーバー上でコマンドを実行できる。

ＰＨＰに一つの欠陥があるだけで、数百万台のサーバーに一斉に同じ侵入口が開かれる。欠陥を悪用すれば、ウェブサイトを支配できる。ウェブホスティングサービスのゴーダディによると、データの盗難やページの改ざん、システム全体の乗っ取りにつながる恐れがある。クラウドフレアの最高技術責任者は、初期の攻撃が発生し始めていると述べた。

小規模なウェブサイトの大半は通常、セキュリティー担当者のいない所有者が運営している。共用ホスティングサービスを利用していることも多く、その場合、所有者はサーバーを管理しておらず、誰がＰＨＰを更新するのか把握していない可能性がある。ワードプレス向けのセキュリティープラグイン「ワードフェンス」は、通常の自動更新では今回の修正は適用されないと警告した。ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵは、影響を受けるサイトを危険にさらしたままにせず、公開を停止するよう勧告している。

＜どのように発見されたのか＞

セキュリティー企業カリフによると、オープンＡＩと協力する同社の研究者が、オープンＡＩのモデル「ＧＰＴ－５．６ Ｓｏｌ」を使って最初の欠陥を発見し、８月１１日にＰＨＰ側に報告した。アルファベット傘下グーグルが保有するセキュリティー企業ウィズも独自に欠陥を発見し、８月２４日に２件目を報告した。同社も人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルを使用した。

ウィズは、今回の欠陥について「ＰＨＰで見つかった脆弱性の中でも最も深刻な部類に入り、ソフトウエアの歴史全体でもそう言えるだろう」と説明した。根本的な欠陥は数十年前から存在していたが、悪用できると実証するには「人間の研究者が現実的に達成できる限界に近い」一連の手順が必要だったという。

トランプ米政権は「状況を注視し、修正プログラムの公開を早めるため、連邦機関や主要なＳＩ研究機関と調整している」と表明した。ＳＩは、トランプ氏が人工知能を指して好んで使う「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス）」の略称。政権は今回の発見を、米国の「超知能」が国家安全保障を強化している証拠と位置付けた。

item.title: What is PHP and why did it take government websites offline?
item.description: The developers of PHP said they would release patches for two critical vulnerabilities.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: Government websites across Europe went dark on Wednesday as operators raced to patch two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, one of the most widely used programming languages on the web. The developers of PHP said on Wednesday they would release patches for two critical vulnerabilities, and EU cybersecurity officials warned organisations unable to apply the fixes to take affected websites offline. Here is what you need to know: WHAT IS PHP? PHP is a programming language that runs websites. It works behind the scenes. When a user loads a page, the server running PHP assembles the content and sends the finished page to the browser. It is free, open source and maintained by volunteers. Site owners rarely interact with it directly. PHP runs nearly 70% of all websites whose programming language can be identified, according to web technology tracker W3Techs. It is the engine behind WordPress, the software that powers about 40% of all websites such as blogs, small business pages, government portals, online shops and news sites. WHAT ARE THE RISKS OF THE FLAWS? The two vulnerabilities are rated 9.2 out of 10 on the CVSS v4.0 severity scale, a standard industry scoring system. CERT-EU, the European Union's cybersecurity response team, said that rating signals unauthenticated remote code execution, meaning an attacker can run commands on a vulnerable server, over the internet, with no password or account. A single flaw in PHP opens the same door on millions of servers at once. Whoever exploits the flaw controls the website. GoDaddy (GDDY.N) , a web hosting provider, said that could mean stolen data, defaced pages or full-system compromise. Cloudflare's (NET.N) chief technology officer said early attacks were emerging. Most small websites are typically run by owners with no security staff, often on shared hosting where they do not manage the server and may not know who updates PHP. Wordfence, a security plugin for WordPress sites, warned that the usual automatic updates will not apply this fix. CERT-EU's guidance is to take affected sites offline rather than leave them exposed. HOW WAS IT FOUND? Researchers at security firm Calif, working with OpenAI, reported the first flaw to PHP on August 11 after finding it with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model, the company said. Wiz, a security firm owned by Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google, found the flaws independently and reported a second one on August 24, also using AI models. Wiz said the findings "rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history." The underlying flaws had been present for decades, the firm said, but proving they were exploitable required a chain of steps "at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve." US President Donald Trump's administration said it was "tracking and coordinating with federal agencies and leading SI labs to expedite the release of the fix," referring to Trump's preferred name for artificial intelligence. It framed the discovery as evidence that American "Super Intelligence" strengthens national security.

item.content:encoded:
アップルの折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ「デュオ」、23日発売　店頭は数量限定 0:39 配信

米アップルの折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」。カリフォルニア州のスティーブ・ジョブズ・シアターで開催された同社イベントで９月撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Stephen Nellis

[サンフランシスコ　２１日　ロイター] - 米アップルは２１日、２３日に発売される同社初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」 について、店頭に来店した顧客向けに「数量限定」で提供すると発表した。オンラインでの先行予約が数分で完売し、一部顧客への配送時期が来年１月にずれ込んでいることを受けた措置となる。

アップルは声明で「２３日の朝、アップルストアで『iPhone Duo』や素晴らしいiPhoneのラインアップを体験してもらえることを楽しみにしている」と表明。「アップルストアでは『iPhone Duo』を来店客向けに数量限定で用意しており、この革新的な新製品をできるだけ早く届けられるよう尽力している」と述べた。

アップルは、当日店頭で購入できる台数は国・地域によって異なるとしている。オンライン予約の店頭受け取りおよび数量限定の店頭販売は、米国、オーストラリア、カナダ、メキシコ、英国と欧州の大部分で利用可能となる。

一方、オンラインで事前購入した顧客のみに提供される地域もあり、中国本土、フランス、香港、インド、日本、マレーシア、韓国、台湾、タイ、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）が含まれるとした。

Jaspreet Singh　Aditya Soni

[２１日 ロイター] - 米電子商取引（ＥＣ）大手イーベイが、従業員の約９％を削減することが分かった。ジェイミー・イアンノーネ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が従業員に宛てたメモをロイターが確認した。業務を簡素化し、成長が最も速い分野に経営資源を振り向ける。

同社の広報担当者は２１日、人員削減を確認し、約１０００人が対象になると述べた。

２０２５年末の従業員数は１万２３００人だった。同社は業務効率化の一環として、２月にも従業員の約６％に当たる８００人を削減した。

イアンノーネ氏はメモで「今後の大きな機会を引き続き捉えるには、どこに注力し、投資するかについて慎重に選択する必要がある」と説明。対象の従業員には今後数日以内に通知するとした。

イーベイ株は取引序盤に約１％上昇した。

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat vor mittlerweile täglichen hybriden Angriffen Russlands auf Deutschland gewarnt und gleichzeitig eine Kapitulation der Ukraine abgelehnt. "Meine größte Sorge ist im Moment nicht unsere Wirtschaft, nicht die Europäische Union, nicht Amerika und nicht China", sagte Merz am Mittwoch beim Berlin Global Dialogue (BGD). "Meine größte Sorge sind die Auswirkungen Russlands auf unsere Gesellschaft und die Art und Weise, wie es ihnen gelingt, unsere Gesellschaften zu destabilisieren." Man erlebe permanent Angriffe Russlands und müsse widerstandsfähig werden. Die fortwährenden Desinformationen aus Moskau würden auch noch von einer Partei geschürt, sagte er in Anspielung auf die AfD. Deshalb sei auch klar, warum Deutschland die Ukraine weiter in ihrem Abwehrkampf gegen den russischen Angreifer unterstütze. "Das ist nicht nur ein Krieg in der Ukraine. Das ist ein grundlegender Angriff auf die gesamte politische Ordnung, die wir nach 1990 erreicht haben", sagte er. Mit Blick auf die neuen Russland-Avancen von US-Präsident Donald Trump fügte der Kanzler hinzu: "Eine Kapitulation – oder gar eine bedingungslose Kapitulation der Ukraine – kommt nicht infrage. Denn das wäre eine Kapitulation von uns allen." Deutschland und die Europäer unterstützten die Ukraine im eigenen Interesse. Regierungssprecher Stefan Kornelius bestätigte, dass der außen- und sicherheitspolitische Berater des Kanzlers bei den Gesprächen in Oslo zwischen dem US-Sondergesandten Steve Witkoff, dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj, dem norwegischen Ministerpräsidenten Jonas Gahr Støre und dem finnischen Präsidenten Alexander Stubb anwesend gewesen sei. Für die Bundesregierung sei klar, dass es keine Vereinbarung über die Köpfe der Ukraine und der Europäer hinweg geben könne.

item.title: Apple will have limited iPhone Duo units available in stores on Friday
item.description: Apple on Wednesday said it will have 'limited' numbers of its folding iPhone Duo phone available for walk-in customers when the device launches Friday, after initial online orders sold out in minutes and pushed delivery times for some customers to January.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: Apple (AAPL.O) on Wednesday said it will have 'limited' numbers of its folding iPhone Duo phone available for walk-in customers when the device launches Friday, after initial online orders sold out in minutes and pushed delivery times for some customers to January. Apple announced its first folding phone in September, with analysts expecting it to quickly come to dominate a niche segment where rivals such as Samsung Electronics and Huawei Technologies have sold premium offerings for years. But the iPhone Duo is also a more complex product than standard candy-bar iPhones, with a tight-fitting hinge that analysts believe may take time for Apple to learn to manufacture in high volumes. “On Friday morning, our teams look forward to welcoming customers at Apple Stores to experience iPhone Duo and the incredible iPhone line-up for themselves," Apple said in a statement. "Apple Stores will have limited iPhone Duo available for walk-in customers, and we’re working hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers' hands as quickly as possible.” The availability of walk-in units will vary by country, Apple said. Online order pickup and limited walk-in purchases will be available in the United States, Australia, Canada, Mexico and much of the UK and Europe. But other regions will only have iPhone Duo units available for customers who already bought them online. Those include mainland China, France, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and the UAE, Apple said. In the China-governed territory of Macau, the iPhone Duo will be available for walk-in customers only, with limited inventory, Apple said. (This story has been refiled to clarify that Macau is a territory of China, in paragraph 7 . )

経産省、来年からＥＶ補助6─8割に減額　予算内で制度維持へ 10/21 22:58 配信

電気自動車の充電設備。２００９年７月、神奈川県横須賀市で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Yuriko Nakao）

Maki Shiraki

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は２１日、電気自動車（ＥＶ）など電動車の購入を促す補助金を来年から減額すると発表した。購入後に購入者が受け取れる補助金額を、現行の６割─８割程度に抑える。当初の想定より需要が強く、補助額を引き下げて予算内で制度を継続できるよう見直した。

来年１月１日以降に新車登録する車両から適用する。ＥＶの補助金は最大で１２５万円だったが、来年からは最大７５万円に減る。軽自動車のＥＶでは５５万円が４４万円に、プラグインハイブリッド車（ＰＨＶ）は８０万円が４８万円に、燃料電池車は１４５万円が８７万円にそれぞれ引き下がる。

車両に対する補助金とは別に、環境負荷の低減に向けた鋼材の導入に関する自動車メーカーの取り組みに応じて決める加算額も、軽のＥＶが最大３万円から１万８０００円に、それ以外の電動車は最大５万円から３万円に減額する。

政府は２０２５年度補正予算に、約１１００億円を補助分として計上していた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：ルノー、ＥＶ新会社ＩＰＯ中止は「災い転じて福」か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：静かに進むガソリン離れ、中国製ＥＶの世界展開が後押しか 焦点：中国の省エネシフト加速、燃料需要が急減　ＥＶ普及など 最終更新: 10/21(水) 22:58 ロイター

item.description: [東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は２１日夜、ウェブサイトで広く使われているプログラミング言語ＰＨＰに深...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
高市首相　速やかな対応呼びかけ　プログラミング言語ＰＨＰに脆弱性 10/21 22:47 配信

資料写真：2024年2月19日に撮影されたこのイラストでは、「サイバーセキュリティ」という文字の前にコンピューターとスマートフォンを持った人形が写っている。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は２１日夜、ウェブサイトで広く使われているプログラミング言語ＰＨＰに深刻な脆弱性が見つかったことを受け、日本時間午後１１時に公開される修正プログラムを速やかに適用するよう呼びかけた。直ちに対応できない場合は、サイトなどを一時停止することも有効な対策とした。Ｘに投稿した。

ＰＨＰの開発者チームは同日、深刻な脆弱性２件に対応する修正プログラムを公開すると発表した。

item.content:encoded:
独経済は第3四半期停滞、今四半期回復を予想＝中銀 10/21 21:52 配信

[フランクフルト ２１日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）は２１日、国内経済が第３・四半期に停滞した可能性が高いとの見方を示した。輸出の低迷、ライン川の異例の水位低下による混乱、内需の弱さが、財政支出による下支え効果を相殺した。

連銀は第４・四半期に景気が回復するとの予想を維持。建設活動への恩恵が広がっているインフラ支出などが回復を主導するとみている。
